Title: Junior data analist
Description:
Heb jij een afgeronde Wo-opleiding in een analytische richting en wil je verder leren hoe je data vertaalt naar concrete verbeteringen binnen een van de grootste logistieke netwerken van Nederland? Als junior data analist op ons hoofdkantoor in Oirschot werk je samen met ervaren collega's aan analyses, rapportages en dashboards die helpen bij het nemen van betere beslissingen. Je krijgt volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te pakken.

Wat ga je doen?

Als junior data analist maak je onderdeel uit van het team Insights & Analytics en rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de Manager Insights & Analytics. Samen met vier andere data analisten en het Business Intelligence-team help je DPD om betere beslissingen te nemen op basis van data.

Je voert dataverzoeken en analyses uit op vraagstukken vanuit de organisatie en richt je daarbij voornamelijk op historische data. Denk hierbij aan het onderzoeken van oorzaken van inefficiënties binnen de supply chain. Je onderzoekt wat er is gebeurd, waarom dit is gebeurd en welke inzichten hieruit kunnen worden gehaald. Deze inzichten deel je met stakeholders binnen de operatie, zodat zij processen kunnen verbeteren en beter onderbouwde beslissingen kunnen nemen.

Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden


Analyseren van operationele en/of commerciële data om trends, afwijkingen en verbeterkansen inzichtelijk te maken.
Onderzoeken van vraagstukken vanuit de organisatie en achterhalen wat de oorzaken zijn van bepaalde resultaten.
Verzamelen, controleren en interpreteren van data uit interne- en externe bronnen.
Ondersteunen bij het ontwikkelen van rapportages, dashboards en analyses.
Vertalen van data naar duidelijke inzichten en verbetervoorstellen voor de organisatie.


Wat bieden we jou?


Een salaris tussen € 4.159,- en € 5.941,- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.
Een functie 38,75 (1 fte) uur per week.
De mogelijkheid om hybride te werken incl. een netto thuiswerkvergoeding en flexibele werktijden.
Opleidingskansen, ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en onbeperkt toegang tot onze Studyhub.
28 vakantiedagen (+ optie tot bijkoop) en reiskostenvergoeding.
Veel extra’s, zoals een collectieve zorgverzekering, thuiswerkvergoeding en een aantrekkelijk pensioen (3,55% eigen bijdrage).


,

Wat neem je mee?


Een afgeronde Wo-opleiding in de richting van Econometrie, Data Analytics, Wiskunde, Supply Chain Management of een vergelijkbare studie.
Affiniteit met data-analyse en het vertalen van data naar waardevolle inzichten.
Basiskennis van SQL, Power BI, Python, Excel of vergelijkbare analysetools.
Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.
Een nieuwsgierige en analytische instelling; je wilt begrijpen waarom dingen gebeuren.
De motivatie om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen data-analyse, forecasting en supply chain.


Over DPD Nederland

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA.

We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil.

Solliciteren

Solliciteer direct bij DPD door op de rode knop ‘solliciteren’ te klikken. Wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.

Heb je eerder vragen? Neem gerust contact op met onze corporate recruiter, Donne van der Wal via +31 6 29 989 532.

Klik hier voor meer informatie over ons sollicitatieproces.

Acquisitie en doorplaatsing van deze vacature worden niet op prijs gesteld.

Title: Data Analyst - Entry Level
Description:
At TCC Global, we create innovative loyalty marketing solutions that drive customer engagement and strengthen brand loyalty for some of the world’s leading retailers. Our passionate team delivers exceptional results through precision execution, strong client partnerships, and seamless operational processes.

As a Data Analyst within the Data & Analytics (D&A) department, you will sit in TCC’s client- and stakeholder-facing BI team. You will play a central role in proving TCC’s value proposition by measuring loyalty campaign ROI, analyzing the drivers of campaign performance, and translating findings into clear proof points and business insights that inform commercial and operational decisions. The role carries hands-on tasks across measurement, analysis, data pipeline building, and report development. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, and Operations to deliver insights, scale campaign measurement, support commercial proposals, and optimize campaign execution through in-store and digital channels. Working day-to-day with Power BI, Azure ML, and AI tooling, you will help shift the business toward democratized, AI-served insights — delivered faster, embedded with stakeholders, and closer to the decisions they support.

The role supports the BI function within the Data & Analytics department, with the following responsibilities:


Measure and analyze campaign performance and ROI; translate results into proof points that demonstrate TCC’s value proposition, in close collaboration with Marketing.
Deliver business analyses that support commercial proposals, client conversations, and internal de-cision-making across Commercial, Delivery, and Operations.
Respond to ad-hoc analysis requests from across the business — turning open-ended questions into structured analyses with clear, timely answers.
Build and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards.
Develop and optimize data pipelines on TCC’s data platform (Azure).
Contribute to the evolution of analytical and AI-served tools (including Enterprise AI / text2sql) that put insights directly in the hands of colleagues and clients.
Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate analysis, pipeline, and reporting work.
Support running solutions — monitor pipelines and reports in production, investigate issues, and contribute to iterative improvement.
Apply data governance standards in day-to-day work, ensuring trusted, well-documented outputs.
Participate in agile delivery ceremonies (planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and share best practices across the team.



Must‑haves: 


1–2 years of experience in a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, or similar role, with hands-on experience in performance/campaign analysis and dashboard development;
Strong analytical and technical skills across SQL, Python, statistics, Power BI (including DAX/data modelling), and cloud-based data environments (preferably Azure);
Ability to turn complex data into actionable business insights and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders;
Comfortable working in agile, fast-paced environments, collaborating cross-functionally, and using AI-assisted tools to improve analysis and reporting workflows;
Fluent English.



Nice‑to‑haves:


Exposure to Azure AI Foundry and broader modern AI/data platforms;
Experience in retail, loyalty, marketing, or campaign analytics;
Additional language skills such as Dutch, Spanish, Portuguese, or German;
Strong curiosity for emerging AI tooling and continuous learning across the data and AI stack;
Practical experience with data pipelines, ELT/ETL processes, testing/data quality practices, and software engineering fundamentals such as Git and code reviews.



What we offer:


Competitive salary and annual bonus.
Opportunities for growth and professional development.
A dynamic and supportive work environment where your ideas truly matter.
Hybrid working model.



TCC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered without distinction of age, culture, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ethnicity, or disability status.

Title: Data Analist
HTML:
Word jij enthousiast van het ontdekken van inzichten én het bouwen van slimme datagedreven oplossingen? Zie jij kansen om met predictive analytics, AI en moderne analysetechnieken betere beslissingen mogelijk te maken? En wil jij bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van data- en AI-gedreven werken binnen Nederlandse Loterij? Kom dan in beweging en versterk Nederlandse Loterij als Data & Analytics Specialist.


Jouw speelveld

Nederlandse Loterij is georganiseerd in drie bedrijfseenheden: Loterijen, TOTO en New Business. Binnen Business Intelligence werken we aan de volgende stap in datagedreven besluitvorming. Naast het leveren van betrouwbare inzichten en dashboards, bouwen we ook voorspelmodellen, experimenteren met AI-oplossingen en ontwikkelen nieuwe manieren om de business slimmer te ondersteunen.


Je werkt op het snijvlak van business, data analytics en data science. Je schakelt met Marketing, Product, Retail en Business Control en krijgt de ruimte om niet alleen vragen te beantwoorden, maar ook zelf nieuwe kansen te signaleren.


Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen er beter onderbouwde strategische en operationele keuzes gemaakt worden. Je combineert scherpe analyses met voorspellende modellen en moderne AI-technieken om complexe businessvraagstukken te vertalen naar concrete inzichten en aanbevelingen. Je werkt met SQL en Python op ons datawarehouse en lakehouse in Databricks en benut, waar relevant, externe databronnen en nieuwe AI-toepassingen. Zo bouw je mee aan de volgende generatie datagedreven besluitvorming binnen Nederlandse Loterij.


Je scoort in deze rol door:

  • complexe businessvraagstukken te vertalen naar slimme analysevraagstukken;
  • analyses uit te voeren die verder gaan dan beschrijvende rapportages;
  • samen met collega's AI-toepassingen te onderzoeken en toe te passen, bijvoorbeeld met LLM's, Agentic AI of adaptive AI;
  • nieuwe en/of geavanceerde analysetechnieken actief naar het team te brengen;
  • collega’s te stimuleren om meer datagedreven te werken.


Je wordt onderdeel van een ambitieus Business Intelligence team dat volop in ontwikkeling is. We combineren klassieke BI met advanced analytics en AI. We geloven dat de grootste impact ontstaat wanneer analyses, voorspelmodellen en AI-oplossingen samenkomen in de dagelijkse besluitvorming.


Samen werken, samen winnen

Nederlandse Loterij is dé betrouwbare kansspelorganisatie van Nederland met acht sterke spelmerken. We zijn marktleider, expert en staan voor verantwoord, eerlijk en veilig spelen. Bijna alles wat we verdienen dragen we af voor een gelukkig, gezond en sportief Nederland. Naast een kansspelorganisatie met een maatschappelijke insteek zijn we een werkgever. Binnen onze organisatie werken we samen met ruim 500 toptalenten.


Door samen te werken en samen te winnen, is er altijd reden om te juichen. Binnen het Business Intelligence team helpen we elkaar presteren en gaan we niet voor het eigen succes. Onze verschillen maken ons samen sterk. Sport verbindt ons.


Jouw talent

De mensen die bij Nederlandse Loterij werken zijn nieuwsgierig, ondernemend en continu in ontwikkeling.


Jouw talent is een optelsom van:

  • een afgeronde wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Data Science, Econometrie, Wiskunde, Artificial Intelligence of een vergelijkbare richting;
  • minimaal 3 jaar ervaring binnen advanced analytics, business intelligence, data science of een vergelijkbare sterke analytische rol;
  • uitstekende kennis van SQL en ervaring met Python/PySpark voor complexe analyses en voorspelmodellen;
  • ervaring met Databricks;
  • ervaring met statistische analyses, voorspellende modellen of experimentatie (zoals A/B-testen);
  • ervaring met DBT is een pré;
  • ervaring met BI-tools zoals Qlik Sense is een pré. Geen eis;
  • affiniteit met of ervaring in een adviserende rol, waarbij je complexe analyses vertaalt naar heldere inzichten voor de business;
  • nieuwsgierigheid naar de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen AI en de motivatie om deze praktisch toe te passen. Ervaring met generatieve AI, agentic AI of andere moderne AI-toepassingen is een pré.


Daarnaast beschik je over sterke analytische vaardigheden, ben je kritisch op de kwaliteit van data en analyses en vind je het leuk om nieuwe technieken te verkennen. Je durft bestaande werkwijzen uit te dagen en helpt collega's om data én AI slimmer in te zetten.


Jouw score

Als Data & Analytics Specialist bieden we jou:

  • een salaris dat ligt tussen €4.900,- en €6.800,- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring
  • een interessante bonusregeling
  • een functie voor 32 - 40 uur per week
  • Voor €3,25 geniet je van een gezonde en gevarieerde lunch in ons bedrijfsrestaurant


Ons kantoor in Rijswijk is in principe de plek waar jij je werk doet, maar je werkt vooral op een plek die het beste past bij wat je doet. Bekijk hieronder welke arbeidsvoorwaarden jij nog meer kan verwachten. Vragen over de vacature? Neem gerust contact op met Rani Adjodhia, Corporate Recruiter bij Nederlandse Loterij via rani.adjodhia@nederlandseloterij.nl.

Title: Senior Data & AI Analyst
Description:
About the Role

The Senior Analyst works in the Data & Analytics Team, focusing primarily on Central Europe (Germany, the Netherlands, Austria and Denmark) initially, but with the expectation to support other countries when required. The role supports the delivery of asset business plan targets and the execution of strategies for achieving operational excellence by generating and analysing reports on property management performance. The role gathers and analyses market, client and portfolio data, giving management the input needed to identify opportunities to improve NOI, wider commercial performance and customer satisfaction. It also carries out other analytical tasks that support the running of the business. This role will be expected to work closely with the Central Europe Operational and Asset Management teams on a day-to-day basis, with direction also being provided by the Central Europe Senior Management Team.




Key Responsibilities

Supports the Data & Analytics team by developing consistent, accurate KPIs and reports for relevant stakeholders.
Supports the Central Europe Operational Management Team across a range of financial and data analysis activities.
Supports the delivery of the Data & Analytics team’s reporting requirements to meet both internal routines (e.g. weekly reporting) and external needs (investor, client and similar). This includes running the leasing reporting process to track and analyse leasing and occupancy performance and trends, and to highlight opportunities for rental growth or corrective marketing activity.
Supports the property and regional managers, Operations Directors, Asset Management and Client Services teams, and other business leaders by fielding questions and requests, gathering data and reports, and helping to resolve issues relating to operational policies and performance.
Acts as SME for AI within the region, driving adoption of a range of AI tools and products such as Claude.
Works with other functions (Digital/Performance, Asset Marketing and Brand/Insights) to track key performance indicators, provide regular, consistent reporting to the business, and connect the insights and analysis gathered by other departments with operational execution.
Gathers and analyses financial, market and other data to assess the performance of assigned portfolios against budgets, targets and client expectations, and prepares summaries, reports and recommendations to support business decisions.
Participates in project teams to implement process improvements and new applications and programmes aimed at improving operational performance.
Builds an effective working relationship between the Data & Analytics team and the IT/Systems team to ensure the smooth provision of data.
Supports requirements gathering for systems projects, along with testing and ongoing systems optimisation.
Supports annual rent and budget-setting processes, new acquisition due diligence, and other reports, analyses and tasks as needed.
Works with other Data & Analytics team members to identify improvements to the systems and tools used to understand, monitor and track performance.
Contributes to new acquisitions (due diligence and operational data for underwriting) and supports their execution (asset openings).
Supports periodic service-cost reporting and the annual price versus allowance analysis.
Supports FF&E and other service-charge-related administration.




About You

You’re a data and analytics professional who knows how to turn complex data into meaningful business insight. Confident with Power BI, SQL and Python, you’re experienced working with data lakes, warehouses, and large datasets, building scalable reporting that supports better decision-making.

You combine strong technical expertise with a commercial mindset, translating business needs into practical solutions and explaining complex concepts in a way everyone can understand. Organised, collaborative, and naturally curious, you thrive in fast-paced environments, embrace new technologies including AI, and enjoy solving problems that make a real impact.




What We Offer

We include a range of benefits for our corporate team members, including competitive pension, healthcare, and holiday allowance, amongst others as standard. Please reach out if you are keen to know more.




About Greystar

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated real estate company offering expertise in investment management, development, and management of rental housing properties globally. The company's business model is unique in its ability to own, operate, and develop multifamily, student, and senior housing across the globe. Building a global platform with a local presence, Greystar continues to expand its geographic reach around the world, bringing a globally interconnected professional rental housing platform and industry funded with institutional capital to countries where the sector does not yet exist. Greystar’s pan – European platform was established in 2013 and has scaled rapidly, now with investment, operational and development presence in the UK, Ireland, France, the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, and Spain.




One of Greystar’s core values is Equality, and as such, we continue to pride ourselves on being an equal opportunities employer, accounting for all protected and identifiable characteristics. We truly value diversity of thought, background and of experience. Please reach out to the Talent Acquisition team to explore opportunities at Greystar in more detail or visit our careers site at https://jobs.greystar.com/.

Title: Senior Data Analyst Advertising
Description:
How do you help bol make better decisions?

Bol.com continuously advances its platform to create a better tomorrow for over 13 million customers and 50,000+ trading partners. Our advertising business plays an increasingly important role in that ambition — and increasingly, so does the clarity with which we can explain how it's performing. As a Senior Data Analyst, you're the person leadership and key stakeholders turn to when they need to understand not just what the numbers say, but what to do about it.

The biggest challenge

Advertising via bol keeps growing, and so does the complexity of explaining why. Revenue moves, but the story behind the movement often doesn't move with it. Is display underperforming, or is the market shifting? Is a driver structural, or a one-off? As a senior analyst you own that story end-to-end: framing the right question, building the analysis that answers it, and staying in the room until the answer actually changes how the business acts. AI is fast taking over the repetitive parts of this work like dashboarding or descriptive questions, freeing you to spend more time on the analysis and the room, not less.

What you'll do as a Senior Data Analyst – Business Analytics

You'll join 20+ analysts in bol's Advertising Analytics team, working closely with internal stakeholders — Leadership, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Business Development. Within the Business Analytics sub-team, we aim to be the steering model of the advertising via bol department. We shape the strategy, explain performance and guide execution of core initiatives.

In practice:


Own analyses end-to-end: from framing an ambiguous business question with a stakeholder to shipping the analysis and staying involved until it changes a decision
Build and maintain driver trees and financial narratives that explain how advertising revenue moves, and why
Dive deep into the performance of our advertising propositions, developing domain expertise stakeholders come to rely on
Apply causal inference, statistical, or econometric methods where correlation isn't good enough — and recognize when it isn't needed
Use AI to eliminate the low-value repetitive parts of your work, and reinvest that time into deeper analysis and stakeholder engagement
Coach junior analysts on problem framing, technical craft, and operating as a genuine analytical partner rather than an order-taker
Write clean, reusable SQL and Python that scales and solves genuine problems


Why you can make a difference

You have 4+ years of hands-on analytics experience, SQL and Python are second nature, and you know how to turn a messy question into a shipped answer. Here's the thing: we're looking for a rounded profile. Some analysts are tech-savy; comfortable with causal inference, econometrics and our full tech stack. Others are strongest on the domain and ownership side: real retail media domain knowledge, end-to-end ownership, staying until insights actually land, coaching junior analysts, and using AI to buy back capacity for higher-value work. You can have a spike on one of them, but we want a minimum level for both.

Where you'll be working

You'll join an international group of 20+ analytics professionals in bol's Advertising Analytics team, working with key stakeholders across leadership, finance, sales, marketing and business development. You will be part of the Business Analytics team. We are the internal-facing arm. You won’t talk to advertisers directly, but you will collaborate with colleagues that decide where our advertising business will go next. Your goal is to help our Retail Media business make sharper decisions. You'll find a mix of colleagues that share a low tolerance for dashboard-and-move-on work: everyone here is expected to own the question, not just answer it. We all bring something special to the table and expect the same of you.

Something for you?


Story finder: You don't stop at "revenue is down." You keep digging until you can say why, and what to do about it.
Insight activator: Your definition of done isn't a dashboard or a deck. It's the moment a stakeholder makes a better decision because of something you surfaced.
Driven mentor: You make the analysts around you sharper. Not by telling them what to do, but by teaching them how to think.


Nothing for you?


Dashboard deliverer: You've built some visually stunning dashboards in your career. Which is how you measure their impact.
Lone analyst: Stakeholder management distracts from the real work. You'd rather just interact with data.
Comfort zone cartographer: You've mastered a solid analytics stack and see no compelling reason to stretch into causal thinking or deeper stakeholder ownership.


We take pride in our B Corp certification and strive for continuous improvement every day. Our annual bonus is tied to sustainability goals, and we are committed to equality and equal opportunities for all.Perks of having a blue heart


29 days: to recharge
Travel costs: Public transport, car, parking & charging covered
Pension plan: 75% premium covered
Annual bonus: Based on sustainability goals

You analyze data such as support tickets and release data to identify patterns, anomalies, and underlying causes.
You combine quantitative data with input from technicians and service teams to build a complete picture.
You sit with colleagues to understand their questions and help translate them into meaningful insights.
You turn insights into concrete improvements and support the team in applying them in their daily work.
You work with data specialists and engineers to improve data quality and availability where needed.


Apply now

You enjoy turning data into insights that help others make better decisions. You have a strong drive to improve and know how to bring others along with your ideas, recommendations, and way of thinking. Title: Senior Data Analist
Description:
Wil jij impact maken op logistieke processen met data? Je zet statistische analyses en modellen in om patronen te doorgronden en vertaald inzichten om het management direct verder te helpen!




Als Logistiek Data Analist zorg je dat logistieke processen continu verbeteren op basis van data en inzichten. Je vertaalt complexe datasets naar heldere stuurinformatie en ondersteunt het management bij operationele en tactische beslissingen. Je werkt hierbij intensief samen met interne stakeholders zoals operationeel managers en teammanagers, en bent een belangrijke sparringpartner in de dagelijkse aansturing.




Jouw uitdaging

Je komt te werken in het team Data & Analytics Operations, een hecht team van 10 analisten en consultants; mensen die trots zijn op hun werk én op elkaars successen. Samen zorgen jullie dat de logistieke organisatie kan sturen op data. Je werkt aan vraagstukken zoals het optimaliseren van productiviteit, het verbeteren van processen en het ontwikkelen van dashboards en voorspellende inzichten.




Je duikt in data van onze logistiek en vertaalt wat je ziet naar verbeteringen die managers de volgende dag toepassen.
Je werkt nauw samen met operationeel managers en teammanagers om processen te verbeteren.
Je toetst data aan de praktijk op de werkvloer en borgt consistente stuurinformatie.
Je voert verdiepende analyses uit bij afwijkingen of optimalisatievraagstukken.




Jouw profiel

Je bent analytisch sterk en denkt in processen. Je weet data te vertalen naar heldere inzichten en neemt anderen daarin mee. Met jouw communicatieve vaardigheden maak je complexe informatie begrijpelijk voor verschillende doelgroepen.




WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in Business Analytics, Technische Bedrijfskunde of vergelijkbaar.
Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als data-analist of consultant binnen logistiek/operations
Aantoonbare ervaring met statistiek zoals regressieanalyse, forecasting of hypothesis testing
Je bent thuis in Power BI: van datamodel tot gebruiksvriendelijk dashboard (must).
Sterk in data-analyse, proces denken en het vertalen naar verbeteringen.
Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend.




Ons aanbod

Voor een data-professional is Royal FloraHolland een speeltuin: enorme datavolumes, real-time processen en directe impact op een dynamische sector. Je komt in een team met een positieve werksfeer, waar je direct meepraat over prioriteiten en waar veel ruimte is voor jouw goede ideeën.

Een bruto maandsalaris volgens de cao (o.b.v 38 uur per week) tussen € 4.938,42 en € 7.006,84
Laptop en telefoon of telefoonvergoeding.
27 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband met de mogelijkheid tot het bijkopen van 10 vakantiedagen op basis van fulltime.
Hybride werken waarbij je gemiddeld 2 dagen op locatie (in Naaldwijk of Aalsmeer) werkt.
Ontwikkel- en doorgroeimogelijkheden via onze Academy, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van LEAN (Six Sigma) en Agile werken;




Een online screening en referentie check maken deel uit van het sollicitatieproces, net als de aanvraag van een verklaring omtrent gedrag (VOG).




Werk je bij een bureau en wil je een kandidaat voorstellen voor deze vacature bij Royal FloraHolland? Bedankt, maar hier gaan we niet op in. We werven onze nieuwe collega graag zelf.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Hardware Automation)
Description:
About Nebius

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

The Hardware Infrastructure Automation team at Nebius operates at the intersection of physical infrastructure and intelligent software systems. We build the data layer that drives automation and operational decisions for our global hardware fleet.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who can work end-to-end — from data modelling and pipeline engineering to dashboards and business recommendations. You will be a full owner of analytical projects: defining the problem, building the solution, and driving adoption with stakeholders.

You will work closely with SWE, SRE, and frontend teams to surface insights that directly influence how we scale and automate our infrastructure. If you are equally comfortable writing Python and SQL as you are presenting findings to leadership, this role is for you.

Your Responsibilities Will Include


End-to-end project ownership. Lead analytical projects independently from scoping and data modelling through to delivery and iteration. Define success metrics, manage timelines, and communicate progress without supervision.
Data engineering. Build and maintain reliable data pipelines using Python and SQL. Validate sources, monitor data quality, improve freshness, and ensure models are well-documented and reusable by the team.
Dashboard development. Design and implement dashboards that give SWE, SRE, and frontend teams clear visibility into fleet health, utilisation, capacity, and automation coverage. Own dashboard quality and iteratively improve based on user feedback.
Infrastructure analytics. Analyse large-scale hardware telemetry and operational data to identify bottlenecks, anomalies, and optimisation opportunities. Translate complex infrastructure signals into clear, actionable recommendations.
Automation insight. Support the team's automation roadmap by quantifying the impact of automation initiatives, identifying gaps in coverage, and modelling scenarios that inform prioritisation.
Stakeholder collaboration. Work directly with HW RnD, IT Operations, DC Operations, Logistics, and other teams to clarify requirements, align on metrics, and present results in a way that supports engineering decisions — not just "interesting numbers".
Analytical best practices. Raise the standard of analytical work in the team through documentation, metric definitions, code reviews, and mentoring less experienced colleagues where relevant.


We Expect You To Have


Significant experience as a Data Analyst, Senior Data Analyst, or in a similar role with strong technical ownership.
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL — you write clean, production-quality code, not just scripts.
Proven experience building and maintaining dashboards used by engineering or operations teams.
Experience owning analytical projects end-to-end: from data modelling and pipeline development through to stakeholder delivery.
Solid grounding in statistics and analytical thinking, including descriptive analytics, hypothesis testing, and regression fundamentals.
Strong attention to data quality, including validating definitions, identifying inconsistencies, and implementing monitoring.
Comfort working with large, complex, and sometimes ambiguous datasets — including telemetry, logs, or operational data.
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.
Strong problem-solving skills — you break down ambiguous questions, form hypotheses, and identify practical next steps independently.
Working knowledge of spoken and written English.


It Will Be An Added Bonus If You Have


Experience with hardware infrastructure, data centre operations, or cloud infrastructure analytics.
Familiarity with modern data stacks such as dbt, Airflow, BigQuery, Snowflake, or PostgreSQL.
Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or Superset.
Background in automation analytics, capacity planning, or fleet management.
Experience mentoring other analysts or contributing to team standards and documentation.


Benefits & Perks


Competitive compensation
Career growth and learning opportunities
Flexibility and ownership
Collaborative and innovative culture
Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
International environment and talented teams


What's It Like To Work At Nebius

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

Businessvragen vertalen naar analyses, KPI's en datavereisten.
Data verzamelen, transformeren en modelleren vanuit verschillende bronnen.
Dashboards, rapportages en dataproducten ontwikkelen die gebruikt worden in de besluitvorming.
Inzichten vertalen naar concrete aanbevelingen voor stakeholders en management.
Datakwaliteit, governance en betrouwbaarheid helpen bewaken.

Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons dataplatform, analytics capabilities en AI-toepassingen.

Herken jij jezelf in deze functie en krijg je energie van het werken met data, inzichten en businessvraagstukken? Dan komen we graag met je in contact.

Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau.

Ervaring met datavisualisatie en dashboardontwikkeling in Power BI.
Ervaring met SQL voor datatransformatie, datamodellering en analyses.
Het vermogen om complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar businesstaal met heldere inzichten en concrete aanbevelingen.
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om stakeholders mee te nemen in jouw adviezen.
Een proactieve houding, eigenaarschap en nieuwsgierigheid om continu te leren.

Ervaring met een moderne cloud dataomgeving.

Veel vrijheid, eigenaarschap en verantwoordelijkheid.

Samenwerking met ervaren data professionals in Nederland en België.
Ruimte voor ontwikkeling op het gebied van analytics, AI en dataproductontwikkeling

Title: Medior Data Analist FEC Investigations
Description:
In het kort

Wij zijn op zoek naar een data analist bij FEC Investigations binnen de afdeling Innovation, Design and Change (ID&C). Als data analist speur je binnen grootschalige, data-gedreven thematische onderzoeken naar criminele financiële geldstromen en onbekende patronen. Je werkt samen met een team van financiële economische criminaliteit (FEC) experts om risico’s met betrekking tot financiële criminaliteit te identificeren, en hebt zichtbare maatschappelijke impact. Benieuwd naar deze boeiende rol? Lees dan verder.

Je werk

Als data-analist binnen FEC Investigations onderzoek je klantintegriteitsrisico's zoals witwassen en sanctieomzeiling. Je werkt projectmatig aan diverse thema’s, variërend van risicovolle sectoren tot specifieke witwasmethoden. Samen met investigators en FEC-experts bepaal je welke data en analyses nodig zijn. Jij analyseert grote datasets, vertaalt dit tot waardevolle inzichten en doet voorstellen voor aanvullende analyses. Je rapporteert de resultaten helder en visueel aan stakeholders, waarmee risico’s van de populatie binnen het onderzoeksthema worden geïdentificeerd.

Naast het uitvoeren van onderzoeken zijn onze data analisten altijd bezig met het onderzoeken van manieren om meer informatie uit de beschikbare data te halen. We ontwikkelen innovatieve analysemethodes om financiële criminaliteit op te sporen en opvallend gedrag vroegtijdig te signaleren. Hierbij maken we gebruik van geavanceerde technieken op het gebied van data science, die we testen in exploratieve onderzoeken. Daarnaast werken we met het FEC Intelligence team aan datagedreven methodes om inzichten te halen uit interne en externe intelligence-signalen, die tot nieuwe projecten kunnen leiden. Hierbij wordt onder andere gebruik gemaakt van NLP-technieken, trenddetectie en dashboarding. Ook werk je intensief samen met andere datateams om tot gezamenlijke definities te komen. Hierbij deel je je kennis en gebruik van de data en analysemethoden uit de FEC Investigations onderzoeken.

Concreet ben je verantwoordelijk voor het:


Verwerken van ruwe big data tot bruikbare informatie en heldere rapportages.
Waarborgen van de kwaliteit en juiste interpretatie van de verwerkte data en het verwerven van de hiervoor nodige kennis.
Kritisch evalueren van resultaten en aandragen van aanvullende analyses.
Onderzoeken hoe meer informatie uit beschikbare data te halen is en voorstellen doen om deze data verder te verrijken.
Samen met de investigator(s): waarborgen van de algemene kwaliteit en bewaken van de tijdslijnen van je projecten.
Kennis delen van (de interpretatie van) nieuwe databronnen en nieuw ontwikkelde data-analyses zowel met collega’s binnen FEC Investigations als met andere datateams.
Afstemmen van het gebruik van databronnen en definities met stakeholders binnen ABN AMRO.



Werkomgeving

In een snel veranderende wereld waarin wet- en regelgeving voortdurend veranderen en criminelen steeds nieuwe methoden bedenken, streeft ABN AMRO binnen de afdeling Detecting Financial Crime (DFC) naar een duurzaam financieel systeem. Wij zijn toegewijd aan het opsporen van financiële economische criminaliteit (FEC) en het bouwen aan een innovatieve en expertise-gedreven organisatie.

DFC bestaat uit verschillende units die hierin samenwerken. Binnen de unit ID&C bevindt zich FEC Investigations, een team dat zich voornamelijk richt op het identificeren van (nieuwe) FEC-risico’s. FEC Investigations werkt intensief samen met FEC Intelligence en biedt daarnaast ondersteuning aan verdiepende (klant)onderzoeken en dataverzoeken vanuit andere DFC-teams. Om de risico’s die binnen de onderzoeken van FEC Investigations worden geïdentificeerd te mitigeren werken we samen met andere units binnen DFC en in de rest van de organisatie.

FEC Investigations werkt vanuit Amersfoort en bestaat uit 20 gepassioneerde professionals met uiteenlopende achtergronden. De ene helft van het team bestaat uit data analisten, de andere helft uit investigators, experts op het gebied van financiële economische criminaliteit.

Je profiel

Ben je klaar voor deze uitdaging? Check je profiel:


Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring op WO/HBO niveau met data-analyse in programmeertalen zoals SQL en Python .
Bekend met statistische technieken en methodes om complexe datasets te analyseren .
Een afgeronde, kwantitatief georiënteerde opleiding (WO/HBO), zoals (bedrijfs)wiskunde, natuurkunde, econometrie, bioinformatica of data science.
Je bezit sterke schriftelijke en mondelinge communicatievaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels.
Je bent ondernemend, nieuwsgierig en werkt graag zelfstandig binnen een hechte samenwerking.
Je hebt interesse in de inhoudelijke aspecten van de functie en bent intrinsiek gemotiveerd om criminele geldstromen bloot te leggen.



Wij bieden

Het is voor ons belangrijk om een goede werkgever te zijn. Wij bieden je daarom een functie met impact en uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden die bijdragen aan jouw werkplezier, ontwikkeling en wellbeing.

Daarnaast bieden wij:


Een aantrekkelijk bruto maandsalaris op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Dit is inclusief vakantiegeld en een flexibel benefit budget.
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling, zodat je goed voorbereid bent voor later.
Flexibiliteit in werken: thuiswerken is mogelijk in overleg met je team en afhankelijk van je functie. Wij regelen een ergonomische thuiswerkplek voor je.
Ruimte voor ontspanning met vijf weken vakantie per jaar, aangevuld met twee verplichte vrije dagen. Daarnaast kun je jaarlijks tot vier extra weken vakantie bijkopen.
Vijf ‘Banking for better days’: extra vrije dagen die je kunt inzetten voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling of vrijwilligerswerk.
Persoonlijke ontwikkeling staat centraal: je ontvangt een ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 per jaar,dat je kunt opsparen tot €3.000.
Een OV-jaarabonnement met gratis openbaar vervoer in heel Nederland voor zakelijk en privégebruik.



Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en salarisschalen vind je in onze cao die van toepassing is op deze vacature.

Bij ABN AMRO geloven we in "Banking for better, for generations to come." Gelijke kansen voor iedereen vormen een belangrijk fundament, waarbij we streven naar een inclusieve cultuur waarin alle medewerkers zich gezien, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelen. Onze visie als persoonlijke bank in de digitale tijd sluit naadloos aan bij de behoefte aan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen, voortkomend uit een divers samenspel van culturen en ervaringen. We richten ons op klantbeleving, duurzaamheid en bouwen aan een toekomstbestendige bank, waarbij we gelijke beloning voor gelijk werk jaarlijks onderzoeken om eerlijke kansen te waarborgen. Sluit je aan bij een bank die vindingrijkheid en ambitie omarmt, en maak samen met ons impact voor een betere toekomst.

HTML:
Vragen stellen die niemand durft. Antwoorden geven die iedereen nodig heeft. Dat is wat een goede data analist doet en bij JEX doe je dat op het snijvlak van AI, marketing en operaties. Geen rapport dat in een la verdwijnt. Echte impact, elke dag.

Het datateam bij JEX werkt dwars door de hele organisatie. De ene week duik je in marketingcampagnes en platformdata, de andere week bouw je koppelingen tussen AI-tools en interne systemen. Je werkt aan alle stappen in het data proces, van transformatie tot dashboarding in Looker en van analyse tot discussies met je stakeholder.

Je combineert technische kennis met sterke communicatie. Je achterhaalt snel de vraag achter de vraag en zorgt voor een sterke start van ieder project.

Dit vind jij leuk om te doen:

  • Bouwen en onderhouden van datapipelines met DBT en SQL;
  • Analyseren van data dwars door de organisatie: van marketingcampagnes en platformgedrag tot procesoptimalisatie en AI-output;
  • Checken en optimaliseren van AI-gedreven e-mailcampagnes;
  • Het ontwikkelen van koppelingen tussen onze verschillende systemen;
  • Vertalen van ruwe data naar inzichten waar iedereen iets mee kan, van manager tot support medewerker;
  • Meedenken over automatiseringen die tijd besparen en fouten voorkomen.


Hier herken jij jezelf in:

  • Je hebt minimaal twee jaar aantoonbare ervaring, in werk of projecten;
  • SQL, DBT en BigQuery ken je, of je pikt het razendsnel op;
  • Ervaring met visualisatie tools zoals Looker, PowerBI of vergelijkbare tooling is een pre;
  • Je doet er alles aan om vraagstukken zelfstandig op te lossen voordat je om hulp vraagt. Eigenaarschap is geen buzzword voor jou;
  • Stakeholdermanagement? Je stapt gemakkelijk op mensen af, stelt de juiste vragen en weet wanneer je moet doorvragen. Wachten tot iemand naar jou komt? Dat is niet jouw stijl;


Wat biedt JEX:

Bij JEX krijg je de kans om jezelf continu uit te dagen en te ontwikkelen. Daarnaast mag je ook minimaal onderstaande van ons verwachten:

  • Een salaris tussen de €3.600 en €4.600 (o.b.v. je ervaring, skills en potentie);
  • Een riante optieregeling;
  • Een passende mobiliteitsvergoeding;
  • 30 vakantiedagen o.b.v. 40 uur en 8% vakantiegeld;
  • Een premievrije pensioenregeling;
  • Inwisselbare feestdagen en de optie om extra vrije dagen bij te kopen of te verkopen;
  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak;
  • Elke dag ontbijt, uitgebreide lunch en onbeperkt fruit, snacks en fris;
  • Een gym en gebedsruimte in ons prachtige kantoor;
  • Hele toffe events op interne én externe locaties;
  • Een inhouse skybar waar we de gezelligste borrels hebben;
  • Diverse opleidingsmogelijkheden, wij moedigen je aan om de beste versie van jezelf te worden.


Hier kom je terecht:

Bij JEX geloven we dat technologiebedrijven vooruit moet brengen. Slimmer werken, sneller groeien en meer focus op wat écht telt. Met toegankelijke tech- en AI-oplossingen automatiseren we complexe en tijdrovende processen voor B2B-organisaties.

Enthousiast?

Dat snappen we! Deel je cv en motivatie en krijg binnen twee werkdagen na je sollicitatie bericht van ons. We zijn erg benieuwd naar wat jou bijzonder maakt.

Title: Sr. Healthcare Data Analyst (Medicaid)
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Healthcare Data Analyst (Medicaid) based in Netherlands.

This is a senior data analytics opportunity focused on using healthcare data to strengthen Medicaid program oversight.

You will analyze large and complex datasets to identify patterns, vulnerabilities, and potential areas of fraud, waste, and abuse.

The role combines advanced analytics, Medicaid policy knowledge, research, and data visualization to turn complex information into actionable insights.

You’ll work closely with technical teams and leadership to investigate challenging questions and develop practical analytical solutions.

Your findings will help inform decisions with meaningful implications for program integrity and public-sector healthcare outcomes.

The environment values collaboration, critical thinking, clear communication, and the ability to work independently on complex problems.

This role offers the opportunity to apply your healthcare data expertise to mission-driven work with tangible societal impact.

Accountabilities


Perform advanced analysis, interpretation, and reporting of Medicaid data, developing methodologies and analytical approaches that support program oversight.
Analyze large datasets to identify meaningful patterns, trends, anomalies, vulnerabilities, and high-risk areas within the Medicaid program.
Conduct research combining Medicaid policy knowledge with detailed claims analysis to investigate potential fraud, waste, abuse, and other program integrity concerns.
Develop analytical rules, methodologies, and solutions that translate complex healthcare data into actionable insights.
Apply exploratory research and critical thinking to understand program requirements and determine how data can inform decision-making.
Build compelling data visualizations, dashboards, and reports that communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Present analytical conclusions and recommendations through written, verbal, and visual communication.
Collaborate proactively with leadership and multidisciplinary team members to identify solutions to complex analytical challenges.
Contribute to data-driven approaches that support the detection and prevention of fraud, waste, and abuse across Medicaid programs.


Requirements


Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline and 5+ years of professional experience conducting advanced analysis of Medicaid data.
Strong hands-on experience with T-MSIS data and demonstrated expertise analyzing Medicaid datasets.
Proficiency with SQL, Python, Tableau, Databricks, Snowflake, or comparable data analytics, reporting, dashboarding, and visualization technologies.
Proven ability to work efficiently with large and complex datasets and uncover actionable patterns and trends.
Experience developing advanced analytical solutions that address business or program challenges through a strong understanding of Medicaid policy.
Demonstrated experience creating analytics and visualization solutions designed to identify and help prevent healthcare fraud, waste, and abuse.
Strong statistical analysis, research, data interpretation, and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear recommendations for audiences with varying levels of technical expertise.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting findings to stakeholders and leadership.
Strong collaboration skills combined with the ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and take ownership of complex analytical assignments.
Ability to obtain and maintain the required NACI (Tier 1) public trust designation.
Willingness to work remotely with limited travel, expected to be less than 10%.


Benefits


Competitive estimated salary range of $106,250–$143,750 USD annually, with final compensation based on experience, location, and applicable contractual considerations.
Fully remote work environment.
Full-time schedule of approximately 40 hours per week.
Medical plan options, including plans with Health Savings Accounts.
Dental and vision insurance options.
401(k) retirement plan with company matching and pre-tax/post-tax contribution options.
Flexible work arrangements and full-flex work weeks where applicable.
Paid vacation, sick, personal, and holiday leave.
Typically 15 days of paid leave per calendar year for new employees, plus 10 paid holidays, subject to applicable prorating.
Paid parental leave, including up to 160 hours of paid family leave during a rolling 12-month period for eligible employees.
Military, bereavement, and jury duty leave.
Short- and long-term disability coverage and life insurance options.
Accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness, and business travel and accident insurance offerings.
Opportunity to contribute to mission-driven healthcare analytics and public-sector program integrity initiatives.
Professional growth through work involving advanced data analytics, visualization, and large-scale healthcare datasets.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

Title: ESG Data Analyst
Description:
EMEA Recruitment are exclusively partnered with an international business in their search for an ESG Data Analyst to join the team.




This is a key analytical role supporting the development of high-quality, consistent and audit-ready ESG reporting across a complex international industrial organisation. You will sit at the intersection of sustainability, data and operations, helping strengthen ESG governance while ensuring reporting meets evolving CSRD and ESRS requirements.




Please note this role involves weekly travel.




Key Responsibilities for ESG Data Analyst

Consolidate and manage ESG data across multiple international operational sites, ensuring consistency, accuracy and compliance with CSRD and ESRS requirements.
Develop and improve ESG data collection frameworks, templates, dashboards and reporting tools to create efficient and reliable processes.
Review and validate ESG datasets, identifying gaps, inconsistencies and data-quality issues to ensure information is accurate and audit-ready.
Maintain strong data governance processes, including data controls, adjustments, documentation and traceability for assurance purposes.
Analyse ESG performance through benchmarking, trend analysis and gap assessments, providing insights to support continuous improvement.
Partner with sustainability, operations and other key stakeholders to align ESG metrics with business plans, budgets and long-term sustainability targets, including decarbonisation initiatives.
Support stakeholders with ESG reporting requirements, tools and data-quality standards, providing training and clear communication as reporting expectations evolve.




Experience Required

Around 3-5 years’ experience working with sustainability information, ESG reporting, non-financial data or a related analytical discipline.
Relevant degree-level education within sustainability, environmental studies, analytics, finance or another quantitative/business-related field.
Good understanding of European sustainability reporting requirements and the evolving regulatory landscape, with practical exposure to ESG reporting standards.
Experience working with complex datasets, including checking data integrity, investigating inconsistencies and preparing information for internal or external review.
Strong analytical capability with advanced Excel skills and experience using visualisation, reporting or database tools such as Power BI or SQL.
Comfortable improving data processes and reporting workflows, including introducing greater structure, consistency and automation across multiple data sources.
Strong English communication skills and confidence working across different functions and international teams; additional European languages are beneficial (Dutch, French, German).

Title: Senior Data & AI Analyst
Description:
About the Role

The Senior Analyst works in the Data & Analytics Team, focusing primarily on Central Europe (Germany, the Netherlands, Austria and Denmark) initially, but with the expectation to support other countries when required. The role supports the delivery of asset business plan targets and the execution of strategies for achieving operational excellence by generating and analysing reports on property management performance. The role gathers and analyses market, client and portfolio data, giving management the input needed to identify opportunities to improve NOI, wider commercial performance and customer satisfaction. It also carries out other analytical tasks that support the running of the business. This role will be expected to work closely with the Central Europe Operational and Asset Management teams on a day-to-day basis, with direction also being provided by the Central Europe Senior Management Team.




Key Responsibilities

Supports the Data & Analytics team by developing consistent, accurate KPIs and reports for relevant stakeholders.
Supports the Central Europe Operational Management Team across a range of financial and data analysis activities.
Supports the delivery of the Data & Analytics team’s reporting requirements to meet both internal routines (e.g. weekly reporting) and external needs (investor, client and similar). This includes running the leasing reporting process to track and analyse leasing and occupancy performance and trends, and to highlight opportunities for rental growth or corrective marketing activity.
Supports the property and regional managers, Operations Directors, Asset Management and Client Services teams, and other business leaders by fielding questions and requests, gathering data and reports, and helping to resolve issues relating to operational policies and performance.
Acts as SME for AI within the region, driving adoption of a range of AI tools and products such as Claude.
Works with other functions (Digital/Performance, Asset Marketing and Brand/Insights) to track key performance indicators, provide regular, consistent reporting to the business, and connect the insights and analysis gathered by other departments with operational execution.
Gathers and analyses financial, market and other data to assess the performance of assigned portfolios against budgets, targets and client expectations, and prepares summaries, reports and recommendations to support business decisions.
Participates in project teams to implement process improvements and new applications and programmes aimed at improving operational performance.
Builds an effective working relationship between the Data & Analytics team and the IT/Systems team to ensure the smooth provision of data.
Supports requirements gathering for systems projects, along with testing and ongoing systems optimisation.
Supports annual rent and budget-setting processes, new acquisition due diligence, and other reports, analyses and tasks as needed.
Works with other Data & Analytics team members to identify improvements to the systems and tools used to understand, monitor and track performance.
Contributes to new acquisitions (due diligence and operational data for underwriting) and supports their execution (asset openings).
Supports periodic service-cost reporting and the annual price versus allowance analysis.
Supports FF&E and other service-charge-related administration.




About You

You’re a data and analytics professional who knows how to turn complex data into meaningful business insight. Confident with Power BI, SQL and Python, you’re experienced working with data lakes, warehouses, and large datasets, building scalable reporting that supports better decision-making.

You combine strong technical expertise with a commercial mindset, translating business needs into practical solutions and explaining complex concepts in a way everyone can understand. Organised, collaborative, and naturally curious, you thrive in fast-paced environments, embrace new technologies including AI, and enjoy solving problems that make a real impact.




What We Offer

We include a range of benefits for our corporate team members, including competitive pension, healthcare, and holiday allowance, amongst others as standard. Please reach out if you are keen to know more.




About Greystar

Greystar is a leading, fully integrated real estate company offering expertise in investment management, development, and management of rental housing properties globally. The company's business model is unique in its ability to own, operate, and develop multifamily, student, and senior housing across the globe. Building a global platform with a local presence, Greystar continues to expand its geographic reach around the world, bringing a globally interconnected professional rental housing platform and industry funded with institutional capital to countries where the sector does not yet exist. Greystar’s pan – European platform was established in 2013 and has scaled rapidly, now with investment, operational and development presence in the UK, Ireland, France, the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, and Spain.




One of Greystar’s core values is Equality, and as such, we continue to pride ourselves on being an equal opportunities employer, accounting for all protected and identifiable characteristics. We truly value diversity of thought, background and of experience. Please reach out to the Talent Acquisition team to explore opportunities at Greystar in more detail or visit our careers site at https://jobs.greystar.com/.

Title: Data Analyst - Entry Level
Description:
At TCC Global, we create innovative loyalty marketing solutions that drive customer engagement and strengthen brand loyalty for some of the world’s leading retailers. Our passionate team delivers exceptional results through precision execution, strong client partnerships, and seamless operational processes.

As a Data Analyst within the Data & Analytics (D&A) department, you will sit in TCC’s client- and stakeholder-facing BI team. You will play a central role in proving TCC’s value proposition by measuring loyalty campaign ROI, analyzing the drivers of campaign performance, and translating findings into clear proof points and business insights that inform commercial and operational decisions. The role carries hands-on tasks across measurement, analysis, data pipeline building, and report development. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, and Operations to deliver insights, scale campaign measurement, support commercial proposals, and optimize campaign execution through in-store and digital channels. Working day-to-day with Power BI, Azure ML, and AI tooling, you will help shift the business toward democratized, AI-served insights — delivered faster, embedded with stakeholders, and closer to the decisions they support.

The role supports the BI function within the Data & Analytics department, with the following responsibilities:


Measure and analyze campaign performance and ROI; translate results into proof points that demonstrate TCC’s value proposition, in close collaboration with Marketing.
Deliver business analyses that support commercial proposals, client conversations, and internal de-cision-making across Commercial, Delivery, and Operations.
Respond to ad-hoc analysis requests from across the business — turning open-ended questions into structured analyses with clear, timely answers.
Build and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards.
Develop and optimize data pipelines on TCC’s data platform (Azure).
Contribute to the evolution of analytical and AI-served tools (including Enterprise AI / text2sql) that put insights directly in the hands of colleagues and clients.
Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate analysis, pipeline, and reporting work.
Support running solutions — monitor pipelines and reports in production, investigate issues, and contribute to iterative improvement.
Apply data governance standards in day-to-day work, ensuring trusted, well-documented outputs.
Participate in agile delivery ceremonies (planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) and share best practices across the team.



Must‑haves: 


1–2 years of experience in a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, or similar role, with hands-on experience in performance/campaign analysis and dashboard development;
Strong analytical and technical skills across SQL, Python, statistics, Power BI (including DAX/data modelling), and cloud-based data environments (preferably Azure);
Ability to turn complex data into actionable business insights and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders;
Comfortable working in agile, fast-paced environments, collaborating cross-functionally, and using AI-assisted tools to improve analysis and reporting workflows;
Fluent English.



Nice‑to‑haves:


Exposure to Azure AI Foundry and broader modern AI/data platforms;
Experience in retail, loyalty, marketing, or campaign analytics;
Additional language skills such as Dutch, Spanish, Portuguese, or German;
Strong curiosity for emerging AI tooling and continuous learning across the data and AI stack;
Practical experience with data pipelines, ELT/ETL processes, testing/data quality practices, and software engineering fundamentals such as Git and code reviews.



What we offer:


Competitive salary and annual bonus.
Opportunities for growth and professional development.
A dynamic and supportive work environment where your ideas truly matter.
Hybrid working model.



TCC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered without distinction of age, culture, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ethnicity, or disability status.

Description:
About FareHarbor

At FareHarbor, our mission is to make experiences better for everyone. Founded in 2013 in Hawaii and acquired by Booking Holdings in 2018, FareHarbor creates powerful tools that enable our clients (think boat rentals, museums, food tours, events and more!) to operate and grow.

FareHarbor Core Values


Think Client First
We Are One ‘Ohana
Be Curious and Learn
Own It.
Act With Integrity
Embrace the Challenge


Why FareHarbor?

Founding FareHarbor required unwavering passion. Turning a start-up into the world’s leading and largest reservation software for tours, activities, and attractions required relentless dedication and vision. To date, we’ve helped over 20,000 global businesses operate successfully and are proud to have played a role in enabling business owners to live their dreams.

And since day one, we’ve known that our real success lies in our people—the Ohana.

With each new feature launched and new client onboarded, there is a team of incredible people behind the scenes who are full of dedication, passion, energy, and the will to succeed. We encourage everyone to bring their whole selves to work—to believe in their abilities, to freely express their creativity, and to contribute with their own uniqueness by wearing their true colors. We take care of one another and always prioritize health and wellbeing. We give our people the space and trust to learn, to try, to succeed, to collaborate, to think outside of the box, to make mistakes, and even to fail. And then we come together to try again.

From the minute you join, you have a voice. You find your space. You make an impact. We celebrate our victories, shout our successes, and are always eager to tackle new challenges. And we can’t wait to see all that’s to come.

About The Role

The Lead Data Analyst serves as the analytical craft leader within the BI team, responsible for translating complex business problems into trusted data products, advanced analytics, and actionable recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes. This role partners closely with Product, Commercial, Finance & Strategy, and Data Engineering teams to identify opportunities, measure impact, and influence business decisions through data and insights.

You will help advance FareHarbor's analytics capabilities by leveraging modern analytics tools, automation, and AI-assisted workflows. As a senior individual contributor, you will drive analytical best practices, mentor analysts, and help shape how analytics is delivered, adopted, and operationalized across the organization.

This role reports to the Manager, Data Analytics within the global Business Intelligence team.

What You’ll Do Here


Partner with Product and Commercial stakeholders to translate business questions into analytical frameworks, trusted metrics, and actionable insights.
Design, build, and maintain scalable reporting, dashboards, and data products that support decision-making across the organization.
Proactively identify growth opportunities, operational inefficiencies, and emerging business risks through data analysis and insight generation.
Conduct advanced analyses, forecasting to drive measurable business outcomes across acquisition, upsell, retention, and product adoption.
Translate analytical findings into measurable actions by partnering with stakeholders to operationalize recommendations and track business impact.
Help improve self-service analytics capabilities by developing trusted datasets, documentation, and reporting frameworks.
Collaborate with Data Engineering to improve data quality, governance, accessibility, and reliability.
Create and apply AI-assisted analytics workflows and automation to increase analytical productivity, accelerate insight generation, and evaluate the quality and reliability of AI-generated outputs.
Drive analytical excellence through best practices in business metrics design, experimentation, reporting quality, and insight generation.
Mentor and support other analysts through knowledge sharing, code reviews, and analytical guidance.
Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and data-informed decision-making.


Requirements


5+ years of experience in data analytics , or a related quantitative field, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.
Strong experience working with commercial analytics. Experience in product analytics is a plus.
Advanced SQL expertise and strong proficiency in Python for analytics, modeling, and automation.
Strong experience with dbt to manage data workflows and pipelines and deploy analytics-ready datasets; GitLab experience.
Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar..
Familiarity with AI-assisted analytics workflows, automation, and natural language analytics tools.
Experience with statistical analysis, forecasting and business performance measurement. Experimentation is a plus.
Understanding of data modeling, dbt, semantic layers, and analytics engineering concepts.
Strong knowledge of metric design, reporting standards, and data governance principles.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
Strong problem-solving skills, business judgment, and a track record of delivering measurable impact.


This role is available to candidates located in the Netherlands and requires ability to work in a hybrid setup with in-office presence (3 days/week)..

Benefits


Global leave benefit
22 weeks paid parental leave
2 weeks paid grandparent leave
Extended care and bereavement leave
Life insurance policy
Pension Plan
Central Amsterdam Location
Discount CZ insurance
Working in a multicultural environment - 45 different nationalities
Commuting allowance for public transport & subsidized lunch
Wellness benefits (Headspace subscription & wellness webinars)
Hybrid friendly
Work-from-home assistance
Educational Opportunities
Social hours & events and team-building
26 vacation days per year

Title: Senior Data Analyst Advertising
Description:
How do you help bol make better decisions?

Bol.com continuously advances its platform to create a better tomorrow for over 13 million customers and 50,000+ trading partners. Our advertising business plays an increasingly important role in that ambition — and increasingly, so does the clarity with which we can explain how it's performing. As a Senior Data Analyst, you're the person leadership and key stakeholders turn to when they need to understand not just what the numbers say, but what to do about it.

The biggest challenge

Advertising via bol keeps growing, and so does the complexity of explaining why. Revenue moves, but the story behind the movement often doesn't move with it. Is display underperforming, or is the market shifting? Is a driver structural, or a one-off? As a senior analyst you own that story end-to-end: framing the right question, building the analysis that answers it, and staying in the room until the answer actually changes how the business acts. AI is fast taking over the repetitive parts of this work like dashboarding or descriptive questions, freeing you to spend more time on the analysis and the room, not less.

What you'll do as a Senior Data Analyst – Business Analytics

You'll join 20+ analysts in bol's Advertising Analytics team, working closely with internal stakeholders — Leadership, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Business Development. Within the Business Analytics sub-team, we aim to be the steering model of the advertising via bol department. We shape the strategy, explain performance and guide execution of core initiatives.

In practice:


Own analyses end-to-end: from framing an ambiguous business question with a stakeholder to shipping the analysis and staying involved until it changes a decision
Build and maintain driver trees and financial narratives that explain how advertising revenue moves, and why
Dive deep into the performance of our advertising propositions, developing domain expertise stakeholders come to rely on
Apply causal inference, statistical, or econometric methods where correlation isn't good enough — and recognize when it isn't needed
Use AI to eliminate the low-value repetitive parts of your work, and reinvest that time into deeper analysis and stakeholder engagement
Coach junior analysts on problem framing, technical craft, and operating as a genuine analytical partner rather than an order-taker
Write clean, reusable SQL and Python that scales and solves genuine problems


Why you can make a difference

You have 4+ years of hands-on analytics experience, SQL and Python are second nature, and you know how to turn a messy question into a shipped answer. Here's the thing: we're looking for a rounded profile. Some analysts are tech-savy; comfortable with causal inference, econometrics and our full tech stack. Others are strongest on the domain and ownership side: real retail media domain knowledge, end-to-end ownership, staying until insights actually land, coaching junior analysts, and using AI to buy back capacity for higher-value work. You can have a spike on one of them, but we want a minimum level for both.

Where you'll be working

You'll join an international group of 20+ analytics professionals in bol's Advertising Analytics team, working with key stakeholders across leadership, finance, sales, marketing and business development. You will be part of the Business Analytics team. We are the internal-facing arm. You won’t talk to advertisers directly, but you will collaborate with colleagues that decide where our advertising business will go next. Your goal is to help our Retail Media business make sharper decisions. You'll find a mix of colleagues that share a low tolerance for dashboard-and-move-on work: everyone here is expected to own the question, not just answer it. We all bring something special to the table and expect the same of you.

Something for you?


Story finder: You don't stop at "revenue is down." You keep digging until you can say why, and what to do about it.
Insight activator: Your definition of done isn't a dashboard or a deck. It's the moment a stakeholder makes a better decision because of something you surfaced.
Driven mentor: You make the analysts around you sharper. Not by telling them what to do, but by teaching them how to think.


Nothing for you?


Dashboard deliverer: You've built some visually stunning dashboards in your career. Which is how you measure their impact.
Lone analyst: Stakeholder management distracts from the real work. You'd rather just interact with data.
Comfort zone cartographer: You've mastered a solid analytics stack and see no compelling reason to stretch into causal thinking or deeper stakeholder ownership.


We take pride in our B Corp certification and strive for continuous improvement every day. Our annual bonus is tied to sustainability goals, and we are committed to equality and equal opportunities for all.Perks of having a blue heart


29 days: to recharge
Travel costs: Public transport, car, parking & charging covered
Pension plan: 75% premium covered
Annual bonus: Based on sustainability goals
