Title: CRM Insights Analyst
Description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.  

We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a CRM Insights Analyst to join on-site in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change? 

The Role 

As a CRM Insights Analyst, you will work in the CRM team. Our job is to inform, engage and entertain customers through email, push notifications, and in-app messaging. Working with large-scale customer data, we help onboard, find new favorites to watch, learn to use features and much more – for positive effects on retention, sales, and reactivation. We have established strong personalization capabilities, and you'll play a key role in taking them to the next level through strategic thinking and data-driven innovation.

Your responsibility will be to support the team by creating monitoring, liveboards and reporting, developing them to enable efficient and constantly improving operations. You will also do hands-on analysis of various areas of the messaging and share insights and recommendations with the team and its stakeholders across the Nordics, on how to optimize.

As a CRM Insights Analyst your tasks will include: 


Support the team with hands-on analysis. Identify opportunities and proactively share knowledge and findings with the team and stakeholders based on your findings
Visualize and present results and recommendations in a clear, concise way
Build, own and develop liveboards and reports from multiple sources of data that empower the team to track progress and monitor operations
Oversee, recommend and visualize relevant KPI’s to focus operations on
Ensure that CRM runs on complete, reliable and fresh data. Suggest what items to track, spot anomalies and strive to always improve dashboards and reporting. Work with Data Science teams to make it happen!
Provide guidance on methodology and execution of performance enhancing initiatives such as e.g. A/B testing


We aspire to continuously improve and learn from everything we do. You’ll be challenged and have plenty of fun.

What we’re looking for 

As a CRM Insights Analyst, you will be at the heart of things. It’s essential to be structured, organized, and forward-leaning with a go-getter attitude. 

We are looking for a candidate who is highly analytical and has a business and performance mindset. The ideal candidate is someone who has a good understanding of extracting, wrangling and interpreting customer data to shape it into business recommendations and decisions. You are a proactive self-driven doer with experience from working with digital products in the Nordics and thrive in a collaborative environment, working alongside a highly skilled team and a range of stakeholders within Commercial, Data Science, Product, Content, Finance and more.

To be a successful candidate we believe that: 


You are a strong communicator with experience in visualizing customer data and creating impactful reports and liveboards
You are familiar with SQL, Python or R, and reporting tools such as ThoughtSpot or equivalent
At least two years of experience working with CRM Analytics or Customer Analytics
You hold a post-secondary degree in Business, Finance, Mathematics or a related field, and have 3–5 years of relevant experience
You are passionate about movies, TV series and/or sports
An analytical eye, able to search for constant improvements in messaging effects, process output etc. You are familiar with tapping into data and reports to understand and improve.
Fluency in English


Most of all, you are curious and keen to learn! 

What we offer you

We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.

Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.

A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.

Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including series & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.

Hit play today 

If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position. 

Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

Title: Customer Lifecycle Analyst
Description:
We are Strawberry. With over 245 hotels, 120 restaurants, 20 spas and more, we create thousands of experiences every day. With urban Comfort Hotel®, warm Quality Hotel™, stylish Clarion Hotel® and cosy Home Hotel and more than 40 unique independent hotels, our guests can pick and choose. Our team of 20,000 passionate individuals from more than 120 countries is what makes us grow! Strawberry is built on our core values: energy, courage and enthusiasm.


Are you a curious, fast-paced analyst who loves turning complex customer and lifecycle data into commercial impact? Do you thrive in an environment where your insights directly shape strategic decisions and customer growth - rather than dying in a presentation slide? If you're looking for a role with high autonomy, sharp colleagues, and the chance to build a true data foundation from the ground up, this is your place to thrive!







We find ourselves at an exhilarating position. We’ve grown to over 250 hotels, broken the historic 20 billion NOK revenue milestone, and transformed how marketing, loyalty, and commercial growth operate at Strawberry. Now, we are taking our lifecycle marketing and personalization capabilities to the next level. We need a proactive Customer Lifecycle Analyst to be the dedicated analytics bridge to our Omnichannel and CRM teams. 



Note: We are currently hiring three distinct analyst roles within our Commercial Insights & Personalization team. While all three share our passion for commercial data and high tempo, this specific role is dedicated to driving real commercial value across our customer lifecycle journeys and personalized CRM efforts.






What you will be doing


As our Customer Lifecycle Analyst, your main role is to be a trusted business partner and commercial challenger. You’ll dive into our customer data, map behavior across lifecycle stages (onboarding, engagement, retention, reactivation), and proactively bring new solutions to the table – including the ones we didn't know we needed. 



A core part of your mission will be to support and empower our Omnichannel team – led by Bjørnhild Kjørsvik (Head of Omnichannel) – providing them with the actionable insights, segmentation logic, and experimentation rigor needed to optimize relevance and customer lifetime value.



(We’re not looking for a static dashboard generator, but we do value foundational analytical hygiene. You own your data domain end-to-end: from building the pragmatic dashboards and streamlining monthly reporting that keep us grounded, to telling the commercial story behind the numbers.) 

Dig into the "why" behind customer behavior shifts, lifecycle drop-offs, and retention metrics (LTV, churn). You proactively spot anomalies and trends across our customer journeys and bring these insights to light. 
Streamline our recurring monthly lifecycle reporting and create clean, reliable dashboards/data structures that keep the Omnichannel team self-sufficient and aligned on core KPIs.
Independently design and analyze A/B tests and customer segmentations. Ensure statistical rigor and commercial impact while shifting CRM from tactical campaigns to data-driven lifecycle management. 
Drive initiatives proactively. Take full ownership. Spot opportunities, ask the brave questions ("Have we looked into this?"), and run with them.
Balance strategy & speed. Move seamlessly between fast ad-hoc questions and broader strategic projects. Spread data literacy across commercial teams, increasing the organization's appetite for analytics and data-driven decision-making.




Who we think you are


You are a curious commercial storyteller who naturally digs beneath the surface and has the confidence to translate raw data into persuasive business recommendations. You combine a solid technical, analytical foundation with a deep understanding of CRM and customer lifecycle mechanics. 



You are pragmatic, action-driven, and resilient. When you spot anomalous data or hidden patterns in the member base, you react with curiosity—using your analytical skills and proactive mindset to connect the dots and drive clarity. 

Proven experience in CRM Analytics, Lifecycle Analytics, or Customer Data Analytics (around 5+ years of experience). Solid grasp of customer lifetime value, retention strategies, and personalization frameworks
Proficiency in SQL, visualization tools (e.g., PowerBI, Tableau, or GA4), and hands-on experience working with customer data platforms (CDP) or CRM automation tools (e.g., Braze, Salesforce, HubSpot)
Strong background in experimental design (A/B testing) and segmentation methodologies






Details: 
You will report to Dianne Robillos, as part of her Commercial Insights & Personalization team. Here, you get a solid data community of analyst colleagues to spar with, while acting as the primary bridge to daily commercial execution
Location: Stockholm (Solna) or Oslo (with flexibility through our hybrid office setup).
Working Language: Swedish, Norwegian, or English.






What we can offer you

A flat organization with trust and autonomy in your work. We are rebels that support innovation without imposing strict corporate rules.
The chance to be part of a passionate team with exceptional colleagues and an inclusive culture that believes every stay should be a story worth telling. 
Plenty of social events including smaller gatherings with your team and huge get-togethers with the whole Strawberry family! 
Great benefits! In addition to our collective agreement, we also offer staff discounts and friends & family rates at our 250+ hotels.

Title: Data & BI Specialist for Marketing Domain
Description:
Job Description



ABOUT THE TEAM

You'll join the Marketing Insights & Steering area within the Marketing Domain, where we enable data-driven decision-making across H&M's global marketing organisation. Our team plays a central role in understanding the impact of marketing, ensuring that investments across channels, markets and customer touchpoints are measurable, optimised and aligned with business goals.



We build and evolve the insights, measurement and reporting capabilities that help H&M understand how marketing drives customer behaviour and business results. By connecting data, technology and business needs, we enable smarter decisions and greater impact across the organisation.



Working closely with teams across Marketing, Marketing Tech and AI- Data & Analytics we help make trusted data more accessible and actionable across the business.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Data & BI Specialist, you'll play a key role in transforming marketing data into actionable insights that shape decisions across H&M's global marketing organisation. Working at the intersection of business, analytics and technology, you'll help stakeholders understand performance, identify opportunities and make more informed decisions.



You will:



Own and manage marketing reporting tools, ensuring they remain reliable, effective and aligned with business needs.
Build, develop and improve data models, dashboards, reports and analytical solutions that support decision-making across Marketing.
Translate business needs into scalable reporting solutions, intuitive visualisations and clear data requirements.
Optimise existing data models and reports to improve performance, usability and business value.
Identify opportunities to automate, streamline and simplify reporting processes to improve efficiency and consistency.
Partner with business stakeholders to understand challenges, identify opportunities and turn data into actionable insights.
Collaborate with data engineers, analysts and product teams to improve data quality, accessibility and governance.
Support the development of self-service capabilities that enable teams to access insights and make informed decisions more independently.
Contribute to the continuous development of H&M’s marketing data, reporting and analytics capabilities.

WHO YOU ARE

You are curious, analytical and motivated by solving business problems through data. You enjoy working at the intersection of business and technology and know how to translate complex information into clear insights that drive action.



You thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy partnering with stakeholders across different functions. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, asking questions and continuously looking for better ways to use data to create business value.



WE ARE LOOKING FOR PEOPLE WITH



A degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering or another quantitative field.
Experience within analytics, business intelligence, marketing analytics or a related field.
Strong SQL skills and experience with Power BI, Tableau, Looker or similar visualisation tools.
Experience working with large datasets from multiple data sources.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical audiences.
Fluent English, written and spoken.

IT'S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH



Marketing and customer data.
Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery or Databricks.
Experience driving automation of analytical processes, reporting tools, and data models.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING



This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of marketing, analytics and business strategy. You'll help shape how H&M measures marketing performance globally and contribute to better decisions across media, customer engagement, brand building and commercial growth.You'll work with large-scale datasets, modern analytics platforms and stakeholders across one of the world's largest retail organisations, helping transform data into meaningful business impact.





Additional Information



This is a permanent full-time position based in Stockholm.



As collaboration and teamwork are important to us, we expect an in-office presence of four days per week.



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE



At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer:



Global career and development opportunities
A value‑driven culture where you are encouraged to be yourself
Staff discount cards and benefits
Wellness and wellbeing benefits
Parental support
Opportunities to experiment, grow, and create tangible impact in a large‑scale tech organization.

Here, you are encouraged to be yourself, experiment, and grow — and as you flourish, so do we.



If you believe you can contribute to this role and want to join our team, we'd love to hear from you. Please submit your application in English.



We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter to your application.

Title: Analytics Engineer (in-house)
Description:
We are looking for a full-time Analytics Engineer in-house (m/f/d) to join our motivated global Insights team starting as soon as possible in the Stockholm or Munich office.




The Role

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll help shape how data is structured, accessed, and used across the business. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to build reliable, scalable data solutions that support smarter decisions.




As a vital member of our international IT organization, you will be involved in the foundation of our internal product development and will join the cross-functional data team that is responsible for developing and maintaining Netlight's business-critical data platform and strives to decentralize analytics. That is why it is important that you are a self-driven person, who is comfortable with taking initiative and responsibility, as well as a service-minded and communicative team player.




Who you are

A trusted communicator who builds relationships across technical and non-technical stakeholders and translates data into decisions
Self-driven and proactive, but also team-oriented, with sound judgment on when to lean on AI tools for speed and when human oversight and design thinking matter more
Comfortable working in ambiguity — organized yet flexible, able to adapt as tools, priorities, and team structures evolve quickly
A curious, fast learner with a growth mindset — genuinely energized by new tools, AI-assisted workflows, and continuously raising your own technical bar




Qualifications

Based in Stockholm or Munich
A degree in a quantitative field (e.g. software engineering, computer science, economics, mathematics, statistics) — if you think you’re a great fit, we want to hear from you!
At least 2+ years of relevant experience in fields like Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Science, or Software Development.
Strong SQL skills, with hands-on experience building and testing data models in dbt on a cloud warehouse, and an understanding of dimensional data modeling (star schemas, facts and dimensions)
Solid grasp of version control with Git, including CI/CD workflows for data pipelines
Familiarity with Python for data transformation, automation, and light pipeline work
Fluent in written and spoken English (business level)
Comfort working with AI copilots and AI-assisted analytics tools (e.g. Copilot-style code/doc generation, AI BI assistants) while maintaining human oversight on data quality and design
Bonus: Experience with, or strong interest in, semantic layers and metric governance — ensuring a single, trusted definition of key business metrics that both humans and AI tools can rely on




What you will do

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll help shape how data is structured, accessed, and used across the business. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to build reliable, scalable data solutions that support smarter decisions.




Data Modeling & Quality

Transform raw data into clean, usable datasets for analytics and business intelligence, and AI use cases.
Collaborate with stakeholders to define and maintain a semantic layer and single source of truth for key business metrics.
Ensure data quality and consistency across teams and tools.
Build and maintain robust, well-documented data models using Snowflake and dbt.

Governance & Enablement

Provide compliant, user-friendly access to data across various tools (e.g. Power BI, Excel, or AI-powered BI assistants).
Empower users of all technical levels — including AI agents — to find, understand, and securely query the data they need.
Own the data access lifecycle end-to-end, balancing self-service efficiency with security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
Maintain clear documentation and metadata (data catalog, definitions, lineage, ownership) so both people and AI tools can trust and correctly interpret the data

Optimization & Agile Delivery

Continuously evaluate and improve data models for performance and scalability.
Contribute to agile ways of working, participating in planning, refinement, and delivery cycles.
Stay current with emerging tools and practices in the data stack (e.g. orchestration, observability, AI-assisted development) and help the team adopt what's genuinely useful.




What we offer

The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry
Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
Mental health & parental support offerings
30 days of paid vacation.




Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:

5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
Private pension savings




Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:

Deutschlandticket
Wellpass




About us

Netlight is an international digital consulting firm, helping leading companies to succeed in the digital landscape, from advice to implementation. Our service contains the collective intelligence of more than 2200 consultants offering a comprehensive range of digital services, from strategy to technology. Co-creating the future today, since 1999.




Netlight has been awarded several times for profitable growth and management, as a top employer, and for our engagement in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Located in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Oslo, Helsinki, Copenhagen, Munich, Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Zurich, Cologne, Amsterdam, Madrid, Toronto, Vienna and London.




Come work with us

Netlight as a company strives to be a truly diverse, equitable, and inclusive organisation. Regardless of who you are, what personality, background, and experience you have, you enrich our culture through your values. Netlight’s purpose is to unleash full potential, realise great careers, and fulfil personal growth.




To achieve this, we have a highly engaged network organisation, where every employee gets a mentor, delivery coach, and personal communities. The key to our continued success is trust and personal responsibility, diverse experiences, challenging opportunities, and development based on personal values. Every Netlighter is an active part of building and shaping this culture, which leads to a clear correlation between personal growth and the growth of Netlight.




Apply today

Should your experience and education match, we will get back to you within two weeks after your application. Feel free to contact us on LinkedIn if you have any further questions.




Please apply with your resume in English. Links to relevant projects, GitHub, or IaC repositories are welcome. We look forward to hearing from you!

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
We are on a mission to become the leading international force in residential property management. What we do matters to billions of people in their everyday lives.

Residential real estate is the world’s largest asset class, and for most families, buying a home is the single biggest financial decision they will ever make. For too long, residential property management has fallen short of homeowners' and residents' expectations, and the industry is ready for change. Odevo was formed to make that change happen.

In just six years, Odevo has grown more than 70-fold, establishing us as the leading international player. We are more than 14,000 people across the US, the UK, the Nordics, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, and Italy building Odevo. Together, we aspire to break new ground through innovation and cultivate a workplace where we help each other succeed, where ideas matter more than titles, and where kindness is a strength.

By combining the power of people and technology, we set a new standard for how homes are managed. Our technology-enabled services simplify living for residents and create a better experience for property owners and boards.

Our ambition is to continue our fast-growing journey through new customers, service expansion, and by partnering with great companies that share our mindset and ambition, both in existing and new markets.

As we continue to grow, we stay true to who we are, challenge unnecessary bureaucracy, and keep decision-making close to our customers.

If you share our mindset and ambition, we’d love you to join us and help accelerate our mission together.

About The Role

As a Data Engineer in our Global Data & BI team, you will build and operate the pipelines that power the Odevo Data Warehouse (ODW). Working within an established Microsoft Fabric architecture, you'll ingest data from the many source systems used across our operating companies, model it into trusted, reusable datasets, and keep it flowing reliably to the dashboards and data products our business depends on.

Key Responsibilities


Build and maintain ingestion pipelines in Fabric Data Factory across APIs, databases, SaaS platforms and file-based feeds, including incremental and change data capture patterns.
Develop and test transformation models across the Bronze, Silver and Gold layers (medallion architecture), following the team's modelling standards and naming conventions.
Model data for analytical consumption — dimensional models, slowly changing dimensions, and handling multi-entity, multi-currency and multi-country data.
Operate what you build: monitor pipeline health, investigate and fix failures, respond to source schema changes, and improve reliability and run cost.
Implement data quality tests and validation rules in pipelines, working to the standards set by our Data Enablement squad.
Prepare and document governed datasets for the Published layer, so that BI developers, semantic models and downstream applications can consume them with confidence.
Work within our engineering workflow — version control and CI/CD in Azure DevOps, peer review, secrets management in Azure Key Vault, and clear documentation of pipelines and lineage.
Work directly with BI developers and business stakeholders to understand what the data is for, and translate that into pipelines and models that answer the actual question.


Who You Are

You're a pragmatic builder who gets things into production. You're comfortable with messy, undocumented source systems and enjoy the detective work of figuring out what the data actually means. You take ownership of the pipelines you build rather than handing them over, you ask what a dataset is for before you build it, and you can explain what you've done to someone who doesn't work in data. You want to work somewhere the data platform is still being built out, rather than somewhere it's already finished.

Experience


2–4 years' hands-on data engineering experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.
Strong SQL, and Python for data manipulation, automation and API-based ingestion.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Synapse Data Warehouse / Lakehouse, OneLake) — or with the Azure equivalents such as Azure Data Factory, Synapse or Databricks, and the appetite to move onto Fabric quickly.
Practical experience transformation framework and a solid grasp of modular, tested SQL modelling.
Solid understanding of data warehousing, ELT and dimensional modelling.
Comfortable working with Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines, ideally Azure DevOps.
Awareness of data protection and security practice — GDPR, handling of personal data, role-based access — applied to the data you work with.

We are on a mission to become the leading international force in residential property management. What we do matters to billions of people in their everyday lives.

Our ambition is to continue our fast-growing journey through new customers, service expansion, and by partnering with great companies that share our mindset and ambition, both in existing and new markets.

As we continue to grow, we stay true to who we are, challenge unnecessary bureaucracy, and keep decision-making close to our customers.

If you share our mindset and ambition, we’d love you to join us and help accelerate our mission together.

About The Role

As a Data Engineer in our Global Data & BI team, you will build and operate the pipelines that power the Odevo Data Warehouse (ODW). Working within an established Microsoft Fabric architecture, you'll ingest data from the many source systems used across our operating companies, model it into trusted, reusable datasets, and keep it flowing reliably to the dashboards and data products our business depends on.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain ingestion pipelines in Fabric Data Factory across APIs, databases, SaaS platforms and file-based feeds, including incremental and change data capture patterns.
  • Develop and test transformation models across the Bronze, Silver and Gold layers (medallion architecture), following the team's modelling standards and naming conventions.
  • Model data for analytical consumption — dimensional models, slowly changing dimensions, and handling multi-entity, multi-currency and multi-country data.
  • Operate what you build: monitor pipeline health, investigate and fix failures, respond to source schema changes, and improve reliability and run cost.
  • Implement data quality tests and validation rules in pipelines, working to the standards set by our Data Enablement squad.
  • Prepare and document governed datasets for the Published layer, so that BI developers, semantic models and downstream applications can consume them with confidence.
  • Work within our engineering workflow — version control and CI/CD in Azure DevOps, peer review, secrets management in Azure Key Vault, and clear documentation of pipelines and lineage.
  • Work directly with BI developers and business stakeholders to understand what the data is for, and translate that into pipelines and models that answer the actual question.

Who You Are

You're a pragmatic builder who gets things into production. You're comfortable with messy, undocumented source systems and enjoy the detective work of figuring out what the data actually means. You take ownership of the pipelines you build rather than handing them over, you ask what a dataset is for before you build it, and you can explain what you've done to someone who doesn't work in data. You want to work somewhere the data platform is still being built out, rather than somewhere it's already finished.

Experience

  • 2–4 years' hands-on data engineering experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.
  • Strong SQL, and Python for data manipulation, automation and API-based ingestion.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Synapse Data Warehouse / Lakehouse, OneLake) — or with the Azure equivalents such as Azure Data Factory, Synapse or Databricks, and the appetite to move onto Fabric quickly.
  • Practical experience transformation framework and a solid grasp of modular, tested SQL modelling.
  • Solid understanding of data warehousing, ELT and dimensional modelling.
  • Comfortable working with Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines, ideally Azure DevOps.
  • Awareness of data protection and security practice — GDPR, handling of personal data, role-based access — applied to the data you work with.

Title: Consumer Analyst
Description:
Are you passionate about building true consumer preference—turning data and insights into real user and business impact?

At Instabee, we are on a mission to become the undisputed #1 service in the eyes of our consumers. We are now looking for a Consumer Analyst to join our Consumer Department. In this role, you will play a fundamental part in building the analytical foundation and insights required to ensure our organization is aligned, informed, and accountable for delivering a superior consumer experience across all markets.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical capabilities with business acumen and the ability to communicate findings clearly to diverse stakeholders.

About The Role

As Consumer Analyst, you will translate complex data and consumer signals into clear, actionable insights that can drive strategic and tactical impact. Partnering with teams across Data & Analytics, Product, Design, Operations, Strategy and Market to understand challenges, synthesize insights from diverse sources, and co-create solutions grounded in consumer and business relevance.

Your goal is to build a solid foundation for consumer, brand, and experience analytics, making insights accessible and actionable company-wide. Whether you are mapping the behavior of different consumer segments, uncovering what drives long-term retention, or tracking the impact of a new product feature, you will play a key role in guiding our journey toward becoming the undisputed #1 service in all our markets.

What You'll Do


Manage the Consumer Scorecard: Define and evolve our core KPIs (NPS, User ratings, Brand preference, CSAT, MAU, Consumer base metrics, Operational metrics etc.) to ensure a trusted, single source of truth for our performance across the full consumer journey and lifecycle.
Analyze Loyalty & Retention: Conduct cohort and retention analysis to identify the key drivers of consumer satisfaction and long-term loyalty. You’ll explore how different user segments behave and evolve, and translate user and service delivery insights into cross-functional guidance for the most effective ways to win, delight, and retain our consumers.
Analyze Consumer Behavior: Dive deep into user behavior across web, app, communications and customer service channels. You will analyze funnels and identify drop-off points to provide concrete product and experience recommendations. This includes proactively identifying tracking gaps and defining what needs to be measured and how, to ensure decisions are grounded in reliable data.
Translate Data into Action: Synthesize quantitative and qualitative data into concise, actionable insights. You will provide a holistic lens to ensure we deliver a seamless and superior experience across the entire consumer journey.
Co-create Analytical Foundations: Partner with data and tech teams to ensure our data collection is high-quality, scalable, and reliable. You’ll help shape the tracking and data structures (e.g., GA4, BigQuery) required to turn digital behavior into trustworthy insights.
Drive Performance Insights: Enable data-driven decision-making through forecasting, trend analysis, and the development of automated dashboards in Tableau, Steep or similar tools.
Collaborative Problem Solving: Act as the consumer analytics partner for teams across Instabee, helping them move past the "what" to understand the "why" behind consumer behavior.
Drive Experimentation: Design, run, and evaluate A/B tests—taking ownership from the initial hypothesis to the final conclusion and recommended next steps.


Your profile

You are an analytical problem-solver with a natural drive to uncover patterns and understand exactly what drives consumer behavior and business performance. You are curious, proactive, and motivated by creating real-world results rather than theoretical perfection. You don't just provide data; you see it as your mission to provide the actionable insights that enable our teams to deliver a great consumer experience and our business to grow.

Experience & Mindset


Analytical Experience: 4-5+ years of experience in consumer analytics, digital analytics or a related field - ideally within a fast-paced service or e-commerce environment.
Commercial Curiosity: You have a strong business acumen and a natural drive to understand the "why" behind the numbers. You focus on what is relevant and actionable for the business, and proactively surface insights and opportunities.
Problem Solver: Strong analytical and numerical skills with a business-oriented mindset. You excel at bringing structure to ambiguous problems and can navigate complex datasets to find the most impactful answers.
Communication: You can translate complex analysis into sharp, actionable narratives for diverse stakeholders. You communicate insights clearly and confidently to stakeholders at all levels, from junior teams to senior leadership.
Collaboration: Team player who enjoys working across Product, Tech, and Business teams to develop insights and build solutions together.
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, IT, Statistics, Business, or other relevant field.


Analytical toolkit


Consumer Analytics: Proven ability to synthesize various internal and external consumer data into holistic consumer analytics and insights.
Digital Analytics: Experience with tools such as Amplitude, GA4, or similar behavioral tracking platforms.
Data Foundations: Proficiency in SQL and Python or similar, and experience working with large datasets.
Visualization: Ability to build and maintain clear dashboards and funnels that give our teams an ongoing view of consumer health (e.g., using Tableau, Power BI, or Steep).
AI coding tools: Experience in using AI tools in your analytical work is an advantage.
Experimentation: Hands-on experience designing, running, and evaluating A/B tests is an advantage.
Tracking: Knowledge of digital tracking implementation and Google Tag Manager is an advantage.


What You'll Get

We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!

Benefits

Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:


Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm.
Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work - we've got a whole floor for our furry friends!
Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.
Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.
A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!
Hybrid setup and flexible working hours


Get to know us

In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.

We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.

This recruitment process consists of background checks via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys as a review of previous public criminal records. The result is public information that is handled confidentially. This is mandatory for all recruitment processes at Instabee in Sweden.

Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

Title: Data Analyst II
Description:
Through strategic acquisitions and fast organic growth, Sinch has turned into an international powerhouse serving enterprises across the globe and handling over 700 billion engagements per year. In fact, independent analysts say we're a CPaaS leader!

ABOUT SINCH
Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 150,000 businesses - including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others - rely on Sinch's Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email. Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey. At Sinch we "Dream Big", "Win Together", "Keep it simple", and "Make it Happen". These values are our foundation!

DESCRIPTION
At Sinch, our focus is on driving growth through data-driven commercial strategies. As a Data Analyst specializing in CRM reporting and analytics within our Data Analytics department, you will play an essential role in guiding our sales and marketing strategies and building operational efficiency. You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Finance leaders to translate Salesforce and related CRM data into high-quality, actionable insights across the entire sales funnel. In this role, you will work closely with multifunctional teams and be part of a modern analytics setup using advanced tools like Snowflake, dbt, and Tableau.

Please note: This is a one-year fixed-term contract, covering colleagues on parental leave. The role is designed to ensure continuity in analytics delivery and stakeholder support during this period.

Key Responsibilities
CRM Reporting & Dashboarding: Design, build, and maintain robust dashboards and reports in Tableau and Salesforce to track KPIs related to sales pipeline, customer lifecycle, and sales team performance.
Sales Funnel Analysis: Analyze the entire sales and marketing funnel, identifying trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for optimization.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Finance leaders to deliver actionable insights that support strategic and tactical decisions.
Data Integrity & Governance: Act as a subject matter expert on CRM data, ensuring data quality and accuracy within Salesforce and related reporting environments.
Empower Sales Teams: Create and manage user-friendly dashboards that provide self-service analytics, enabling sales representatives and managers to monitor performance effectively.
Analytics Support & Culture: Act as a key point of contact for internal analytics users by managing support requests, investigating issues, and helping spread a strong data-driven culture by training and supporting stakeholders.
REQUIREMENTS
CRM & Visualization Tools: Proven experience working directly with Salesforce (or similar CRM), including report building and data models, plus at least 2 years of experience creating dashboards in Tableau.
Technical & Analytical Skills: At least 2 years of experience working with SQL (or a comparable track record in analyzing large structured and unstructured datasets) is a big plus.
Education & Professional Experience: A bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative or business-related field (e.g., finance, economics, mathematics, computer science, engineering) is desirable, along with experience collaborating with commercial stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, Finance).
Communication & Language: Fluency in English (both written and spoken) is required, with strong skills in expressing ideas and complex data insights clearly to diverse audiences.
Industry & Global Context: Experience working in a global company and/or within a Tech, SaaS, or B2B Telecom setting is highly preferred.
Professional Qualities: A growth-oriented, detail-oriented, and highly adaptable mindset, with strong emotional intelligence and collaboration skills to build effective working relationships.

Salary:

The monthly salary for this position is between 35,266 SEK - 44083 SEK. Factors which may affect pay within this range may include skills, education, experience, and other qualifications.

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.

OUR HIRING PROCESS
We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel. We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Vi tror på ett samhälle format av framgångsrika företag där entreprenörskap och samhällsnytta går hand i hand. Att vara en del av Fortnox är att vara en del av en ständig förändring - en förändring där du själv bestämmer hur långt du vill nå. Vårt största fokus är att ge dig rätt förutsättningar att få leva din passion tillsammans med oss. Var du kommer ifrån är inte relevant - det är vart du är på väg som är intressant för oss. Precis som vi igår inte kunde drömma om det Fortnox som finns idag, så kan du vara med och forma vilka vi är imorgon.

Om tjänsten

Fortnox behöver förstå hur våra produkter skapar värde, och det börjar med data som går att lita på. Produktanalysteamet bygger den grunden, och vi söker en Analytics Engineer som äger den. Det du modellerar i dbt idag blir kontextlagret som AI-agenter konsumerar imorgon.

Vi söker en person som trivs i en teknisk roll och vill bygga datafundamentet för att:


Bygga datamodeller i dbt och BigQuery. Basmodeller som hela organisationen konsumerar. Tydliga namn, dokumentation och tester.
Få in och modellera event-data. Du tar Kafka backend-events och Piwik frontend-events hela vägen in i BQ/dbt och bygger affärslogiken ovanpå: aktivering, inloggning och hur kunder rör sig genom produkterna.
Äga produktdomänen i dataplattformen. Du ansvarar för struktur, standards och kvalitet för allt som rör produkt, så att andra team kan lita på modellerna.
Göra datan användbar för både människor och AI. Vi bygger en AI-driven pipeline för mätning. Du säkrar att modeller och events är dokumenterade så att relevanta stakeholders förstår dem, och så att en AI-agent svarar rätt på frågor om dem.
Hjälpa team hjälpa sig själva. Du bygger verktygen och kontexten som låter produktteam lägga till mätning och hämta data på egen hand.



Om dig

Du har erfarenhet av att bygga dbt-modeller i produktion, med SQL som primärt verktyg. Det som gör dig intressant för oss är att du vet skillnaden mellan en modell som råkar vara korrekt och en som faktiskt är användbar, för en analytiker, en produktägare eller en AI-agent.

Title: Dataanalytiker registerkontroll
Description:
Vill du bidra till att rätt personer är en del av det mest skyddsvärda i Sverige? Som dataanalytiker i gruppen för registerkontroll bidrar du till att säkerställa lämpligt deltagande och minska risken för insiders i säkerhetskänsliga verksamheter. Välkommen med din ansökan.




Tillsammans skyddar vi Sverige.




Ort: Stockholm

Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-08-23




Det här är ditt uppdrag

Vid Säkerhetspolisen är arbete med data och analys centralt. Nu söker vi dig som vill jobba med att utöka myndighetens förmåga inom dataintag och dataanalys.




I rollen arbetar du aktivt med data och dataanalys i olika faser och skapar värde för vår verksamhet. Du kommer arbeta tvärfunktionellt med analys och bedömning av data. Inhämtning av nya datakällor, samt aktivt bidra i arbetet med datakvalitet och datadefinitioner. I rollen ingår utveckling och införande av processer för t.ex. datakvalitet, och bedömning av analyserade datamängder. Arbetet kräver ett nära samarbete med andra områden inom myndigheten samt frekvent samverkan med andra myndigheter.




I rollen som dataanalytiker på registerkontrollen kommer du att bidra till att relevant information beaktas i registerkontrollprocessen, detta innebär bland annat arbete mot flertalet olika register. Du kommer att bidra till att utveckla verksamheten utifrån ett mer digitaliserat flöde. Du kommer även att ges möjlighet att bidra till planering av gruppens verksamhet samt medverka till att utveckla arbetsmetoder. Rollen innebär bred samverkan, samt kan komma att innefatta genomförande eller bidragande till utbildningsinsatser, både internt och externt. Vi ser gärna att du har kompetens som kan bidra till att utveckla vår informationshantering och det interna it-stödet i registerkontrollen.




Förändringar i reglering tillsammans med ett osäkert omvärldsläge gör att registerkontrollen kommer att få en allt större påverkan av skyddet för det mest skyddsvärda i Sverige. Du kommer bland annat vara en del av den säkerhetsprövning som verksamhetsutövare genomför innan deras personal deltar i säkerhetskänslig verksamhet.




Din placering är på huvudkontoret i Solna och arbetet utförs på plats, vilket innebär att du inte har möjlighet att arbeta på distans. Resor inom Sverige kan förekomma.




De här kvalifikationerna söker vi hos dig

Det är endast du som uppfyller nedanstående krav som kan bli aktuell för tjänsten.




Krav:

För tjänsten relevant eftergymnasial utbildning
Flerårig erfarenhet av kvalificerat analysarbete med fokus på större datamängder
Erfarenhet av att framställa underlag för beslut
Erfarenhet av process- och metodutveckling
Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i såväl tal som skrift
God förmåga att kommunicera på engelska i såväl tal som skrift




Anställningen kräver svenskt medborgarskap.




Du som söker kan också ha kompetens som tillför bredd och kompletterande perspektiv. Kan du bidra med något eller flera av följande är det meriterande:

Relevant akademisk examen inom t.ex. dataanalys, informatik, statistik, systemvetenskap
Erfarenhet av informationssäkerhet, dataskydd/integritetsskydd eller juridik
Erfarenhet av att arbeta inom en organisation med höga säkerhetskrav
Kunskap och erfarenhet inom säkerhetsskydd eller samhällsviktig verksamhet
Erfarenhet av statlig förvaltning
Erfarenhet av arbete med säkerhetsprövning
Erfarenhet av projektledning eller förändringsledning




Det här är kollegan vi söker

I rollen som dataanalytiker krävs det att du är mål- och resultatinriktad och levererar utifrån gruppens uppdrag. Du är utvecklingsorienterad, strukturerad och har god analytisk förmåga. Du har en positiv och prestigelös inställning till samarbeten och uppdrag, och du bygger nätverk genom att skapa och upprätthålla förtroliga och professionella kontakter.




I rollen kommer du växla mellan längre och kortare uppdrag och det krävs därför att du har god förmåga att snabbt kunna sätta dig in i olika frågor. Du har förmågan att sammanfatta information för att identifiera det mest relevanta.




Säkerhetspolisen ställer höga krav på säkerhet och sekretess, därför förutsätter vi att du har ett högt säkerhetsmedvetande.




Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.




Anställningsvillkor och förmåner

Anställning vid Säkerhetspolisen innebär inplacering i säkerhetsklass som kräver svenskt medborgarskap. För anställning krävs också godkänt resultat i säkerhetsprövningen med registerkontroll, som genomförs i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen.




Det här är en tillsvidareanställning som inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras.




På vår hemsida, www.sakerhetspolisen.se, kan du läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss samt om våra förmåner.







Så tar du kontakt med oss

För information om rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta HR, tfn 070-860 78 25 eller 010-568 70 06.




Fackliga företrädare: Polisförbundet, tfn 010-568 70 03, SACO, tfn 010-568 70 04 och ST, tfn 010-568 70 02.




Så ansöker du

Ansökan sker via vår hemsida, www.sakerhetspolisen.se




Ansökan ska ha kommit in senast 2026-08-23.




Ansök genom att bifoga ditt CV (i den här rekryteringsprocessen önskar vi inget personligt brev) och besvara urvalsfrågorna nedan. Frågorna utgår från kravprofilen för den här rekryteringen och dina svar ligger till grund för det urval som sker i processen. Att besvara frågorna är en förutsättning för att din ansökan ska anses komplett. Det är därför viktigt att du svarar tydligt och utförligt på frågorna och inte hänvisar till andra handlingar t.ex. CV.




Vänligen bifoga ett separat dokument (pdf eller word) med svar på urvalsfrågorna nedan som du skickar in i samband med din ansökan.

Har du erfarenhet av process- och metodutveckling? Om Ja, beskriv kort din erfarenhet.
Har du mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i såväl tal som skrift? Ja/Nej
Har du god förmåga att kommunicera på engelska i såväl tal som skrift? Ja/Nej
Har du relevant akademisk examen inom t.ex. dataanalys, informatik, statistik, systemvetenskap? Om Ja, vilken akademisk utbildning?
Har du erfarenhet av informationssäkerhet, dataskydd/integritetsskydd eller juridik? Om Ja, beskriv kort din erfarenhet.
Har du erfarenhet av att arbeta inom en organisation med höga säkerhetskrav? Om Ja, beskriv kort din erfarenhet.
Har du kunskap och erfarenhet inom säkerhetsskydd eller samhällsviktig verksamhet? Om Ja, beskriv kort din erfarenhet.

Har du erfarenhet av projektledning eller förändringsledning? Om Ja, beskriv kort din erfarenhet.




Urval och intervjuer kan ske löpande.




Övrig information

Du bör inte berätta att du sökt tjänst hos Säkerhetspolisen för andra personer än dina närmast berörda. Det beror på att vi har tjänster som omfattas av sekretess.




I våra rekryteringar använder vi arbetspsykologiska tester.




Vi har redan gjort våra val av annonskanaler. Vi undanber oss därför samtal från rekryteringsföretag och annonsförsäljare.

Din placering är på huvudkontoret i Solna och arbetet utförs på plats, vilket innebär att du inte har möjlighet att arbeta på distans. Resor inom Sverige kan förekomma.


De här kvalifikationerna söker vi hos dig

Det är endast du som uppfyller nedanstående krav som kan bli aktuell för tjänsten.


Krav:

  • För tjänsten relevant eftergymnasial utbildning
  • Flerårig erfarenhet av kvalificerat analysarbete med fokus på större datamängder
  • Erfarenhet av att framställa underlag för beslut
  • Erfarenhet av process- och metodutveckling
  • Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i såväl tal som skrift
  • God förmåga att kommunicera på engelska i såväl tal som skrift


Anställningen kräver svenskt medborgarskap.


Du som söker kan också ha kompetens som tillför bredd och kompletterande perspektiv. Kan du bidra med något eller flera av följande är det meriterande:

  • Relevant akademisk examen inom t.ex. dataanalys, informatik, statistik, systemvetenskap
  • Erfarenhet av informationssäkerhet, dataskydd/integritetsskydd eller juridik
  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta inom en organisation med höga säkerhetskrav
  • Kunskap och erfarenhet inom säkerhetsskydd eller samhällsviktig verksamhet
  • Erfarenhet av statlig förvaltning
  • Erfarenhet av arbete med säkerhetsprövning
  • Erfarenhet av projektledning eller förändringsledning


Det här är kollegan vi söker

I rollen som dataanalytiker krävs det att du är mål- och resultatinriktad och levererar utifrån gruppens uppdrag. Du är utvecklingsorienterad, strukturerad och har god analytisk förmåga. Du har en positiv och prestigelös inställning till samarbeten och uppdrag, och du bygger nätverk genom att skapa och upprätthålla förtroliga och professionella kontakter.


I rollen kommer du växla mellan längre och kortare uppdrag och det krävs därför att du har god förmåga att snabbt kunna sätta dig in i olika frågor. Du har förmågan att sammanfatta information för att identifiera det mest relevanta.


Säkerhetspolisen ställer höga krav på säkerhet och sekretess, därför förutsätter vi att du har ett högt säkerhetsmedvetande.


Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.


Anställningsvillkor och förmåner

Anställning vid Säkerhetspolisen innebär inplacering i säkerhetsklass som kräver svenskt medborgarskap. För anställning krävs också godkänt resultat i säkerhetsprövningen med registerkontroll, som genomförs i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen.


Det här är en tillsvidareanställning som inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras.


På vår hemsida, www.sakerhetspolisen.se, kan du läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss samt om våra förmåner.



Så tar du kontakt med oss

För information om rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta HR, tfn 070-860 78 25 eller 010-568 70 06.


Fackliga företrädare: Polisförbundet, tfn 010-568 70 03, SACO, tfn 010-568 70 04 och ST, tfn 010-568 70 02.


Så ansöker du

Ansökan sker via vår hemsida, www.sakerhetspolisen.se


Ansökan ska ha kommit in senast 2026-08-23.

Frågorna utgår från kravprofilen för den här rekryteringen och dina svar ligger till grund för det urval som sker i processen. Att besvara frågorna är en förutsättning för att din ansökan ska anses komplett. Det är därför viktigt att du svarar tydligt och utförligt på frågorna och inte hänvisar till andra handlingar t.ex. CV.

Title: Data Engineer / BI Consultant
Description:
Vill du kombinera data, AI och affärsutveckling?

Är du en erfaren Data Engineer eller BI-konsult som drivs av att skapa affärsvärde – inte bara bygga tekniska lösningar? Vill du arbeta nära företagsledningar och hjälpa några av Sveriges största företag att fatta bättre beslut med hjälp av data? Då kan detta vara nästa steg i din karriär.

Vår kund är ett väletablerat managementkonsultbolag med specialistkompetens inom verksamhetsstyrning, lönsamhetsutveckling och beslutsstöd. Nu söker de en Data Engineer som vill vara med och utveckla deras satsning inom Data & AI samt bidra till den fortsatta tillväxten av Stockholmskontoret.




Om rollen

Du kommer att arbeta i gränslandet mellan teknik och affär, där ditt uppdrag är att hjälpa kunder att omvandla komplex data till beslutsunderlag som skapar verkligt affärsvärde.

Rollen handlar inte enbart om att bygga dataplattformar och pipelines. Du kommer även att analysera verksamheters behov, ta fram relevanta KPI och utveckla datamodeller som ger ledningsgrupper bättre beslutsunderlag.




Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att innebära att:

Utforma datamodeller och moderna datalager i Azure.
Bygga lösningar för analys, rapportering och visualisering i Power BI.
Arbeta med Python, SQL och moderna molnplattformar.
Delta i workshops och kundmöten för att förstå verksamhetens behov.
Ta fram KPI, styrmodeller och lönsamhetsanalyser tillsammans med kunden.
Bidra till utvecklingen av AI-baserade lösningar och hur AI kan skapa affärsvärde.
Samarbeta nära managementkonsulter och tekniska specialister i tvärfunktionella projektteam.




Vi tror att du har:

Minst 3–5 års erfarenhet som Data Engineer, BI-konsult eller inom Data & Analytics.
Akademisk examen inom exempelvis Industriell ekonomi, Datavetenskap, Matematik, Teknisk fysik eller motsvarande.
Mycket goda kunskaper i Python och SQL.
Erfarenhet av Azure och moderna dataplattformar.
Erfarenhet av datamodellering, ETL/ELT och Data Warehouse.
Erfarenhet av Power BI eller liknande analysverktyg.
Ett genuint intresse för AI och hur tekniken kan användas för att utveckla verksamheter.




Meriterande är erfarenhet av Microsoft Fabric, Azure DevOps eller Databricks.




Vem är du?

Du trivs i skärningspunkten mellan teknik och verksamhet och motiveras av att förstå affären bakom datan.

Du är van att samarbeta med kunder och känner dig trygg i att diskutera lösningar med både verksamhet och ledning. Samtidigt har du ett stort tekniskt intresse och uppskattar att omsätta komplex data till tydliga beslutsunderlag.




Som person är du:

Affärsmässig och konsultmässig.
Kommunikativ och förtroendeingivande.
Prestigelös och samarbetsorienterad.
Analytisk och lösningsfokuserad.
Självgående med ett starkt eget driv.




Har du dessutom en grundläggande förståelse för ekonomistyrning, controlling eller finansiell rapportering är det ett stort plus.




Därför ska du välja den här möjligheten

Här får du möjlighet att arbeta i ett entreprenöriellt konsultbolag med korta beslutsvägar, stort eget ansvar och en kultur där varje medarbetare har möjlighet att påverka både kundernas utveckling och företagets framtid.




Du erbjuds bland annat:

Uppdrag hos några av Sveriges största företag och koncerner.
Möjlighet att kombinera management consulting, data och AI.
Stor frihet, ansvar och möjlighet att påverka.
Ett kompetent och prestigelöst team med hög kunskapsnivå.
Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och en tydlig karriärväg.
Möjlighet att vara med och utveckla ett växande Stockholmskontor.




Låter det intressant? Vi ser fram emot att berätta mer om företaget och rollen i nästa steg av processen.




Om anställningen:

Detta är en direktanställning där du kommer att bli direkt anställd av kunden.




Övrig info:

Omfattning: Heltid, 100%, direktrekytering
Start: Enligt överenskommelse
Placering: Stockholm city
Rekryteringsansvarig: Hedvig Svärd




Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval av kandidater och att annonsen kan stängs ner innan tjänsten är tillsatt om vi gått över till urvals och intervjufasen. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail.




Om Friday:

På Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som Tech-talang en riktigt bra start på karriären. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av, matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet.

Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas.

Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

Title: Management Consultant - Data & Analytics
Description:
Your role




Our Data & Analytics (D&A) team combine broad business understanding with technical expertise to help our clients make better data-driven decisions.




Expect to participate in projects ranging from advisory services to hands-on development of D&A solutions. We help our clients define a strategy, organize their D&A capabilities, and implement data platforms and analytical solutions. The analytical work ranges from business intelligence to Machine Learning and Generative AI.




Together with an ambitious and multidisciplinary team of colleagues, you will help our clients understand their current situation, risks, and opportunities and advise how they can use technology to solve their business needs. The type of projects will be varied, and you will have access to experts throughout our international community of consultants.




Your professional and personal growth will be supported by a Development Manager. As you deepen your expertise and grow as a consultant, you will take on greater responsibilities in our client engagements and our internal business activities. Such as team development, employer branding, developing new offerings, pitching to clients, and other activities.




What We Are Looking For In Our New Colleagues




You may have a background as a developer and now want to combine technical work with more business‑focused and strategic responsibilities. Alternatively, you may work in Consulting, have a strong technical interest, and want to deepen your expertise within data and AI.




We Expect Candidates To Have




Experience in data collection and analysis, along with a general understanding of business processes.
Familiarity with Business Intelligence solutions and Generative AI development, as well as programming proficiency in Python and SQL.
Some experience with Database design, ETL, and Data Visualization is also desirable.
Experience with Microsoft´s Data & Analytics tools is a plus (Fabric, PowerBI, SQL Server, Data Factory, etc.)
Ability to balance analytical rigor with practical, implementable recommendations.
Structured communication, adapting style to managers and operational teams and an ability to establish credibility quickly in new environments.
A master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other relevant field.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint to support daily business activities.
Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, spoken and written.




What We Offer




BearingPoint is a great place to work. We can offer you the opportunity to work for a company with a global reach and a unique culture that allows everyone to reach their highest potential. We also offer team-specific competency development opportunities and employee benefits such as:

Professional and personal growth, supported by your Development Manager.
An international, dynamic, and inspiring work environment.
A steep learning curve in client-facing roles with a high impact on the business performance of our clients.
Competitive compensation and benefits package, including but not limited to an occupational pension, health insurance, wellness grants, expanded parental benefits, and more.
Competency development opportunities include our First 1000-day program and other Nordic & Firm-wide training and boot camps (Grow with BearingPoint).
An annual curriculum of various social events and sports activities.




What Now?




Send us your resume in either Swedish or English, and we´ll get back to you shortly. A cover letter is optional, and Interviews will be held continuously.




During the interview process, you will meet various colleagues from the team and conduct case interviews.




Want to find out more about the team? Meet some of our colleagues here (Meet our Sweden team), or read an article with our D&A team lead Marcus Ehrndal here.




As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be subject to background checks. These checks help us ensure a safe and trustworthy workplace and may include verification of identity, employment history, education, and any relevant criminal records, in accordance with applicable laws.

Title: Statistician
Company: The National Board of Health and Welfare (Socialstyrelsen)
Description:
Vill du bidra till att tillgängliggöra hälsodata för forskning och främja svensk forskning på ett rättssäkert och serviceinriktat sätt? Hos oss bidrar du i det viktiga arbetet med att tillhandahålla externa intressenter med data från våra hälso- och socialtjänstdataregister. Du får möjlighet att använda och utveckla dina programmeringskunskaper i en verksamhet som gör skillnad.




Om tjänsten

Tjänsten är placerad på statistikavdelningen och du kommer att ansvara för att bereda ärenden, skriva förslag till beslut och vara föredragande av ärenden, samt att ta fram det dataunderlag som beslutet omfattar. Du programmerar i SAS och SQL och gör populationsframtagningar och datauttag från Socialstyrelsens egna register och genomför samkörningar av data från olika källor. Då Socialstyrelsens inte ska lämna ut mer uppgifter än nödvändigt är det mycket stora inslag av villkor som reglerar datautlämnandena.

Du har ett självständigt och omväxlande arbete där du, tillsammans med dina närmsta kollegor, bidrar till att forskare får tillgång till registerdata på ett rättssäkert och serviceinriktat sätt. Rollen innebär många kontakter – du samverkar med kollegor, forskare och myndigheter, samt ger stöd till beställare före, under och efter leverans. Du arbetar målinriktat genom att driva dina ärenden via en tydlig process där du sätter upp mål och arbetar ambitiöst och fokuserat för att nå dessa. Du förväntas bidra till verksamhetens utveckling.




Om dig

Vi söker dig som är analytisk och lösningsorienterad, med förmåga att hantera komplexa data. Du har god förmåga att växla mellan olika arbetsuppgifter och kan hantera parallella projekt utan att tappa fokus. Du uttrycker dig tydligt på svenska, både i tal och skrift, för att kunna samarbeta med kollegor och kommunicera med externa parter. Du har en stark ansvarskänsla för ditt arbete men värderar också lagarbete högt – vi arbetar som ett team där vi stödjer och lär av varandra.




Vi söker dig som har




relevant masterutbildning, exempelvis inom statistik, epidemiologi, folkhälsovetenskap, samhällsvetenskap eller kvalifikationer som Socialstyrelsen anser likvärdiga
minst 10 högskolepoäng i statistik
mycket goda kunskaper i programmering i verktyg för statistikframställning
god förmåga att utrycka dig tydligt och pedagogiskt på svenska i tal och skrift
intresse av att arbeta med samhällsfrågor eller frågor som rör hälso- och sjukvård och folkhälsa

Det är meriterande om du har

erfarenhet av att handlägga ärenden på statlig myndighet

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!




Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:

We are trusted by over 450 million active users every month across 190+ countries
We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
We are powered by a team of 450+ employees from 45+ nationalities




We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.




The role:

As a Senior Data analyst, you’ll be responsible for the team's quantitative insights. From understanding our data, identifying problems, to working with product, tech, and design on hypothesizing solutions. You’ll be the driver of our experimentation and learning efforts and will collaborate with different teams.




What you will do

Understanding Truecaller's data.
Taking ownership of quantitative insights for your team, playing a crucial role in product development.
Defining experiments, overseeing their setup, and analyzing their results to drive decision-making.
Developing and maintaining key performance indicators (KPIs) for the team, ensuring their tracking, reliability, and reporting.
Creating data pipelines and dashboards to measure the team's KPIs and effectively communicate insights to both the team and leadership.
Coaching and mentoring the team on experimentation and data-driven product development processes, fostering a culture of data-driven decision-making.




What you bring in

4+ years of experience in Data Analytics
Experience in using SQL to extract, transform, and analyse data
Experience in data visualisation tools like Looker (preferred), QlikSense, Tableau, or Power BI
Experience in mentoring, coaching, and evangelizing about data in product development
Experience in digging into different data sources to understand why specific customer behaviours happen
Fluent in spoken and written English




It would be great if you also have

Big data query tools (we use BigQuery).
Experience with data from mobile applications.




What we offer:

We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:




A comprehensive compensation package: We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
Modern tools to do your best work: Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
A people-focused office culture: We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination: 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.




Come as you are:

Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.




Check out Life at Truecaller - Behind the code: https://www.instagram.com/lifeattruecaller/




Sounds like a great opportunity?




We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.




We only accept applications in English.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Till Trygg-Hansa Företagsmarknad söker vi nu en Senior Data Analyst som vill vara med och ta organisationens BI- och analysfunktion till nästa nivå.

Om jobbet | Ta data till insikter som gör skillnad för affären

Som Senior Data Analyst får du en nyckelroll i att driva utvecklingen av BI, analys och datadrivet beslutsfattande inom Företagsmarknad. Du utvecklar moderna rapporterings- och analyslösningar i Power BI och gör data tillgänglig på ett sätt som skapar verkligt affärsvärde. Du arbetar nära beslutsfattare och specialister i verksamheten och omvandlar komplexa affärsfrågeställningar till värdeskapande rapporter, dashboards och dataleveranser som används i det dagliga beslutsfattandet.

Du blir en del av ett erfaret team av analytiker och data scientists som delar kunskap, utmanar varandra konstruktivt och samarbetar tvärfunktionellt med många delar av organisationen. Teamet har ett övergripande ansvar för Företagsmarknads rapportering och analys. Vi utvecklar och förvaltar rapporter och dashboards end-to-end, exempelvis inom försäljning och portföljutveckling. Teamet supporterar också organisationen med data och analys.

Exempel På Ansvarsområden


Identifiera möjligheter att öka användningen av data och BI i verksamheten samt driva förbättringsinitiativ
Omsätta affärsbehov till skalbara analysprodukter, KPI:er och dashboards
Utveckla och vidareutveckla rapporterings- och analyslösningar i Power BI end-to-end
Bygga och förbättra dataflöden samt ETL-processer med moderna tekniker och verktyg
Säkerställa hög användarvänlighet och rätt design i våra rapporter och dashboards
Utveckla ett nära samarbete med stakeholders för att förstå organisationens behov
Ta ägarskap och aktivt bidra i planering av både kort- och långsiktig utveckling
Agera rådgivare till verksamheten i frågor kopplade till analys, rapportering och datadrivet beslutsfattande
Planera och genomföra demo av nya rapporter


Placeringsort är Stockholm och du rapporterar till Chef för Data, Analys & Rapportering.

Om dig | Senior analytiker som skapar insikter och förändring

Det här är en roll för dig som har gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av analys och BI, trivs med stort eget ansvar och vill utveckla lösningar som påverkar både affären, kundvärdet och hur organisationen arbetar med data.

För att kvalificera dig för rollen har du:


Relevant akademisk utbildning inom exempelvis Statistik, Matematik, Datavetenskap, Industriell ekonomi eller annat närliggande område
Minst fem års relevant erfarenhet inom dataanalys/BI i affärsnära roll
Mycket goda kunskaper i Power BI, från datamodellering till dashboard-design
Mycket goda kunskaper i statistisk analys och metoder
Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL.
Erfarenhet av Python, dbt, samt Azure, Databricks eller andra moderna data- och analysplattformar är meriterande
Erfarenhet av att omvandla affärsbehov till datadrivna lösningar som skapar konkret affärsnytta
Förmåga att uttrycka dig väl på svenska och engelska både i tal och skrift


Vi söker dig som har hög kapacitet, stark analytisk förmåga och vilja att bidra till ett team där ansvar, lärande och gemensam utveckling är viktiga delar av vardagen.

För att lyckas i rollen kombinerar du stark analytisk och teknisk kompetens med ett stort intresse för kund- och affärsnära frågor. Du uppskattar att själv arbeta hands-on med data, analys och visualisering samtidigt som du kan lyfta blicken, förstå verksamhetens behov och bidra till att sätta riktning och prioriteringar.

Om oss | Skapa värde med data i stark gemenskap

Trygg-Hansa är en av Sveriges mest välkända försäkringsaktörer och en del av Tryg-koncernen, en av Nordens största försäkringsgrupper. Hos oss får du arbeta i en verksamhet där data, analys och kundinsikter spelar en allt viktigare roll för hur vi utvecklar affären och skapar värde för våra kunder. Vår kultur bygger på tillit, ansvarstagande och att skapa utveckling tillsammans, och vi tror att de bästa resultaten skapas när olika kompetenser och perspektiv får bidra – vi vet att olika erfarenheter och arbetssätt stärker vår förmåga att fatta bättre beslut. Därför arbetar vi aktivt för en inkluderande kultur där fler kan komma till sin rätt och göra ett hållbart och meningsfullt arbete.

Här kan du läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss, möta några av dina framtida kollegor och ta del av mer information om våra medarbetarförmåner.

Ansökan | Vi ser fram emot att höra av dig

Välkommen med din ansökan via länken nedan. Då urvalet sker löpande ser vi gärna att du inkommer med din ansökan snarast möjligt, dock senast 2026-08-30.

Vid frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Frank Svensson på via mail: frank.svensson@trygghansa.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Slutkandidaten kommer att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll.

Vi undanber oss kontakt från rekryteringsföretag angående våra annonserade roller.

Title: Analytics Consultant
Description:
Insights & Analysis

Apply Now

Stockholm

About The Job

Data & Analytics Consultant – Merkle Sweden, a dentsu company

Om rollen

Vi söker nu en Data & Analytics Consultant med ett stort intresse för data, analys och digital utveckling. I den här rollen blir du en viktig rådgivare för våra kunder och hjälper dem att samla in, förstå och aktivera data från digitala kanaler för att skapa bättre kundupplevelser och starkare affärsresultat.

Du blir en del av vårt Data & Analytics-team i Stockholm eller Göteborg och arbetar nära både kunder och kollegor inom olika specialistområden.
