Title: Nätanalytiker
Description:
Är du redo för att hänga med på vår spännande resa? Ellevio är ett av Sveriges största energibolag och tillsammans fortsätter vi att elektrifiera Sverige. Hos oss är du del av en trygg och viktig framtidsbransch samtidigt som du får möjlighet att göra skillnad, växa som individ och ha riktigt kul på vägen! Vi tror på en ljus och hållbar framtid, gör du?

Om rollen som Nätanalytiker

För att möjliggöra energiomställningen och möta framtidens behov av el krävs en djupare förståelse för hur elnätet behöver utvecklas för att möta förändrade laster och nya produktionskällor, såsom sol- och vindkraft. I rollen som Nätanalytiker kommer du att spela en central roll i att analysera och prognostisera var kapacitetsbegränsningar uppstår och hur de kan hanteras genom nätutveckling och flexibilitet. Du kommer att arbeta med att analysera och visualisera kapacitetsbehov samt utvärdera flexibilitetslösningar, både tekniskt och ekonomiskt.

En viktig del av arbetet är att visualisera och kommunicera dessa insikter till verksamheten, för att stödja beslut kring investeringar, drift och underhåll. Du kommer att arbeta i nära samarbete med verksamhetsutvecklare, data engineers och andra tekniska experter för att analysera elnätets framtida behov och leverera relevanta analyser och beslutsunderlag till verksamheten. Du kan även komma att ha kontakt med motsvarande funktioner hos andra nätägare.

Till din hjälp har du en modern analysplattform samt analysverktyg som Power BI, SQL och Python, men i denna roll ligger fokus också på systemanalys, att förstå och utveckla verksamhetens analysbehov samt strategisk planering.

Nyfiken på rollen och hur vi arbetar med analys?

Här kan du träffa några av våra medarbetare och få en inblick i rollen och hur vi arbetar med analys hos oss. Läs mer och se filmen här: Ellevio | Karriär | Dataanalys

För att du ska passa och trivas i rollen

Vi söker dig som har en ingenjörsutbildning, gärna inom energisystem eller elkraft, alternativt annan högre utbildning med dataanalys- eller analysinriktning, kombinerad med erfarenhet av elnätsverksamhet.

Det viktigaste är att du har en stark analytisk förmåga och ett intresse för elnätets roll i energiomställningen. Du har erfarenhet av kapacitetsanalyser, dataanalys eller annat arbete där du har analyserat elnätets behov och utveckling.

Du har ett systemperspektiv och förstår hur olika delar av elnätet hänger ihop, från produktion och konsumtion till styrning, investeringar och underhåll. Du deltar gärna i eller leder utvecklingsprojekt och är van att kommunicera och visualisera komplexa analyser på ett pedagogiskt sätt. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt och av att arbeta iterativt med utveckling av analyser och lösningar.

Du trivs i en roll med stor frihet att forma ditt arbete, men där mål och prioriteringar kan skifta över tid. För rollen krävs att du har god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Ellevio som arbetsgivare

På Ellevio får du möjlighet att utvecklas, påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt. Vi tror på nyfikenhet, samarbete och kontinuerligt lärande – och tillsammans arbetar vi för en ljus och hållbar framtid. Ett fint bevis på det är att vi 2026 blivit utnämnda till Karriärföretag - för sjätte året i rad!

Hos oss är jämställdhet, mångfald och inkludering en självklar del av vardagen. Genom initiativ som ELLE-nätet (Ellevios interna kvinnliga nätverk) och utbildningar inom kollektiv intelligens skapar vi förutsättningar för ett öppet och utvecklande arbetsklimat.

Våra kontor är viktiga mötesplatser för samarbete, innovation och kulturbyggande. Du förväntas därför tillbringa merparten av din arbetstid på kontoret. Vi erbjuder samtidigt ett flexibelt arbetssätt som värnar om en god balans i vardagen samt många andra fina förmåner.

Vid frågor är du varmt välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Henrik Rinnemo på henrik.rinnemo@ellevio.se

Vid frågor gällande ansökningsprocessen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Gabriella Boumadi på gabriella.boumadi@ellevio.se

På B3 Indes förvandlar vi data till värdefulla insikter som driver förändring och innovation. Vi skapar lösningar inom AI, Business Intelligence, Data Science och Automation för att maximera värdet av data och stärka företags konkurrenskraft. Vår styrka ligger i att kombinera passion för AI och data med en stark laganda, där vi stöttar varandra och löser utmaningar tillsammans.

Rollen som konsult inom Power BI på B3:

Hos oss får du chansen att jobba med några av Sveriges mest spännande kunder och projekt. Vad innebär det? Jo, att du får:


Gräva i data och hitta insikter som inte bara hjälper våra kunder – utan kanske till och med gör världen lite bättre.
Göra företag mer datadrivna och smartare genom att guida dem i rätt riktning.
Utforma effektiva visualiseringar som våra kunder kan agera på.
Bygga och implementera avancerade lösningar – och faktiskt se dem göra skillnad!


Här handlar det inte bara om teknik – det handlar om att modellera, tillgängliggöra och visualisera data som kan skapa verklig förändring. Vi gillar att tänka stort, experimentera och lösa kluriga problem tillsammans. Och det bästa? Du får ett team av grymma kollegor att bolla idéer med, lära dig av och ha kul ihop med!

Det är din passion för data och analys som gör skillnaden. Utöver det ser vi gärna:


Har du en relevant universitetsutbildning? Toppen! Har du kanske skaffat motsvarande kunskaper genom arbetslivserfarenhet? Det funkar lika bra!
Minst 4 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet – vi letar efter någon som har hunnit samla på sig en del erfarenhet inom området.
Flytande svenska och engelska – eftersom båda språken används dagligen i arbetet.
Tidigare konsultroller är ett plus! Har du jobbat som konsult tidigare? Då är det en extra merit, men inget krav.


Men framför allt...

Har du djup erfarenhet av Power BI och DAX? Grymt – det är viktigt! Men vi lägger också stor vikt vid din förmåga att se helheten, skapa användbara lösningar men framför allt att du är nyfiken. Om du dessutom har koll på:


Någon av de vanligaste databaserna och molntjänsterna
Kanske har du också koll på någon av de andra vanligaste BI-verktygQen (ex; Qlik eller Tableau)
Snowflake och/eller Databricks
Informationsmodellering och Dimensionsmodellering
DevOps och Visual Studio.


Är det här ett stort plus!

Varför välja B3 Indes?

💡 Utveckling & karriär – Väx i en entreprenörsdriven miljö där din kompetens får ta plats.

🌿 Balans & välmående – Vi värnar om ditt välbefinnande med stöd för wellness och en flexibel vardag.

🚀 Energi & gemenskap – Här präglas kulturen av öppenhet, nyfikenhet och en passion för att skapa något större – tillsammans.

❤️ Vi bryr oss – på riktigt – Vi engagerar oss i samhällsfrågor och samarbetar med initiativ som Suicide Zero, My Dream Now och Pink Programming för att göra skillnad även utanför arbetslivet.

En arbetsplats som gör skillnad:

Vi är stolta över att ha utsetts till ett av Sveriges fem främsta karriärföretag 2025 – en utmärkelse som speglar vår energi, nyfikenhet och vårt engagemang för att skapa en inkluderande och inspirerande arbetsplats. Här värdesätts olika perspektiv och idéer, och vi tror att det är just det som gör oss starkare.

Title: CS Data Operation Manager (1 year temp)
Description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.  

We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a CS Data Operation Manager in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change? 

(Note that this is a temporary employment for 1 year)

The role 

As a CS Data Operations Manager, you will drive data-informed decision making across the Customer Service organization by managing reporting, forecasting, KPI tracking, and financial follow-up. You will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that support operational performance, strategic planning, and continuous improvement initiatives. You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across Customer Service and the wider business, providing meaningful analysis and recommendations that drive business outcomes.

What we’re looking for 

Role

We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have at least some experience in the following:


You are a curious, analytical, and data-driven person who loves turning numbers into insights and insights into action. You enjoy digging into data, spotting trends, and finding opportunities to improve both performance and ways of working.
You are comfortable working with reporting, forecasting, KPIs, and financial follow-up, and you can translate complex data into clear and useful insights for different stakeholders. You take ownership of your work, are highly organized, and enjoy improving processes, dashboards, and tools along the way.
We believe you are a great communicator and a collaborative team player who is also comfortable working independently. Most importantly, you are proactive, solution-oriented, and always looking for ways to make things better.


It’s a bonus if you have: 


Experience in Excel and PowerPoint
A good understanding of data visualization
Understanding what metrics are relevant and why
Experience in customer service and working with BPOs
5+ years of experience in a data analyst position


What we offer you

We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.

Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.

A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.

Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including series & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.

Hit play today 

If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position. 

Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

Title: Dataanalytiker med fokus på register inom kemiområdet
Description:
Om arbetsplatsen

Kemikalieinspektionen är en statlig myndighet som har i uppdrag att minska riskerna för att människor och miljö skadas av kemikalier. Som medarbetare hos oss är du en del av ett betydelsefullt arbete för hållbar utveckling i Sverige, inom EU och globalt. Vi är 280 medarbetare och vårt kontor ligger i centrala Sundbyberg.

Enheten ansvarar för registret och alla dess arbetsmoment. Du kommer delta i många delar av dataprocessen, från datainsamling till databearbetning, kvalitetsarbete, tillhandahålla data i form av underlag, rapporter och tolkning av data. En viktig del av arbetet är att utveckla arbetssätt och data i registret. Du kommer samarbeta med hela enheten, där vi gemensamt tar ansvar för vårt register och dess kvalitet. Du kommer ha en annan dataanalytiker med kemikunskaper som kollega.

Vi befinner oss i en fas där fokus ligger på att bygga ordning och kvalitet i data och här får du möjlighet att delta i att forma och utveckla verksamheten tillsammans med dina kollegor.

Arbetsuppgifter

Du kommer att arbeta med:


att designa, tillhandahålla och utveckla register inom ämnesområdet kemikalier
att samarbeta med verksamheten, förvaltningsledare, enhetschef för att identifiera möjligheter till förbättringar, föreslå ändringar och utveckla kvalitet, innehåll och arbetssätt
systematiskt kvalitetsarbete
programmeringsspråk, främst SQL
att tillgängliggöra data för verksamhetens behov, t.ex. säkra tillgången på data till den officiella statistiken, mätetal och olika kunskapsunderlag
att skapa lämplig dokumentation som gör det möjligt för intressenter att förstå stegen i dataanalysprocessen och duplicera eller replikera analysen vid behov
kravställning och testning inom förvaltningsobjektet
att följa utvecklingen inom området och bidra med omvärldsbevakning
vid behov bistå i övriga uppgifter på enheten


Beroende på aktuella uppdrag och din bakgrund så kan uppgifterna komma att innehålla utredningsuppgifter, hantering och analys av inkommande data och statistik om användning av kemikalier, sammanställningar, visualisering av data och sammanhang/trender.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig om har:


akademisk examen med inriktning mot datavetenskap, systemvetenskap, statistik eller motsvarande som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant
några års relevant aktuell arbetslivserfarenhet, t.ex. datahantering, databaser, dataanalys, administrering av stora datamängder
några års aktuell erfarenhet av databearbetning med hjälp av SQL
god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift, både på svenska och engelska


Det är meriterande om du har:


Erfarenhet av arbete med underhåll och utveckling av register
Erfarenhet av förvaltning av databassystem och analys från andra statistikproducerande organisationer
Erfarenhet av att ta fram statistikunderlag, generera rapporter, utrednings/projektarbete eller visualisering av data
Erfarenhet av arbete med Business intelligence
Ämneskunskap inom kemi- eller miljöområdet


Övrig information

På Kemikalieinspektionen är varje medarbetare viktig för att vi som myndighet ska fungera och vi värnar därför om din hälsa och arbetsmiljö. Hos oss tas dina kunskaper till vara och du har stora möjligheter att utvecklas.

Vi förväntar oss att alla medarbetare bidrar till ett gott arbetsklimat och förstår sin roll som statstjänsteman i vårt gemensamma uppdrag.

Du arbetar och agerar efter vår medarbetarpolicy och vår värdegrund. Vi bedriver också ett målinriktat arbete för lika rättigheter och möjligheter.

Utifrån verksamhetens behov finns möjlighet, efter överenskommelse med chef, att arbeta del av arbetstiden på distans.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Stories have the power to make the ordinary extraordinary. They help us think bigger, see beyond ourselves, and deepen our connection with others.

As one of the world’s leading audiobook and e-book streaming platforms, Storytel brings unlimited listening to millions of users across 25 markets. We’re at the forefront of digital storytelling, driven by a vision to make the world a more empathetic and creative place.

Ready for your next chapter? We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join the team in Stockholm.

About The Team

We are proud of our ability to combine technical expertise with sound business sense. This translates to solutions that are not only effective in addressing current challenges but also sustainable long term. Our team is composed of Analytics Engineers and Data Engineers, fostering a collaborative environment that enables us to manage data end to end – from optimizing data pipelines to developing user-friendly models for analysis.

Our technology stack includes BigQuery (SQL), Looker, dbt™, and Google Cloud Platform, with opportunities to evaluate and introduce new technologies as we scale.

About The Role

As an Analytics Engineer, you'll work with developing data capabilities that power decisions across our global organization. You'll have significant technical and organizational impact, driving both immediate solutions and long-term strategic initiatives.

Examples Of Responsibilities


Develop data transformation steps and build a strong data modeling foundation for enabling self-service analytics across the company.
Build and maintain trusting, working relationships with business partners across domains and discover high-impact opportunities to enable self-service analytics in our semantic layer.
Strategically plan and deliver meaningful projects to increase data literacy at Storytel.
Lead the resolution of critical data issues, establishing monitoring systems and best practices to prevent future problems and improve data reliability.
Collaborate with data practitioners to understand their needs and requirements, breaking down complicated technical concepts to fit the audience.
Drive adoption of technical best practices across the data team, mentoring others and bringing in industry innovations that improve how we work.



We believe that you have


Experience with creating and maintaining semantic layers.
Experience in working with data (BI/Analytics/Data Engineering) specializing within Analytics Engineering.
Deep expertise in SQL and data modeling and extensive experience with modern data stack technologies (e.g., dbt™, Looker, BigQuery, or equivalent tools).
The ability to consistently deliver performant, accurate, and scalable solutions.
Experience mentoring junior engineers and driving team-wide technical improvements.
Proven ability to lead complex data projects, solve problems independently, and proactively improve products.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to various audiences.
The ability to thrive in a feedback culture and constantly strive to improve your own skills and knowledge.



Bonus If You Experience


Working with Python.
With data governance and access management.
With different data modeling schemas.
Working with international teams and global data operations.



Join a world of stories

At Storytel, we’re a team of creative story lovers who thrive on collaboration and new ideas. Our workplace is friendly, dynamic, and full of opportunities to experiment and make an impact. We believe in trust, flat hierarchies, and empowering you to grow with us.

Does this sound like your next story? Simply fill out the application form and share your CV or LinkedIn profile – no cover letter needed. Answer a few questions, and you’re all set.

Does this sound like you? If you feel like Storytel is a place where you could thrive, please submit your application in English and we will contact you as soon as possible.

Title: Data engineer
Description:
Vill du använda din kompetens och ditt engagemang till att skapa digitala lösningar för Skolsektorn i Sverige, samtidigt som du bidrar till Skolverkets digitala utveckling? Vi söker dig som är en erfaren och driven data engineer som kan arbeta både strategiskt och operativt med fokus på datalager och integration. Var med och bidra till skolans framtid!

Om jobbet

Hos oss är arbete med data och analys centralt. Vi vill utöka vår förmåga inom dataintag och dataanalys och där har du en viktig roll. Som data engineer bidrar du både operativt och taktiskt till vår digitala förflyttning inom datalager, datahantering, och dataanalys samt tillhörande integrationsarkitektur. Du arbetar praktiskt med att analysera behov, utforma lösningar och omsätta dem i genomförbara strukturer inom datalager och integration.

Du förenar verksamhetsförståelse och teknisk bredd genom att identifiera behov, analysera förutsättningar och ta fram hållbara lösningsförslag och strukturer anpassade till olika sammanhang. Du är också delaktig i att utforma de lösningar som Skolverket erbjuder skolväsendet, med fokus på att utveckla lösningar för datahantering med direkt verksamhetsvärde.

Du bidrar även aktivt till Skolverkets digitala utvecklingsarbete. Tillsammans med kollegorna inom datafunktionen säkerställer du kvalitet, konsistens och integritet i myndighetens centrala dataobjekt.

Du arbetar i ett tvärfunktionellt team där andra data engineers, informations- och dataarkitekter ingår. Du har även ett nära samarbete med kollegorna inom enheten, avdelningen och andra delar av Skolverket samt externa kontakter. Det här är en roll för dig som trivs i en föränderlig miljö där allt inte är färdigt.

* * * * *

”Som en del av vårt team får du inte bara möjlighet att använda din tekniska expertis, utan även vara med och bidra till utveckling av information- och datahantering internt på myndigheten och på nationell nivå. Vi ser fram emot att välkomna en ny kollega som delar vårt engagemang för att skapa nytta och förbättringar för våra användare.”


Robert Modén , enhetschef


* * * * *

Du tillhör Enheten för förvaltning och systemutveckling inom it-avdelningen. På vår it-avdelning jobbar drygt 100 personer med att säkerställa en fungerande och säker it-miljö samt med att stötta verksamheten genom utveckling och förvaltning av it-stöd, infrastruktur och arbetssätt för digital utveckling.

Du arbetar på vårt moderna och rymliga kontor i Solna Business Park. Du kan också ha möjlighet att arbeta upp till 50% på distans.

Om dig

För att göra ett bra jobb och trivas hos oss behöver du stå för och leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden och till våra kärnvärden för medarbetarskap: förebild, tillit, ansvar, samarbete och utveckling. Läs mer på www.skolverket.se/jobb

I det här jobbet ska du ha


eftergymnasial utbildning inom it eller annan utbildning i kombination med erfarenhet som Skolverket bedömer är relevant,
mycket goda kunskaper om datamodellering med fokus på både datalager och generell systemdesign,
kunskap om olika relevanta tekniker samt förståelse för deras för- och nackdelar,
minst fem års aktuell erfarenhet av att arbeta med systemutveckling i Python,
erfarenhet av utveckling och orkestrering av datapipelines i Python,
minst fem års erfarenhet av att bygga och underhålla stabila data pipelines i olika miljöer,
praktisk erfarenhet av att analysera verksamhetens behov av data för utveckling av rapportlösningar,
relevant erfarenhet av arbete med datastrukturer, algoritmer och principer för mjukvaruutveckling,
god erfarenhet av SQL och arbete med komplexa datamängder,
god erfarenhet av mönster för datainhämtning (datainläsningsarkitektur),
mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift samt goda kunskaper i engelska.


Det är meriterande att du har erfarenhet av containerbaserade lösningar, exempelvis Docker eller Kubernetes, erfarenhet av att sätta upp målgruppsanpassade visualiseringar i Power BI eller motsvarande verktyg samt erfarenhet av arbete i offentlig sektor eller med stora, komplexa informationsmiljöer.

Som person behöver du


ha en god förmåga att analysera behov och omsätta dessa i hållbara och relevanta lösningsförslag,
ha ett driv att nå resultat,
god förmåga att planera ditt arbete,
vara bra på att samarbeta och bygga förtroende i gränssnittet mellan verksamhet och teknik


Viktigt att veta

Sista ansökningsdag är 8 september. Anställningen är tillsvidare och inleds med provanställning i sex månader.

När du registrerar din ansökan får du svara på några frågor i stället för att bifoga ett personligt brev. Läs gärna igenom ansökningsformuläret och förbered dina svar innan du gör ansökan.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.

Role Summary

As Business & Project Analyst, you will support the development and transformation of P&C Service Operations and our global Knowledge Centre organisation. You will analyse operational, financial, workforce and service data and translate your findings into clear recommendations. The role includes developing business cases and assessing new or changed services to support fact-based decisions and sustainable implementation. This is a global role, and we welcome candidates from different locations within the organization.

Job Responsibilities



Conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis and prepare clear recommendations and decision material.
Develop business cases, cost-benefit assessments and financial and resource scenarios.
Assess service scope, volumes, complexity, capabilities, dependencies, costs and expected benefits.
Analyse workforce capacity and operational performance to identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities.
Develop dashboards and management reports and coordinate input across functions, Knowledge Centres and programme teams.



Who You Are



At least 3 years of experience in business analysis, financial analysis, controlling, consulting, shared services, or a similar analytical role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Advanced Excel skills and experience working with data analysis, reporting, and decision-support materials.
Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and engage with stakeholders in an international environment.
A relevant university degree or equivalent professional experience.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Experience with Power BI is considered an advantage.
Knowledge of P&C, transformation initiatives, service implementation, or shared service operations is beneficial.



This Is Us

You will join Program Delivery within P&C Service Operations and work closely with our global programme, functions and Knowledge Centres. Together, we develop scalable and sustainable services for Scania’s global P&C organisation. We work in an international and collaborative environment where analysis and insights directly support business decisions and future ways of working.

Scania Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.

Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-09-10. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Charlotte Qvick - Program Delivery Manager- charlotte.qvick@scania.com or Monika Ciecholewska - Recruiter - monika.ciecholewska@scania.com

We look forward to your application!

Title: Quantitative Risk Analyst, Credit Risk Data Management [Assistant/Regular/Senior]
Description:
Job ID: 5814

We are looking for Quantitative Risk Analyst [Assistant/Regular/Senior] from all background and level to join our Risk Models Data and Strategy teams that is recognized for its professionalism, competence and capabilities.

Do you enjoy working with data analysis? Do you like solving problems and finding new and innovative solutions? Do you understand the principles of banking and are you able to apply this knowledge in your daily work?

If you have previous experience with Credit Risk models, then great! If you have a flair for data and a genuine interest in analysis, you are also welcome!

About Our Team

Meet the Credit Risk Data Management, a part of the Risk Models Data & Strategy organization in Risk Models. We have an ambitious development plan for development of IRB models and together with our colleagues in Nordea we’ll be part of creating the future of banking.

The Risk Models Data & Strategy department, is a department consisting of 6 team, each specialized in their own part of ensuring high quality data is supporting the bank capital foundation. We add value to Nordea and our customers by improving Nordea data quality, helping visualizing and create the understanding of our data so modelling teams can build great internal models used for Own Funds calculation and the for risk management.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Quantitative Risk Analyst, the specific role may vary based on qualifications, but you could i.e. play a valuable role in Data analytics, optimizing data flows, product management or as a data governance specialist. Your role could also include coordinating data related activities and ensuring proper communication within the teams and across other Risk Models areas.

Main responsibilities in this role:


Root-cause analysis for data quality issues, where we meticulously investigate and identify the underlying reasons for any discrepancies in our data. This is closely followed by data reconciliation, ensuring that our data sets are consistent and accurate across different sources.
We focus on optimizing data flows and algorithms to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our data processes.
Own and manage all data used in credit risk models across the end-to-end lifecycle, applying data product mindset to capture, enhance and realize value throughout credit risk models.
Identify and govern critical data elements though strong knowledge of credit risk models, regulatory expectation and capital.
Secure our Data Governance framework and processes with focus on effective Data Quality Controls, also ensuring documentation of Data Lineage toward all data providers and consumers for credit risk data.
Preparing reports and other documentation for senior management and external reporting is also an integral part of our role, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making.


You’ll join an international team with variety of backgrounds and skills. We believe that strong drive and passion for change are fundamental for delivering on our commitments. Bring your background and skills to our team, and you will have plenty of opportunities to collaborate, grow and develop.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you:


Have an adaptability to thrive in fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Are structured and able to coordinate several deliveries simultaneously.
Are self-driven and able to work independently but also enjoy collaboration with others.
Have strong analytical skills and keen attention to detail with the ability to analyse complex data and processes to derive meaningful insights.
Have good communication and presentations skills, are not afraid to speak up and can effectively convey business requirements to IT teams and facilitate collaboration between stakeholders.
Are curious and proactive, focus on solutions rather than problems and share our enthusiasm for developing and learning and constantly improving your skills and competences.


Your background and skills include:


Experience with Credit Risk modeling, capital reporting, and understanding regulatory requirements as BCBS239 and TRIM.
Knowledge of SQL, SAS, Snowflake, Python or similar.
Master’s degree in finance, economics, engineering, physics, mathematics or similar.
A strong focus on results, deliveries and deadlines.
Experience with Big Data would be an asset.
An interest in finance and technology.


What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 09/09/2026.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

Title: Total Rewards Analyst
Description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.


We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role

As Total Rewards Analyst, you'll be the analytical backbone of Legora's reward function — turning data into insight across compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility. You'll work directly within the Total Rewards team, reporting to the VP of Total Rewards, and collaborate closely with the Total Rewards Manager.

This is a role for someone who is energised by making sense of complex data, building robust processes, and making sure every part of our reward engine runs smoothly and accurately.

What You Will Do


Build and maintain reward reporting and dashboards covering compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility — enabling the team and leadership to make data-informed decisions.
Support compensation benchmarking cycles: gather and clean market data, model scenarios, and present findings clearly.
Analyse equity data to track grant activity, vesting milestones, and programme performance across regions.
Build and improve People operations processes across the reward function — creating workflows and documentation that reduce manual effort and increase accuracy.
Support the administration of benefits programmes across markets, coordinating with external vendors and ensuring data accuracy.
Support the mobility programme operationally — coordinating documentation, timelines, and third-party providers.
Help prepare materials for employee and manager communications on compensation, benefits, and equity topics, and contribute to reward-related compliance activities as needed.


Who You Are

You love digging into data to find patterns and build clarity out of complexity. You're a natural problem-solver with a keen eye for process, accuracy, and making things run better.

We Think You'll Thrive Here If You Have


3–5 years of experience in a People, Reward, Finance, or Operations analyst role — ideally in a high-growth or international environment.
Strong analytical skills with experience handling complex datasets; proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets is essential, and experience with HRIS or reward tools is a plus.
Familiarity with compensation frameworks, equity programmes, or benefits administration — even if not a specialist in all areas.
High attention to detail and comfort working with sensitive, confidential data.
A process-builder mindset: you don't just do the work, you look for ways to make the work better.
Clear and confident communicator, able to present data and findings simply to a range of stakeholders.


Why Legora

This is an exceptional opportunity to grow within a reward function that's building from the ground up. You'll gain broad exposure across every dimension of total rewards — compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility — while working alongside experienced people leaders in a company with real momentum.

We value clarity, humility, and impact. Your work will directly support the team that shapes how every Legora employee is rewarded. We're just getting started.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
At Strawberry, we don’t just run hotels, we’re building a universe of experiences. We are rewriting the hospitality playbook through tech and innovation, and data is the engine powering it all.

We’re looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our central Tech BI team. You’ll sit right at the heart of our tech transformation, building scalable datasets and data models that power business decisions, digital products and AI solutions.

If you’re excited about the modern data stack, obsessed with clean architecture, and eager to leverage AI to push the boundaries of traditional BI, Welcome Home.

Our Tech Stack


Data Warehouse: Snowflake
Transformation & Governance: dbt
Orchestration: Apache Airflow
Cloud & DevOps: Cloud Platforms (Azure / AWS / GCP), Git, CI/CD
Languages: SQL, Python


You won't just be maintaining pipelines, As part of our central Tech BI team, you’ll build and evolve the shared data platform while enabling Data Product Teams across the business to deliver trusted, high-quality data products.

Working with our modern data stack, you’ll transform raw, complex data into scalable data models that power business decisions, digital products and AI solutions.

You’ll work at the intersection of our central data platform and our Data Product Teams, enabling reliable data foundations while supporting business-specific data products. As we continue investing in AI, you’ll help build trusted data foundations that enable analytics, automation and future AI solutions.

What You’ll Do


Core Platform Ownership: Build, maintain, and optimize the core datasets, transformations and pipelines that power our enterprise data platform.
Partner with Data Product Teams: Work closely with cross-functional Data Product teams aligned directly with the business to deliver tailored datasets, analytics solutions, and actionable insights.
Own the Data Lifecycle: Design and implement scalable data models in Snowflake, leveraging dbt for transformations, testing, documentation and version controlling.
Build Robust ELT Workflows: Develop, orchestrate, and optimize reliable data pipelines using Airflow to seamlessly integrate diverse source systems.
Drive AI & Innovation: Partner with engineering and product teams to build trusted data foundations that enable advanced analytics, AI solutions and new data products.
Code & Automate: Use Python to build data pipelines, automate workflows and integrate source systems.
Ensure Quality & Documentation: Ensure data assets are monitored, documented and easy for others to understand and reuse.


What You Bring


Proven Track Record: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, BI, or Data Architecture.
Core Tech Expertise: Strong proficiency in SQL, deep experience with Snowflake, and hands-on expertise with dbt and Airflow.
Programming & Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for data manipulation, workflow automation, and integrations.
Cloud & Platform Mindset: Good understanding of cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and modern CI/CD/Git practices.
Business & Product Alignment: Experience or interest in collaborating directly with product teams and business stakeholders to solve real-world problems.
Collaboration & Communication: Humble, curious, and collaborative. You communicate clearly in English, ask great questions, and leave your ego at the door.
Education: BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).


What’s In It For You?


Real Impact: High visibility, strong autonomy, and a flat culture where your ideas actually get built.
Growth & Learning: Space and resources to level up your skills in modern data stack practices and AI.
Unbeatable Perks: Deep discounts on hotel stays, dining, and experiences for you, your friends, and your family across the Strawberry universe.
Vibrant Culture: A fun, passionate team with regular social events, team activities, and a passion for celebrating wins.
Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy a balanced work model with 3 days of high-energy collaboration at our sleek Stockholm HQ and 2 days working from home.


(Please note: This role is based in our Stockholm office. Candidates must be local or ready to relocate to Stockholm, as we do not offer fully remote setups.)

Ready to build something iconic?

Don't just wait, we review applications continuously and are eager to meet you! Apply today.

Title: Staff AI Product Analyst, Product Management | Sweden | Remote
Description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the UK, Germany, Sweden or Spain.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Staff Product Analyst to join our growing Product Analytics team and serve as a strategic partner to Grafana’s AI organization. This role will support the teams building Grafana Assistant, our synchronous chat experience; Investigations, our asynchronous AI workflow for incident analysis; and AI observability solutions, including Agent Observability.

You will shape how the AI team measures success by defining KPIs, improving measurement practices, guiding experiment design and evaluation, and translating data into recommendations that influence product decisions.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, and Data partners, with a primary focus on supporting the AI team, and report to the Product Analytics Manager

If you’re excited about building strong product analytics capabilities and using data to shape the future of AI-powered experiences at Grafana, we’d love to hear from you.

You Will


Partner cross functionally across Product to establish top-level KPIs, dashboards, and product roadmap planning
Define how success is measured for AI-powered product experiences, including adoption, engagement, quality, retention, and user outcomes
Guide the instrumentation of product data in collaboration with our Product Design, Product Management, and Engineering teams to enable reliable analysis of AI features and workflows.
Design, evaluate, and interpret experiments to assess the impact of new AI capabilities and inform product decisions.
Develop dbt models to transform and test our user behavior data in partnership with our Analytics Engineering team
Influence best practices for Product Analytics across teams and help define standards as the company scales
Contribute to defining the long-term vision and strategy for Product Analytics, balancing near-term needs with scalable, durable solutions.



You have


Experience partnering across product and engineering organizations, and familiarity with typical product KPIs and frameworks (e.g., DAU/MAU, funnels, A/B testing)
Experience defining and tracking success metrics for complex product areas, ideally including AI-powered features or workflows.
SQL: writing complex yet efficient SQL is a daily habit for you
Data Visualization: experience with any of the following tools: Tableau, Looker, Omni, Hex, or of course, Grafana!
Experience writing dbt models, implementing Product Analytics tooling (e.g., Heap, Pendo, Amplitude, FullStory), and code version control (git)
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to quickly prototype and iterate across analysis, data modeling, instrumentation, visualization and code development.
Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical topics to non-technical audiences, and maintain many of the essential cross-team and cross-functional relationships necessary for the team’s success



A plus if you have


Knowledge about observability
Familiarity with Airflow or Prefect - generating ad hoc ETL jobs



In Sweden, the Base compensation range for this role is SEK 775,444 - 930,533. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.


Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs


100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.



Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Till Trygg-Hansa Företagsmarknad söker vi nu en Senior Data Analyst som vill vara med och ta organisationens BI- och analysfunktion till nästa nivå.

Om jobbet | Ta data till insikter som gör skillnad för affären

Som Senior Data Analyst får du en nyckelroll i att driva utvecklingen av BI, analys och datadrivet beslutsfattande inom Företagsmarknad. Du utvecklar moderna rapporterings- och analyslösningar i Power BI och gör data tillgänglig på ett sätt som skapar verkligt affärsvärde. Du arbetar nära beslutsfattare och specialister i verksamheten och omvandlar komplexa affärsfrågeställningar till värdeskapande rapporter, dashboards och dataleveranser som används i det dagliga beslutsfattandet.

Du blir en del av ett erfaret team av analytiker och data scientists som delar kunskap, utmanar varandra konstruktivt och samarbetar tvärfunktionellt med många delar av organisationen. Teamet har ett övergripande ansvar för Företagsmarknads rapportering och analys. Vi utvecklar och förvaltar rapporter och dashboards end-to-end, exempelvis inom försäljning och portföljutveckling. Teamet supporterar också organisationen med data och analys.

Exempel På Ansvarsområden


Identifiera möjligheter att öka användningen av data och BI i verksamheten samt driva förbättringsinitiativ
Omsätta affärsbehov till skalbara analysprodukter, KPI:er och dashboards
Utveckla och vidareutveckla rapporterings- och analyslösningar i Power BI end-to-end
Bygga och förbättra dataflöden samt ETL-processer med moderna tekniker och verktyg
Säkerställa hög användarvänlighet och rätt design i våra rapporter och dashboards
Utveckla ett nära samarbete med stakeholders för att förstå organisationens behov
Ta ägarskap och aktivt bidra i planering av både kort- och långsiktig utveckling
Agera rådgivare till verksamheten i frågor kopplade till analys, rapportering och datadrivet beslutsfattande
Planera och genomföra demo av nya rapporter


Placeringsort är Stockholm och du rapporterar till Chef för Data, Analys & Rapportering.

Om dig | Senior analytiker som skapar insikter och förändring

Det här är en roll för dig som har gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av analys och BI, trivs med stort eget ansvar och vill utveckla lösningar som påverkar både affären, kundvärdet och hur organisationen arbetar med data.

För att kvalificera dig för rollen har du:


Relevant akademisk utbildning inom exempelvis Statistik, Matematik, Datavetenskap, Industriell ekonomi eller annat närliggande område
Minst fem års relevant erfarenhet inom dataanalys/BI i affärsnära roll
Mycket goda kunskaper i Power BI, från datamodellering till dashboard-design
Mycket goda kunskaper i statistisk analys och metoder
Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL.
Erfarenhet av Python, dbt, samt Azure, Databricks eller andra moderna data- och analysplattformar är meriterande
Erfarenhet av att omvandla affärsbehov till datadrivna lösningar som skapar konkret affärsnytta
Förmåga att uttrycka dig väl på svenska och engelska både i tal och skrift


Vi söker dig som har hög kapacitet, stark analytisk förmåga och vilja att bidra till ett team där ansvar, lärande och gemensam utveckling är viktiga delar av vardagen.

För att lyckas i rollen kombinerar du stark analytisk och teknisk kompetens med ett stort intresse för kund- och affärsnära frågor. Du uppskattar att själv arbeta hands-on med data, analys och visualisering samtidigt som du kan lyfta blicken, förstå verksamhetens behov och bidra till att sätta riktning och prioriteringar.

Om oss | Skapa värde med data i stark gemenskap

Trygg-Hansa är en av Sveriges mest välkända försäkringsaktörer och en del av Tryg-koncernen, en av Nordens största försäkringsgrupper. Hos oss får du arbeta i en verksamhet där data, analys och kundinsikter spelar en allt viktigare roll för hur vi utvecklar affären och skapar värde för våra kunder. Vår kultur bygger på tillit, ansvarstagande och att skapa utveckling tillsammans, och vi tror att de bästa resultaten skapas när olika kompetenser och perspektiv får bidra – vi vet att olika erfarenheter och arbetssätt stärker vår förmåga att fatta bättre beslut. Därför arbetar vi aktivt för en inkluderande kultur där fler kan komma till sin rätt och göra ett hållbart och meningsfullt arbete.

Här kan du läsa mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss, möta några av dina framtida kollegor och ta del av mer information om våra medarbetarförmåner.

Ansökan | Vi ser fram emot att höra av dig

Välkommen med din ansökan via länken nedan. Då urvalet sker löpande ser vi gärna att du inkommer med din ansökan snarast möjligt, dock senast 2026-08-30.

Vid frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Frank Svensson på via mail: frank.svensson@trygghansa.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Slutkandidaten kommer att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll.

Vi undanber oss kontakt från rekryteringsföretag angående våra annonserade roller.

Fackliga representanter

Akademikerföreningen: Cecilia Jarlstedt, cecilia.jarlstedt@trygghansa.se

Forena: Elias Bakk, elias.bakk@trygghansa.se

Title: Data Analytics Engineer
Description:
Are you ready to be a key contributor within the Data & Analytics Engineering department at NOBA Bank Group? Your focus will be on advancing analytics capabilities, optimizing data workflows, driving innovation in the cloud, and unlocking the full potential of the organization’s most valuable asset – data.

About The Role

The Data & Analytics Engineering department comprises specialized teams focused on Data Infrastructure Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Data Management.

As a Data Analytics Engineer, you'll play a central role in building and optimizing the organization's supporting analytics layer, collaborating across the bank. This role offers broad opportunities to grow and make a tangible impact!

We offer a hybrid working model with two common in-office days. While we value flexibility, we also prioritize collaboration, team-building, and enjoying fikas and after-work gatherings together!

Main Tasks


Design and implement efficient data models, focusing on analytics workflows and end-user usability.
Build robust and scalable data pipelines to support business intelligence and analytics needs.
Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, such as Risk, Finance, and IT, to ensure data solutions align with business needs.
Ensure data quality, security, and compliance throughout the analytics lifecycle.
Drive technical improvements, introducing modern tools and processes to enhance analytics capabilities.
Partner with other engineers to align transformation processes for analytics purposes.


We Are Looking For Someone Who

Enjoys working with data & analytics engineering, modern data practices, and creating insights that drive decisions. We believe you are a detail-oriented and proactive person who thrives in a high pace enviroment and enjoy learning new technologies. You approach challenges with a “can-do” attitude and excel in analytical thinking and problem-solving.

For This Role You’ll Need


Work experience in a similar role within data engineering or analytics engineering
An academic degree related to analytics engineering, data engineering, or similar fields.
Proficiency in ETL processes, designing analytics-ready datasets, and ensuring clean and usable data for stakeholders.
Proficiency in Databricks, dbt (SQL), python and related reporting tools and languages.
Experience with Power BI or similar BI tools.
Fluency in English is required, along with fluency in either Swedish or Norwegian.


It’s a Plus If You Have


Experience with Microsoft’s data stack (Azure, SQL, and other cloud services).
Experience working with on-prem solutions.
A background in data roles within the financial sector.
Knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies.


Our Offer To You


Freedom with Responsibility: Flexible working arrangements to suit your work style.
Career Development: Opportunities to grow and develop in your role.
Feedback Culture: A supportive environment that encourages open communication.
Coaching Leadership: Managers who guide and support your career journey.
A Caring Company Culture: We genuinely care about each other!


In addition to this, it is important to us that you recognize yourself in our values: we are wholehearted, we collaborate and we take the lead.

Title: Analytics Engineer Stockholm
Description:
Jobbeskrivning

Som Analytics Engineer på Sopra Steria får du möjlighet att arbeta med spännande och uppdrag hos ledande företag och organisationer, både inom offentlig och privat sektor. Tillsammans med engagerade kollegor bygger du lösningar som stärker samhällsfunktioner och förbättrar vardagen för tusentals människor. Genom dina goda tekniska kunskaper och din förståelse för verksamheten skapar du stort värde hos våra kunder. Du arbetar med modern dataanalys och BI-utveckling i Power BI samt den bakomliggande dataplattformen, och bidrar till utvecklingen av framtidssäkrade analyslösningar. En viktig del av rollen är att förstå verksamhetens behov och säkerställa att dessa ligger till grund för utveckling av rapporter och den bakomliggande datan. Vidare tillgängliggör du data för verksamheten genom analys, visualisering och strategisk rådgivning.

Uppdragen genomförs oftast i teamleveranser där du får påverka hela analyskedjan – från datainsamling och modellering till visualisering och beslutsstöd. Hos oss finns ett starkt fokus på kunskapsdelning och utveckling, både tekniskt och som team.

Oavsett om du har några års erfarenhet eller är senior och söker nästa stora utmaning, erbjuder vi en miljö där du får utvecklas och göra skillnad.

Vi tror att du har:


Några års erfarenhet av att jobba i molnet med dataanalys, BI eller data engineering med fokus på Power BI & semantiska modeller.
Jobbat nära verksamheten med att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till analysfunktionalitet.
Erfarenhet av Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse och/eller Azure Databricks.
God förståelse för DAX, SQL och modellering.
Är van vid att arbeta i både svenska och internationella miljöer – du behärskar svenska och engelska flytande i tal och skrift.


Meriterande: Erfarenhet av Python, Qlik, Tableau, Data Engineering, AI och Data Science.

Att jobba på Sopra Steria

Vi växer tillsammans, delar kunskap och har roligt på vägen. Hos oss får du arbeta i spännande projekt på en flexibel arbetsplats med schyssta förmåner. Hos oss är det viktigt att kunna växa i sin roll, och vi avsätter tid för lärande och certifieringar och har ett starkt community för kunskapsdelning. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss här!

Ansök nu – vi ser fram emot att träffa dig!

Vi behandlar ansökningar och kallar till intervju löpande. På Sopra Steria ställer vi höga krav på både kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet hos våra medarbetare. Innan en eventuell anställning kommer du därför att genomgå en bakgrundskontroll, och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation.

Rekryteringsprocessen består av tre intervjuer, personlighet- och logiktest, referenstagning och bakgrundskontroll. Denna kombination av urvalsmetoder ger oss en bredare och mer rättvis bild av dig som kandidat, samtidigt som det säkerställer att både dina tekniska och personliga styrkor kommer till sin rätt. För dig som kandidat innebär det en möjlighet att visa din kompetens och potential från flera perspektiv.

Har du frågor? Hör av dig till:

Victoria Stjernström, Talent Acquisition Partner: v.stjernstroem@soprasteria.com

Joakim Hällgren, Rekryterande chef: joakim.hallgren@soprasteria.com

Samtal från externa rekryteringsföretag och säljare undanbedes.

Title: Analyst
Description:
Analyst | Stockholm




Are you ready to accelerate your career? We are looking for two ambitious Analysts to join our Data & Intelligence team in Stockholm.




In this role, you’ll join an international environment where you won’t just analyze numbers, you’ll contribute to build our culture, drive client decisions, and shape our global business.




Who we are

Allshares is a fast-growing SaaS company and a leading expert in equity and incentive design and management. We provide advanced advisory services, software, and reporting tools to assist over 900 organizations across 60+ countries design, communicate, and manage their employee reward and share-based incentive programs.




Our team of 250+ specialists are located in the US, Finland, Sweden, Portugal, France and Switzerland. We’re dedicated to tailoring the desired incentive models for our clients as well as making compensation strategies simpler and more effective for companies of all sizes. Thanks to our recent growth, and corporate acquisitions, we are even better positioned to support our clients with innovative and scalable solutions.




About the Role

In this entry-level position, you will join an established advisory team driving technical and data-driven execution for clients ranging from high-growth scaleups to global Large Caps.




Your main responsibilities will include:

Research, collect, analyze and package data across our platforms and databases.
Conduct financial modeling, market research and quantitative analysis on equity programs.
Translate data into high-quality dashboards and client-ready presentations.
Taking ownership of workstreams, supported by mentorship from senior team members.
Support in benchmarking of compensation models and simulation of equity programs.




About You

We are looking for a fast-learning, self-driven talent with a practical, hands-on mindset who thrives in an ambitious environment.




To succeed in this role, you must have:

A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or similar field with strong academic results.
An analytical mindset, sharp problem-solving skills, ability to build structured logic and handle complex data with ease.
Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English (our corporate language).
Proactive and collaborative work style as you take ownership of specific tasks while supporting your team.
High adaptability and strong initiative qualities. You stay focused in dynamic environments, manage multiple priorities smoothly, and learn new business contexts fast.




Considered an advantage:

Comfortable presenting materials to senior colleagues and clients.
Expertise in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.




What we’ll offer

A possibility to work in a market leading and ambitious team in a fast growing global SaaS company
Monthly base salary ranging from 36 000 - 43 000 SEK depending on your background and experience
Participation in the company bonus program as decided annually
A benefits package, including wellbeing benefits, comprehensive healthcare, and support for cultural and sports activities
Inclusive international culture and working environment
Company- & team events and activities
Great possibility to develop yourself in the role along with the company’s growth journey

Location: Stockholm

Apply by: On-going recruitment

We look forward to hearing from you. Send in your application today!




Please include a short section in your CV outlining your motivation and why you would be a great addition to our team.

Title: Management Consultant - Data & Analytics
Description:
Your role




Our Data & Analytics (D&A) team combine broad business understanding with technical expertise to help our clients make better data-driven decisions.




Expect to participate in projects ranging from advisory services to hands-on development of D&A solutions. We help our clients define a strategy, organize their D&A capabilities, and implement data platforms and analytical solutions. The analytical work ranges from business intelligence to Machine Learning and Generative AI.




Together with an ambitious and multidisciplinary team of colleagues, you will help our clients understand their current situation, risks, and opportunities and advise how they can use technology to solve their business needs. The type of projects will be varied, and you will have access to experts throughout our international community of consultants.




Your professional and personal growth will be supported by a Development Manager. As you deepen your expertise and grow as a consultant, you will take on greater responsibilities in our client engagements and our internal business activities. Such as team development, employer branding, developing new offerings, pitching to clients, and other activities.




What We Are Looking For In Our New Colleagues




You may have a background as a developer and now want to combine technical work with more business‑focused and strategic responsibilities. Alternatively, you may work in Consulting, have a strong technical interest, and want to deepen your expertise within data and AI.




We Expect Candidates To Have




Experience in data collection and analysis, along with a general understanding of business processes.
Familiarity with Business Intelligence solutions and Generative AI development, as well as programming proficiency in Python and SQL.
Some experience with Database design, ETL, and Data Visualization is also desirable.
Experience with Microsoft´s Data & Analytics tools is a plus (Fabric, PowerBI, SQL Server, Data Factory, etc.)
Ability to balance analytical rigor with practical, implementable recommendations.
Structured communication, adapting style to managers and operational teams and an ability to establish credibility quickly in new environments.
A master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other relevant field.
Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint to support daily business activities.
Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, spoken and written.




What We Offer




BearingPoint is a great place to work. We can offer you the opportunity to work for a company with a global reach and a unique culture that allows everyone to reach their highest potential. We also offer team-specific competency development opportunities and employee benefits such as:

Professional and personal growth, supported by your Development Manager.
An international, dynamic, and inspiring work environment.
A steep learning curve in client-facing roles with a high impact on the business performance of our clients.
Competitive compensation and benefits package, including but not limited to an occupational pension, health insurance, wellness grants, expanded parental benefits, and more.
Competency development opportunities include our First 1000-day program and other Nordic & Firm-wide training and boot camps (Grow with BearingPoint).
An annual curriculum of various social events and sports activities.




What Now?




Send us your resume in either Swedish or English, and we´ll get back to you shortly. A cover letter is optional, and Interviews will be held continuously.




During the interview process, you will meet various colleagues from the team and conduct case interviews.




Want to find out more about the team? Meet some of our colleagues here (Meet our Sweden team), or read an article with our D&A team lead Marcus Ehrndal here.




As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be subject to background checks. These checks help us ensure a safe and trustworthy workplace and may include verification of identity, employment history, education, and any relevant criminal records, in accordance with applicable laws.

Title: Analytics Engineer (in-house)
Description:
We are looking for a full-time Analytics Engineer in-house (m/f/d) to join our motivated global Insights team starting as soon as possible in the Stockholm or Munich office.




The Role

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll help shape how data is structured, accessed, and used across the business. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to build reliable, scalable data solutions that support smarter decisions.




As a vital member of our international IT organization, you will be involved in the foundation of our internal product development and will join the cross-functional data team that is responsible for developing and maintaining Netlight's business-critical data platform and strives to decentralize analytics. That is why it is important that you are a self-driven person, who is comfortable with taking initiative and responsibility, as well as a service-minded and communicative team player.




Who you are

A trusted communicator who builds relationships across technical and non-technical stakeholders and translates data into decisions
Self-driven and proactive, but also team-oriented, with sound judgment on when to lean on AI tools for speed and when human oversight and design thinking matter more
Comfortable working in ambiguity — organized yet flexible, able to adapt as tools, priorities, and team structures evolve quickly
A curious, fast learner with a growth mindset — genuinely energized by new tools, AI-assisted workflows, and continuously raising your own technical bar




Qualifications

Based in Stockholm or Munich
A degree in a quantitative field (e.g. software engineering, computer science, economics, mathematics, statistics) — if you think you’re a great fit, we want to hear from you!
At least 2+ years of relevant experience in fields like Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Data Science, or Software Development.
Strong SQL skills, with hands-on experience building and testing data models in dbt on a cloud warehouse, and an understanding of dimensional data modeling (star schemas, facts and dimensions)
Solid grasp of version control with Git, including CI/CD workflows for data pipelines
Familiarity with Python for data transformation, automation, and light pipeline work
Fluent in written and spoken English (business level)
Comfort working with AI copilots and AI-assisted analytics tools (e.g. Copilot-style code/doc generation, AI BI assistants) while maintaining human oversight on data quality and design
Bonus: Experience with, or strong interest in, semantic layers and metric governance — ensuring a single, trusted definition of key business metrics that both humans and AI tools can rely on




What you will do

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll help shape how data is structured, accessed, and used across the business. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to build reliable, scalable data solutions that support smarter decisions.




Data Modeling & Quality

Transform raw data into clean, usable datasets for analytics and business intelligence, and AI use cases.
Collaborate with stakeholders to define and maintain a semantic layer and single source of truth for key business metrics.
Ensure data quality and consistency across teams and tools.
Build and maintain robust, well-documented data models using Snowflake and dbt.

Governance & Enablement

Provide compliant, user-friendly access to data across various tools (e.g. Power BI, Excel, or AI-powered BI assistants).
Empower users of all technical levels — including AI agents — to find, understand, and securely query the data they need.
Own the data access lifecycle end-to-end, balancing self-service efficiency with security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
Maintain clear documentation and metadata (data catalog, definitions, lineage, ownership) so both people and AI tools can trust and correctly interpret the data

Optimization & Agile Delivery

Continuously evaluate and improve data models for performance and scalability.
Contribute to agile ways of working, participating in planning, refinement, and delivery cycles.
Stay current with emerging tools and practices in the data stack (e.g. orchestration, observability, AI-assisted development) and help the team adopt what's genuinely useful.




What we offer

The possibility to be a core part of one of the most successful IT-consultancy companies in the industry
Professional development and long-term career progression through knowledge sharing, mentorship, feedback, coaching, and external training
Modern and centrally located offices in Stockholm or Munich
A culture centered around community, collaboration, and continuous learning, complemented by social and competence-building events
Everything you need to do your magic (computer, phone, mobile subscription)
Mental health & parental support offerings
30 days of paid vacation.




Specific benefit package if positioned in Stockholm:

5000 sek / year in health care benefit (“friskvård”)
Private pension savings




Specific benefit package if positioned in Munich:

Deutschlandticket
Wellpass




About us

Netlight is an international digital consulting firm, helping leading companies to succeed in the digital landscape, from advice to implementation. Our service contains the collective intelligence of more than 2200 consultants offering a comprehensive range of digital services, from strategy to technology. Co-creating the future today, since 1999.




Netlight has been awarded several times for profitable growth and management, as a top employer, and for our engagement in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Located in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Oslo, Helsinki, Copenhagen, Munich, Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Zurich, Cologne, Amsterdam, Madrid, Toronto, Vienna and London.




Come work with us

Netlight as a company strives to be a truly diverse, equitable, and inclusive organisation. Regardless of who you are, what personality, background, and experience you have, you enrich our culture through your values. Netlight’s purpose is to unleash full potential, realise great careers, and fulfil personal growth.




To achieve this, we have a highly engaged network organisation, where every employee gets a mentor, delivery coach, and personal communities. The key to our continued success is trust and personal responsibility, diverse experiences, challenging opportunities, and development based on personal values. Every Netlighter is an active part of building and shaping this culture, which leads to a clear correlation between personal growth and the growth of Netlight.




Apply today
