Title: Senior Data Analyst - DRM & Music
Description:
Join our global force of 400+ innovators, blending the latest in tech with the greatest in soundtracking — from our Stockholm HQ to offices in London, New York, Los Angeles, Berlin, Paris, Oslo, and Seoul. We're an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously. Come create with us, and let the world feel your work.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll join an embedded, AI-native analytics team that sits inside the commercial and product domains driving our growth. You'll work closely with DRM and Music leadership — and the product team — as we grow our Music & DRM business. On the DRM side, you'll validate the metrics that matter, build business cases that motivate product investment, and back our position in platform negotiations. On the Music side, you'll help leadership make better decisions faster: shaping how we think about capex and acquisition tradeoffs, making our biggest financial decisions more data-driven, and building a clear picture of how music moves across our platform and out into the world. You'll have a dedicated mandate spanning both DRM and Music while drawing on the shared infrastructure, engineering support, and peers of our central Data & Analytics team.

What you'll do


Be a trusted thought partner to Music and DRM leadership. Bring structured thinking to high-stakes questions, sanity-check what we measure, and proactively raise the questions stakeholders haven't thought to ask.
Build the business cases that move decisions forward. Turn platform data into the commercial case for what we should build next, and put hard numbers behind contract terms, rate changes, and revenue-share positions where the stakes are real money.
See around corners. Bring data-driven insights around our music investments, and build a deep understanding of how different customer segments use our music — so we can anticipate where demand is heading before it shows up in the numbers.
Connect what happens on our platform with how music performs in the world. Run deep-dives that combine internal and external data to explain why a metric moved, where value is being left on the table, and where the growth opportunities are.
Make our data trustworthy for agentic analytics — enrich context and metadata, and use AI coding tools to ship instrumentation and data-quality fixes directly so both people and AI tools can rely on it.
Uphold analytical rigour as self-serve expands. Push back on false precision in revenue and accrual estimates, set the bar for what good analysis looks like, and resist unnecessary complexity where a simpler approach serves the decision better.


What you'll bring


Senior-level influence. You've driven real business impact by shaping decisions at the leadership level and moving revenue outcomes.
High agency. Habit of driving decisions through tailored communication and data storytelling.
Sharp analytical instincts. You scope vague questions with vetted frameworks, state hypotheses up front, and reason to a defensible answer even with imperfect data.
Sound judgement about data. A solid grasp of statistics and the discernment to know when past data predicts the future and when to override it for where the business is heading.
Technical versatility. Proficiency across SQL and Python (notebooks in Hex), dbt (on BigQuery), plus experience with AI coding tools and techniques including context engineering and evals.
Platform curiosity. You don't need prior rights-management experience, but you're genuinely curious to learn how the music platforms actually work, and how that connects to our business.


Music to our ears


Experience combining data across platforms — e.g. joining first-party product data with external platform data — to explain shifts in user behaviour.
Data modelling know-how and experience with semantic layers.
A track record of validating and refining metrics in a data-mature environment, and of building business cases that turned into real product investment.


What we'll offer


A fast-paced environment with real room for personal growth and tangible impact on the business.
The chance to help write the new playbook for running Analytics in the AI era, combining timeless principles with fresh learnings from emerging tooling.
A diverse, collaborative team of Analysts and Engineers building together.


Equal opportunity employer

We believe that bringing people together from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives makes for a healthy workplace, a more successful business and a better world. We value diversity and encourage everyone to come and soundtrack the world with us.

Application

Ready to make the world feel your work? Please apply, in English.

Title: Volymanalytiker
Description:
Vi söker en Volymanalytiker som genom analys och struktur bidrar till att vi har rätt volymer på rätt plats vid rätt tidpunkt – så att våra blommor alltid finns där kunden behöver dem. Om du gillar att jobba med data, lösa operativa utmaningar och omsätta analyser till beslut, kan den här rollen passa dig perfekt!




Om rollen

På Blomsterboda arbetar vi med blommor. En färskvara med kort hållbarhet och stora säsongsvariationer. Efterfrågan påverkas i hög grad av högtider, väder och andra yttre faktorer vilket ställer höga krav på träffsäker prognostisering och snabba omställningar.




Som Volymanalytiker blir du en del av vårt volymteam och arbetar nära Inköp, Sortiment, Kampanj och Försäljning. Du analyserar försäljningshistorik, kundutveckling, säsongsmönster och kampanjer och för att ta fram beräkningar som hjälper oss att fatta bra beslut kring inköp och volmfördelningar. Rollen kombinerar analysarbete med operativa och administrativa uppgifter kopplade till volymsättning och fördelning. Våra system, processer och arbetssätt är under utveckling, vilket innebär att du också får möjlighet att bidra med idéer och förbättringar i takt med att du växer in i rollen.







Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

Analysera försäljningsdata, historik, säsongsmönster och kampanjutfall för att ta fram beslutsunderlag för inköpsvolymer, fördelning till butik och framtida volymplanering
Arbeta operativt med volymsättning och fördelning av ordinarie sortiment och kampanjer
Följa upp utfall och analysera avvikelser för att förbättra kommande volymplanering
Säkerställa god datakvalitet och utveckla analysunderlag och rapporter
Samarbeta med inköp, sortiment, kampanj och försäljning för att omsätta analys till affärsbeslut







Vi söker dig som

Vi tror att du är i början av din karriär och vill fortsätta utvecklas inom analys, prognosarbete och volymplanering. Du har ett starkt intresse för siffror, problemlösning och att omsätta data till konkreta beslut.

Har erfarenhet från arbete med volymprognostisering eller annan analysintensiv roll
Har stark analytisk och numerisk förmåga och trivs med att arbeta datadrivet
Är strukturerad och metodisk i ditt arbetssätt
Trivs med att kombinera analysarbete med operativa och administrativa arbetsuppgifter
Är nyfiken och drivande med en vilja att förstå samband och hitta förbättringar
Erfarenhet från retail, grossistled eller arbete med färskvaror är meriterande







Kvalifikationer

Eftergymnasial utbildning inom exempelvis ekonomi, inköp, logistik, statistik eller motsvarande
Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel (mycket god/avancerad nivå)
Erfarenhet av BI-verktyg (t.ex. Power BI)
Meriterande: kunskaper i SQL eller motsvarande







Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i ett företag med lång erfarenhet och stark kompetens, i en bransch som är både dynamisk och händelserik. Som analytiker får du en affärsnära roll där dina analyser snabbt får effekt i verksamheten.

En viktig roll i det centrala arbetet med företagets volymprognostisering och planering
Samarbete med stora delar av verksamheten, från inköp till drift
Möjlighet att utvecklas inom prognostisering och volymplanering
Möjlighet att vara med och utveckla arbetssätt och processer
En miljö där vi uppmuntrar initiativ och lärande




Du blir en del av ett engagerat och kunnigt team där samarbete står i fokus.

I rollen som Volymanalytiker rapporterar du till Strategisk volym- och leveransplanansvarig.







Övrig information

Placeringsort: Vallentuna

Omfattning: 100%

Anställningsform: Tillsvidare

Tillträde: Snarast







Ansökan

Låter det här som din nästa utmaning? Skicka gärna in din ansökan senast 2026-09-20.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande.







Om Blomsterboda

Blomsterboda är en av Sveriges ledande leverantörer av blommor till dagligvaruhandeln. Vi finns från Sundsvall i norr till Malmö i söder samt på Gotland och Öland. Tillsammans skapar vi blomsteravdelningar med hög kvalitet, starkt kundfokus och stolthet i varje leverans. Hos oss präglas kulturen av frihet under ansvar, gemenskap och en vilja att alltid göra det lilla extra.

utveckla rapporter och dashboards i Power BI

god erfarenhet av Power BI

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
We are on a mission to become the leading international force in residential property management. What we do matters to billions of people in their everyday lives.

Residential real estate is the world’s largest asset class, and for most families, buying a home is the single biggest financial decision they will ever make. For too long, residential property management has fallen short of homeowners' and residents' expectations, and the industry is ready for change. Odevo was formed to make that change happen.

In just six years, Odevo has grown more than 70-fold, establishing us as the leading international player. We are more than 14,000 people across the US, the UK, the Nordics, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, and Italy building Odevo. Together, we aspire to break new ground through innovation and cultivate a workplace where we help each other succeed, where ideas matter more than titles, and where kindness is a strength.

By combining the power of people and technology, we set a new standard for how homes are managed. Our technology-enabled services simplify living for residents and create a better experience for property owners and boards.

Our ambition is to continue our fast-growing journey through new customers, service expansion, and by partnering with great companies that share our mindset and ambition, both in existing and new markets.

As we continue to grow, we stay true to who we are, challenge unnecessary bureaucracy, and keep decision-making close to our customers.

If you share our mindset and ambition, we’d love you to join us and help accelerate our mission together.

About The Role

As a Data Engineer in our Global Data & BI team, you will build and operate the pipelines that power the Odevo Data Warehouse (ODW). Working within an established Microsoft Fabric architecture, you'll ingest data from the many source systems used across our operating companies, model it into trusted, reusable datasets, and keep it flowing reliably to the dashboards and data products our business depends on.

Key Responsibilities


Build and maintain ingestion pipelines in Fabric Data Factory across APIs, databases, SaaS platforms and file-based feeds, including incremental and change data capture patterns.
Develop and test transformation models across the Bronze, Silver and Gold layers (medallion architecture), following the team's modelling standards and naming conventions.
Model data for analytical consumption — dimensional models, slowly changing dimensions, and handling multi-entity, multi-currency and multi-country data.
Operate what you build: monitor pipeline health, investigate and fix failures, respond to source schema changes, and improve reliability and run cost.
Implement data quality tests and validation rules in pipelines, working to the standards set by our Data Enablement squad.
Prepare and document governed datasets for the Published layer, so that BI developers, semantic models and downstream applications can consume them with confidence.
Work within our engineering workflow — version control and CI/CD in Azure DevOps, peer review, secrets management in Azure Key Vault, and clear documentation of pipelines and lineage.
Work directly with BI developers and business stakeholders to understand what the data is for, and translate that into pipelines and models that answer the actual question.


Who You Are

You're a pragmatic builder who gets things into production. You're comfortable with messy, undocumented source systems and enjoy the detective work of figuring out what the data actually means. You take ownership of the pipelines you build rather than handing them over, you ask what a dataset is for before you build it, and you can explain what you've done to someone who doesn't work in data. You want to work somewhere the data platform is still being built out, rather than somewhere it's already finished.

Experience


2–4 years' hands-on data engineering experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.
Strong SQL, and Python for data manipulation, automation and API-based ingestion.
Experience with Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory, Synapse Data Warehouse / Lakehouse, OneLake) — or with the Azure equivalents such as Azure Data Factory, Synapse or Databricks, and the appetite to move onto Fabric quickly.
Practical experience transformation framework and a solid grasp of modular, tested SQL modelling.
Solid understanding of data warehousing, ELT and dimensional modelling.
Comfortable working with Git-based version control and CI/CD pipelines, ideally Azure DevOps.
Awareness of data protection and security practice — GDPR, handling of personal data, role-based access — applied to the data you work with.
Nice to have: experience integrating newly acquired businesses or consolidating data across multiple legal entities; exposure to Power BI as a consumer of your models.


What Success Looks Like In Your First Six Months


You've independently onboarded a new source system into the Bronze and Silver layers, from first connection through to a tested, documented model.
You're the go-to person for two or three pipelines, including keeping them running.
You've built at least one Gold-layer dataset that a BI developer or stakeholder is actively using for reporting.
You're contributing to code review and raising improvements to how the team works, not just consuming the standards.


What We Offer


Professional growth - to work with the most talented developers in the industry.
Modern technology - we invest in the latest technologies and tools and encourage our team members to share their ideas and take ownership of their work.
Innovation - to work on exciting projects that push the boundaries of our industry and make a real impact.
Commitment to quality - a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values profitable and long-term product development.


Sounds like you? Apply today!

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist
We're partnering with an established fintech that's using data science to solve complex business problems at scale. Operating in a highly digital environment, data sits at the centre of decision-making, giving the team the opportunity to test ideas quickly, measure outcomes, and create meaningful impact across the business.
As the company continues to invest in its Data & ML capabilities, they're looking for a Data Scientist to join a collaborative team where curiosity, analytical thinking and commercial impact are valued just as highly as technical expertise.
About the role:This is an opportunity to apply statistics, machine learning and advanced analytics to solve real business problems. You'll work closely with commercial teams to understand complex challenges, identify opportunities, and develop data-driven solutions that create measurable value.
The role has a particular focus on marketing and growth, but you'll be joining a wider Data Science function and working alongside experienced Data Scientists on a variety of business-critical initiatives.
This is a role for someone who enjoys asking the right questions, applying the appropriate analytical techniques, and taking ownership of problems from initial exploration through to models being deployed into production and delivering measurable impact.
What you'll do:Frame business challenges as data science problems and identify the most appropriate analytical approach.Develop statistical and machine learning models that improve decision making and business performance.Design and evaluate experiments, causal analyses and predictive models to generate actionable insights.Work closely with business stakeholders to understand priorities and translate data into commercial value.Partner with engineering teams to ensure models are successfully deployed, monitored and continue delivering value in production.Identify new opportunities where data science can improve efficiency and support business growth.
About you:We're looking for someone with a strong academic foundation who enjoys applying theory to real-world business challenges.
You'll likely have:3+ years' experience in a Data Science or advanced analytics role.A degree in Mathematics, Statistics or another highly quantitative discipline, with a Master's degree or above preferred.Strong Python skills for data analysis, statistical modelling and machine learning.Excellent understanding of statistical methods, modelling techniques and when to apply them appropriately.Experience building models that have been deployed into production and created measurable business value.Confidence translating ambiguous business questions into structured analytical solutions.Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.A proactive mindset and the ability to take ownership from problem definition through to business impact.
Experience working with marketing analytics, experimentation, attribution or customer behaviour would be beneficial, but the strongest candidates will be those with excellent data science fundamentals and a passion for solving business problems.
Why join?This is a business where data genuinely drives decisions. With a highly digital product and rich datasets, you'll be able to form hypotheses, test them quickly and see the impact of your work in real time.
You'll be joining a collaborative Data & ML team within an established fintech that combines the stability of a successful business with the agility and autonomy of a smaller organisation. Rather than working on isolated research projects or predefined tickets, you'll have the opportunity to shape solutions, influence decision-making and see your work translate into measurable commercial outcomes.
The company offers a flexible hybrid working model (typically two to three days a week in their central Stockholm office), modern tooling, excellent benefits and the opportunity to work alongside experienced Data Scientists in an environment that values continuous learning, collaboration and technical excellence.
If you're a Data Scientist who enjoys combining strong statistical thinking with practical problem solving - and wants to see your work make a tangible business impact - we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll do:Frame business challenges as data science problems and identify the most appropriate analytical approach.Develop statistical and machine learning models that improve decision making and business performance.Design and evaluate experiments, causal analyses and predictive models to generate actionable insights.Work closely with business stakeholders to understand priorities and translate data into commercial value.Partner with engineering teams to ensure models are successfully deployed, monitored and continue delivering value in production.Identify new opportunities where data science can improve efficiency and support business growth.
About you:We're looking for someone with a strong academic foundation who enjoys applying theory to real-world business challenges.
You'll likely have:3+ years' experience in a Data Science or advanced analytics role.A degree in Mathematics, Statistics or another highly quantitative discipline, with a Master's degree or above preferred.Strong Python skills for data analysis, statistical modelling and machine learning.Excellent understanding of statistical methods, modelling techniques and when to apply them appropriately.Experience building models that have been deployed into production and created measurable business value.Confidence translating ambiguous business questions into structured analytical solutions.Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.A proactive mindset and the ability to take ownership from problem definition through to business impact.
Experience working with marketing analytics, experimentation, attribution or customer behaviour would be beneficial, but the strongest candidates will be those with excellent data science fundamentals and a passion for solving business problems.
Why join?This is a business where data genuinely drives decisions. With a highly digital product and rich datasets, you'll be able to form hypotheses, test them quickly and see the impact of your work in real time.
You'll be joining a collaborative Data & ML team within an established fintech that combines the stability of a successful business with the agility and autonomy of a smaller organisation. Rather than working on isolated research projects or predefined tickets, you'll have the opportunity to shape solutions, influence decision-making and see your work translate into measurable commercial outcomes.
The company offers a flexible hybrid working model (typically two to three days a week in their central Stockholm office), modern tooling, excellent benefits and the opportunity to work alongside experienced Data Scientists in an environment that values continuous learning, collaboration and technical excellence.
If you're a Data Scientist who enjoys combining strong statistical thinking with practical problem solving - and wants to see your work make a tangible business impact - we'd love to hear from you.

Title: Data Engineer / BI Consultant
Description:
Vill du kombinera data, AI och affärsutveckling?

Är du en erfaren Data Engineer eller BI-konsult som drivs av att skapa affärsvärde – inte bara bygga tekniska lösningar? Vill du arbeta nära företagsledningar och hjälpa några av Sveriges största företag att fatta bättre beslut med hjälp av data? Då kan detta vara nästa steg i din karriär.

Vår kund är ett väletablerat managementkonsultbolag med specialistkompetens inom verksamhetsstyrning, lönsamhetsutveckling och beslutsstöd. Nu söker de en Data Engineer som vill vara med och utveckla deras satsning inom Data & AI samt bidra till den fortsatta tillväxten av Stockholmskontoret.




Om rollen

Du kommer att arbeta i gränslandet mellan teknik och affär, där ditt uppdrag är att hjälpa kunder att omvandla komplex data till beslutsunderlag som skapar verkligt affärsvärde.

Rollen handlar inte enbart om att bygga dataplattformar och pipelines. Du kommer även att analysera verksamheters behov, ta fram relevanta KPI och utveckla datamodeller som ger ledningsgrupper bättre beslutsunderlag.




Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att innebära att:

Utforma datamodeller och moderna datalager i Azure.
Bygga lösningar för analys, rapportering och visualisering i Power BI.
Arbeta med Python, SQL och moderna molnplattformar.
Delta i workshops och kundmöten för att förstå verksamhetens behov.
Ta fram KPI, styrmodeller och lönsamhetsanalyser tillsammans med kunden.
Bidra till utvecklingen av AI-baserade lösningar och hur AI kan skapa affärsvärde.
Samarbeta nära managementkonsulter och tekniska specialister i tvärfunktionella projektteam.




Vi tror att du har:

Minst 3–5 års erfarenhet som Data Engineer, BI-konsult eller inom Data & Analytics.
Akademisk examen inom exempelvis Industriell ekonomi, Datavetenskap, Matematik, Teknisk fysik eller motsvarande.
Mycket goda kunskaper i Python och SQL.
Erfarenhet av Azure och moderna dataplattformar.
Erfarenhet av datamodellering, ETL/ELT och Data Warehouse.
Erfarenhet av Power BI eller liknande analysverktyg.
Ett genuint intresse för AI och hur tekniken kan användas för att utveckla verksamheter.




Meriterande är erfarenhet av Microsoft Fabric, Azure DevOps eller Databricks.




Vem är du?

Du trivs i skärningspunkten mellan teknik och verksamhet och motiveras av att förstå affären bakom datan.

Du är van att samarbeta med kunder och känner dig trygg i att diskutera lösningar med både verksamhet och ledning. Samtidigt har du ett stort tekniskt intresse och uppskattar att omsätta komplex data till tydliga beslutsunderlag.




Som person är du:

Affärsmässig och konsultmässig.
Kommunikativ och förtroendeingivande.
Prestigelös och samarbetsorienterad.
Analytisk och lösningsfokuserad.
Självgående med ett starkt eget driv.




Har du dessutom en grundläggande förståelse för ekonomistyrning, controlling eller finansiell rapportering är det ett stort plus.




Därför ska du välja den här möjligheten

Här får du möjlighet att arbeta i ett entreprenöriellt konsultbolag med korta beslutsvägar, stort eget ansvar och en kultur där varje medarbetare har möjlighet att påverka både kundernas utveckling och företagets framtid.




Du erbjuds bland annat:

Uppdrag hos några av Sveriges största företag och koncerner.
Möjlighet att kombinera management consulting, data och AI.
Stor frihet, ansvar och möjlighet att påverka.
Ett kompetent och prestigelöst team med hög kunskapsnivå.
Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och en tydlig karriärväg.
Möjlighet att vara med och utveckla ett växande Stockholmskontor.




Låter det intressant? Vi ser fram emot att berätta mer om företaget och rollen i nästa steg av processen.




Om anställningen:

Detta är en direktanställning där du kommer att bli direkt anställd av kunden.




Övrig info:

Omfattning: Heltid, 100%, direktrekytering
Start: Enligt överenskommelse
Placering: Stockholm city
Rekryteringsansvarig: Hedvig Svärd




Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval av kandidater och att annonsen kan stängs ner innan tjänsten är tillsatt om vi gått över till urvals och intervjufasen. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail.




Om Friday:

På Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som Tech-talang en riktigt bra start på karriären. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av, matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet.

Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas.

Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

Tietos verksamhet inom Data /AI söker nu en data scientist som vill bidra till vår och våra kunders utveckling.

Designa, utveckla och underhålla data pipelines och ETL-processer.
Analysera stora mängder strukturerad och ostrukturerad data.
Skapa och underhålla dashboards.
Förstå affärsbehov och leverera datadrivna lösningar.

Minst sex års arbetserfarenhet inom data science och dataanalys.
Flytande svenska och engelska både i tal och skrift.
Universtetsutbildning inom datavetenskap, statistik eller liknande.
Stark kunskap i SQL och Python.
Erfarenhet av molnplattformarna Azure, AWS eller GCP.


Meriterande


Erfarenhet inom data engineering.
Erfarenhet som IT-konsult.
Erfarenhet av plattformarna Databricks, Snowflake och Power BI.
Erfarenhet av maskininlärning och AI.
Erfarenhet av teknologoier och programmering inom Pyspark, Scala, R eller liknande.
Kunskap inom NLP.


Personliga egenskaper

Du är en analytisk och initiativtagande problemlösare. Du brinner för att lösa kundproblem och vill stötta dem på bästa möjliga sätt samtidigt som du utvecklas.

Vi ser fram emot att lära känna just DIG och utforska hur vi tillsammans kan forma framtiden. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Bifoga ditt CV eller din LinkedIn-profil så kontaktar vi dig. Intervjuer kommer att hållas löpande, så vi uppmuntrar dig att ansöka redan idag!

Vi utför bakgrundskontroller av alla slutkandidater.

Tieto avböjer samtal från rekryteringsföretag.

Om Tieto

Tieto skapar meningsfull teknologi som bidrar till att göra världen bättre. Vi är ett ledande techbolag med lång historia och närvaro i Norden men har också global kapacitet. Baserat på våra kärnvärden öppenhet, trovärdighet och mångfald, jobbar vi tillsammans med våra kunder – och utvecklar en digital framtid där företag, samhällen och människor kan växa.

Våra 24 000 experter globalt specialiserar sig på cloud, data och mjukvara för tusentals företag och organisationer inom privat och offentlig sektor i mer än 90 länder. Tieto omsätter årligen cirka 3 miljarder euro och företagets aktier är noterade på NASDAQ-börsen i Helsingfors och Stockholm samt på Oslo Børs.

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Title: Kravanalytiker/produktägare
Company: The Swedish Federation of Unemployment Insurance Funds
Description:
Sveriges a-kassor söker en kravanalytiker/produktägare Statistik

Vi söker en kravanalytiker/produktägare för produkter vi förvaltar på Sveriges a-kassor.




Arbetsbeskrivning

Sveriges a-kassor söker nu en Kravanalytiker/produktägare

Arbetsmarknaden förändras i allt snabbare takt och arbetslöshetskassornas uppdrag har kanske aldrig varit viktigare.




Det finns 24 a-kassor i Sverige. Sveriges a-kassor är deras gemensamma service- och intresseorganisation. Det betyder att vi hjälper a-kassorna med bland annat IT-utveckling, utbildning och opinionsbildning. Syftet är att a-kassorna ska kunna administrera arbetslöshetsförsäkringen på ett så snabbt och effektivt sätt som möjligt. Sveriges a-kassor sitter i nya fräscha lokaler vid Skanstull samt är en modern arbetsgivare som månar om sina anställda. Vi tycker arbetslivet ska vara hållbart över tid och erbjuder flexibilitet och goda villkor för våra anställda.




På Sveriges a-kassor jobbar vi med att vidareutveckla och förvalta de IT-system som a-kassorna nyttjar i sitt dagliga arbete med att administrera arbetslöshetsförsäkringen för sina medlemmar.




Utbildning och erfarenhet

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi gärna att du har:

Relevant högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande förvärvad arbetserfarenhet
Dokumenterad erfarenhet av kravanalys inom datalager, beslutsstöd eller BI-lösningar
Erfarenhet av att ha jobbat i rollen som kravanalytiker eller motsvarande
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
Erfarenhet av att ansvara för användargrupper eller motsvarande
God förståelse för datalagerarkitektur och arbete med stora datamängder i SQL Server (ur ett krav- och analysperspektiv).
Erfarenhet av att arbeta med BI-verktyg, med fokus på informationsstruktur, begreppsmodellering och rapportbehov.
Vi arbetar agilt och du behöver känna dig bekväm med att hålla i workshops.

Personliga egenskaper:

Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga
Förmåga att kunna prioritera samt att du känner ett stort ansvar för de arbetsuppgifter du åtar dig
Drivande
Social kompetens

För att passa in i rollen ser vi att du gillar utmaningar och klarar av ett högt tempo. Du har förmåga och trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och i grupp. Du är bra på att driva ditt arbete framåt samtidigt som du känner stort ansvar för de arbetsuppgifter som du åtar dig. Som person drivs du av att bredda din kompetens och du stimuleras av en arbetsmiljö som präglas av problemlösning och service. 




Övrig information

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som startar med 6 månaders provanställning.

Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-09-04. Intervjuer hålls löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag så skicka in din ansökan redan nu. Lön enligt överenskommelse.

Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta




HR: Nils Boix-Vives, nils.boix-vives@sverigesakassor.se 




Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
At Strawberry, we don’t just run hotels, we’re building a universe of experiences. We are rewriting the hospitality playbook through tech and innovation, and data is the engine powering it all.

We’re looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our central Tech BI team. You’ll sit right at the heart of our tech transformation, building scalable datasets and data models that power business decisions, digital products and AI solutions.

If you’re excited about the modern data stack, obsessed with clean architecture, and eager to leverage AI to push the boundaries of traditional BI, Welcome Home.

Our Tech Stack


Data Warehouse: Snowflake
Transformation & Governance: dbt
Orchestration: Apache Airflow
Cloud & DevOps: Cloud Platforms (Azure / AWS / GCP), Git, CI/CD
Languages: SQL, Python


You won't just be maintaining pipelines, As part of our central Tech BI team, you’ll build and evolve the shared data platform while enabling Data Product Teams across the business to deliver trusted, high-quality data products.

Working with our modern data stack, you’ll transform raw, complex data into scalable data models that power business decisions, digital products and AI solutions.

You’ll work at the intersection of our central data platform and our Data Product Teams, enabling reliable data foundations while supporting business-specific data products. As we continue investing in AI, you’ll help build trusted data foundations that enable analytics, automation and future AI solutions.

What You’ll Do


Core Platform Ownership: Build, maintain, and optimize the core datasets, transformations and pipelines that power our enterprise data platform.
Partner with Data Product Teams: Work closely with cross-functional Data Product teams aligned directly with the business to deliver tailored datasets, analytics solutions, and actionable insights.
Own the Data Lifecycle: Design and implement scalable data models in Snowflake, leveraging dbt for transformations, testing, documentation and version controlling.
Build Robust ELT Workflows: Develop, orchestrate, and optimize reliable data pipelines using Airflow to seamlessly integrate diverse source systems.
Drive AI & Innovation: Partner with engineering and product teams to build trusted data foundations that enable advanced analytics, AI solutions and new data products.
Code & Automate: Use Python to build data pipelines, automate workflows and integrate source systems.
Ensure Quality & Documentation: Ensure data assets are monitored, documented and easy for others to understand and reuse.


What You Bring


Proven Track Record: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, BI, or Data Architecture.
Core Tech Expertise: Strong proficiency in SQL, deep experience with Snowflake, and hands-on expertise with dbt and Airflow.
Programming & Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for data manipulation, workflow automation, and integrations.
Cloud & Platform Mindset: Good understanding of cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and modern CI/CD/Git practices.
Business & Product Alignment: Experience or interest in collaborating directly with product teams and business stakeholders to solve real-world problems.
Collaboration & Communication: Humble, curious, and collaborative. You communicate clearly in English, ask great questions, and leave your ego at the door.
Education: BSc/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).


What’s In It For You?


Real Impact: High visibility, strong autonomy, and a flat culture where your ideas actually get built.
Growth & Learning: Space and resources to level up your skills in modern data stack practices and AI.
Unbeatable Perks: Deep discounts on hotel stays, dining, and experiences for you, your friends, and your family across the Strawberry universe.
Vibrant Culture: A fun, passionate team with regular social events, team activities, and a passion for celebrating wins.
Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy a balanced work model with 3 days of high-energy collaboration at our sleek Stockholm HQ and 2 days working from home.


(Please note: This role is based in our Stockholm office. Candidates must be local or ready to relocate to Stockholm, as we do not offer fully remote setups.)

Ready to build something iconic?

Title: Kvantitativt inriktad analytiker för verksamhetsuppföljning
Description:
Är du en driven analytiker som vill medverka till effektiv brottsbekämpning genom uppföljning och analyser av Ekobrottsmyndighetens verksamhet? Vi söker nu en kvantitativt inriktad analytiker som ska bidra till Ekobrottsmyndighetens uppdrag att bekämpa den ekonomiska brottsligheten.

Arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker en analytiker med god kunskap inom kvantitativa metoder och som har förmågan att omsätta dataanalyser och uppföljning av verksamheten till besluts- och informationsunderlag för den operativa verksamheten, myndighetsledningen och regeringen. Underlagen är viktiga för planering, uppföljning och utveckling av Ekobrottsmyndighetens verksamhet.

Som analytiker hos oss kommer du vara en drivande kraft i utvecklingen av vår verksamhetsuppföljning och analysförmåga inom myndigheten. Tjänsten är placerad på stabsenheten som bland annat ansvarar för att utveckla, producera och analysera myndighetens verksamhetsstatistik. Tjänsten är en förstärkning av den kvantitativa analysförmågan. Du samarbetar med övriga medarbetare på stabsenheten, enheter och kammare inom Ekobrottsmyndigheten men också andra myndigheter inom rättskedjan.

Som analytiker kommer dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter vara att:



Ta fram, sammanställa, analysera och presentera uppföljning och statistiska underlag till interna och externa intressenter.
Uppdatera och utveckla myndighetens statistik och verksamhetsuppföljning.
Utveckla kvantitativa metoder för dataanalys av Ekobrottsmyndighetens verksamhet.
Ge stöd i dataanalysfrågor utifrån de behov som finns inom Ekobrottsmyndighetens olika delar.


Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har:



Högskoleexamen eller -utbildning med inriktning mot kvantitativa analyser (till exempel inom statistik eller nationalekonomi) eller annan utbildning tillsammans med erfarenhet som vi bedömer likvärdig
Flerårig arbetslivserfarenhet från offentlig sektor av att ta fram, sammanställa, analysera och presentera statistiska analyser och underlag
Goda kunskaper och erfarenhet av frågor mot SQL-databaser.


Det är meriterande om du har:



Erfarenhet av att arbeta med verksamhetsnära dataanalyser som underlag för utveckling, planering och/eller resultatredovisning
Goda kunskaper av programmering i SAS
Goda kunskaper i SAS Visual Analytics eller motsvarande
Kunskap om prognoser och tidseriemodeller
Erfarenhet av att jobba med analyser inom statlig myndighet.


Personliga egenskaper

För att trivas hos oss behöver du vara utvecklingsinriktad, kunna strukturera ditt arbete och ha lätt för att samarbeta över såväl organisatoriska gränser som med olika professioner. Du behöver besitta en god analytisk förmåga och gott omdöme. Eftersom det ingår i din roll att driva utveckling på myndigheten så är det viktigt att du har en god förmåga att leda dig själv och föra dina frågor framåt, men också att du har lätt för att skapa goda relationer och bidra till ett kreativt arbetsklimat. Du är en god kommunikatör både i tal och i skrift, du har en talang för att förklara och visualisera så att din omgivning förstår komplexa samband.

När vi anställer lägger vi stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och förmågor. För att lyckas i din roll på Ekobrottsmyndigheten vill och kan du arbeta i enlighet med myndighetens medarbetarpolicy,

Kontaktpersoner

Vid frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Stabschef Ann Lemne, tfn 010-562 90 05. Fackliga företrädare för Saco-S är Henrik Lundin, tfn 010-562 91 723, för ST Karin Hallström Norberg, 010-562 91 71 och för Polisförbundet Sofia Ask, tfn 010-563 87 10.

Tillträdesdatum: Snarast, enligt överenskommelse

Title: Data Steward
Description:
Job Description

At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home!

Data Steward

We are currently looking for a Data Steward whose main goal will be to establish clear ownership and accountability for workforce data quality across HR, ensuring each data domain is actively managed, governed, and trusted. The Data Steward operationalises the domain ownership model, working across HR to embed consistent standards, resolve data quality issues, and build confidence in the workforce data that underpins reporting, analytics, and strategic decision-making.

Why this role matters?

Ownership of workforce data has shifted to a domain ownership model, where each domain is accountable for the quality, accuracy, and integrity of its own data. Responsibility for enabling and governing this ownership now sits within the Analytics team, as part of the broader HR Operating Model changes.

Historically, workforce data quality has lacked clear ownership and accountability — resulting in inconsistent standards, poor data quality, and limited confidence in reporting and insights. Without dedicated stewardship, domain ownership risks remaining unclear and inconsistently applied across HR.

You will join a team of 4 and report directly to HR Analytics Manager.

Main responsibilities:

Data Quality Governance


Define and maintain workforce data quality standards across HR domains
Establish data quality KPIs and thresholds in collaboration with domain owners
Conduct regular data quality assessments and produce governance reporting
Own the data quality issue log — tracking, prioritising, and driving resolution


Domain Ownership Enablement


Support HR domain owners in understanding and fulfilling their data accountability
Develop onboarding materials, guidance, and toolkits for domain owners
Run enablement sessions and provide ongoing coaching to embed data ownership practices
Serve as the primary point of contact for domain owners on data quality matters


Standards & Definitions


Maintain the HR data dictionary — ensuring consistent definitions across all domains
Govern data entry standards and validation rules in HR systems (incl. Workday)
Identify and resolve definitional inconsistencies across reporting and analytics outputs
Partner with HR Technology and IT to implement system-level data quality controls


Monitoring & Issue Resolution


Design and operate data quality monitoring routines across HR data domains
Escalate systemic or unresolved issues to the Head of HR Strategy, Data & Technology
Coordinate with domain owners and technical teams to investigate root causes
Track issue resolution and report on progress against quality targets


Cross-Functional Coordination


Act as the bridge between HR, IT, and Finance on workforce data quality topics
Coordinate with the Analytics team to ensure reporting is built on trusted data
Represent HR data governance in relevant forums and working groups
Support audit and compliance activities relating to workforce data integrity


Continuous Improvement


Identify and implement improvements to data collection, validation, and maintenance processes
Monitor industry developments in HR data governance and propose relevant adoption
Build a continuous improvement cycle for workforce data quality, supported by metrics


Requirements:


Experience in data governance, data quality management, or a related HR analytics role
Understanding of HR data domains (e.g. headcount, compensation, performance, learning)
Ability to translate data governance concepts into practical, operational processes
Strong stakeholder management — able to engage and influence without direct authority
Experience working with HR information systems (Workday preferred)
Structured approach to problem-solving and issue resolution
Clear written and verbal communication skills in English
Exposure to HR analytics, reporting, or BI tooling or experience in data engineering, experience in a global or matrixed organisation and knowledge of global and local data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, local privacy laws) regarding the handling of sensitive employee information are an additional asset


Where you'll be:

This is a full-time position, based at Kungsholmen in Stockholm, Sweden.

We work with 20% work-place flexibility, fostering collaboration and a strong team spirit at our Global Headquarters.

We are 60+ nationalities under the same roof and we enjoy the look and feel of the office! You will be part of a dynamic international team where English is the natural language.

As an Electrolux Group employee, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

Please send your CV in English.

Description:
Are you driven, numerically sharp and eager to shape models, algorithms and decision-making at the center of a fast-moving energy trading firm? We’re looking for a Quantitative Analyst with strong analytical instincts and an interest in building production-ready solutions that push the boundaries between quantitative modelling and power trading. You should enjoy turning ideas into reality quickly, working with code, data and complex market dynamics to improve the tools that Nitor relies on every day.




As a Quantitative Analyst at Nitor Energy, you will help advance the models, algorithms and analytical frameworks that power our trading strategies. You will work directly with complex datasets, market dynamics and production-grade code to enhance the accuracy, speed and robustness of our decision-making tools. This role offers hands-on exposure to the full lifecycle of quantitative development in a modern energy-trading company, shaping ideas, testing assumptions and turning data-driven insights into real trading impact.




The Quantitative Analyst we’re looking for is motivated, analytical and want to help elevate our data, models and workflows while accelerating their own development. You should see yourself thriving in a team that executes quickly, turning ideas into production-ready solutions with a pragmatical mindset and sense of ownership.




Your tasks will include

Work closely with traders to develop and refine quantitative models that support profitable trading strategies
Continuously seek improvements to workflows, analytics, risk tools, and business processes
Conduct ad hoc quick analysis to support trading, risk, and commercial decision-making
Design, develop, and maintain analytic and operational views used for monitoring strategies and market dynamics for trading
Support the development and maintenance of Python-based models
Contribute directly to advancing and scaling our data infrastructure




What we expect

Hold a Master within a quantitative field
You have strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Have great python knowledge and an eagerness to code. Other code languages is a plus
You must be a strong team player
We expect you to have a pragmatic mindset and get things done
You have a winning mentality and are willing to go the extra mile to challenge the status quo
You have a do what it takes mentality and do not take no for an answer




What we offer

A young, dynamic, ambitious and fun work environment
Extensive opportunities for personal development and career growth. You will be given responsibility from day one and receive close sparring with experienced colleagues
The opportunity to contribute and make your mark on the team's development
A fun and social work environment with events such as Friday bars, poker tournaments, summer and Christmas parties etc. throughout the year. We also offer weekly sports activities to boost team spirit, such as our Nitor-running club!
Delicious lunch arrangement with food from Meyers in our own canteen
Brand new office facilities located in the heart of Aarhus, right next to Dokk1 and Letbanen




Expected start date: As soon as possible. Please note that we review applications on a rolling basis and may close the position early if we find the right candidate.




About Nitor Energy

Nitor Energy is a fast-growing energy trading company, that has swiftly transitioned from start-up to scale-up within just a few years. We’re experiencing rapid growth, offering limitless opportunities for learning and development. We’re proud of who we are and excited about what we’re building for the future together. Our employees thrive on challenges and are motivated by the potential that lies ahead.




Our unique culture integrates traders, coders, and analysts into cohesive teams, creating a well-rounded approach to our success. We believe in a balanced work-life dynamic and foster a vibrant, engaging atmosphere where our employees can excel in every aspect.

Title: Data & Analytics Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
On Behalf of Hobbii we are looking for a Data & Analytics Engineer




About Hobbii




Hobbii is Denmark's fastest-growing e-commerce company within yarn and handicrafts. From our base in Copenhagen, we've built a global brand serving passionate makers in more than 12 markets, with an ambition to become the world's leading online yarn universe. Driven by scalable technology, creative energy, and data-driven commerce, we're turning our passion for craftsmanship into a global success story.

This is a rare chance to join a small, dedicated data team at Hobbii and turn raw, complex data into trusted, business-ready answers the whole company relies on.




About the role

You’ll work with stakeholders across Finance, Product, and Tech, serving the business with their data needs and helping users make the most of our customer-centric data. You’ll have full ownership of your data products end to end, as well as talking to and educating the business.




Key responsibilities




• Work closely with Finance, Product and Commercial to understand what they need, and translate it into clear, trustworthy answers

• Own shared KPI definitions such as AOV, CLV, and Margin in our Cube semantic layer, so the business measures things consistently

• Contribute to maintaining and building SQL models and dashboards, and help key stakeholders understand the implementation

• Build useful Metabase dashboards and utilise coding and AI tools to help answer business questions effectively

• Contribute to the Data Dictionary so non-technical users understand what they are measuring and can explore data with confidence




Your profile

You’ve probably been the data person somewhere small before, so you’re used to owning things end to end and figuring them out yourself. You’re as curious about the business as the tech, you’d rather answer a real question than build something clever no one asked for, and you’re comfortable talking to stakeholders.




We imagine you bring:

• Genuine business curiosity and the instinct to translate stakeholder questions into practical solutions, this matters as much as the tech

• Experience with a modern data warehouse such as Redshift

• Interest in semantic modelling, KPI logic, or reusable business definitions. Cube, dbt, or LookML experience is a plus

• Curiosity about using AI and MCP for SQL support, documentation, or data exploration

• English fluency, written and spoken, our company language

• A relevant degree or equivalent practical background




Why join Hobbii?

At Hobbii you’ll join a tight-knit team building something global from Copenhagen, and as one of the first data hires, you’ll have unusual ownership and room to shape how we work. You’ll see the impact of your work across the business every week, with real room to grow as the data function grows. We move fast, support each other, and have a lot of fun along the way.




We offer:

Competitive salary based on experience and skills
Flexible work setup – hybrid (HQ in Nordvest, Copenhagen)
6 weeks of paid vacation
Health insurance and paid parental leave
Catered lunch, great coffee, and lively Friday bars
Legendary company events and a welcoming, informal culture
A great staff discount on yarn




Interested?

FACTOR 7 is managing the recruitment process. For more information, please contact Recruitment Manager Omar Kamel at omar@factor7.dk or on +45 30 22 09 02.

Title: Customer Program Data Analyst
Description:
Ready to shape the loyalty programs behind Bilka Plus, føtex Plus, Netto+, ClubSalling, and Carl's Jr.?

If you are a proactive, outgoing data analyst who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment, this is your chance to make a real impact.

The Role

As our new Customer Program Data Analyst, you will turn customer data and loyalty program performance into actionable insights that power strategic decision making and optimize our retail loyalty ecosystem.

You will join a young, dynamic, and high performing team at Salling Group, playing a key role in driving the strategy for customer data and insights. You will be given the freedom and mandate to build scalable data infrastructure, directly supporting our continuous growth and future opportunities.

Primary Tasks And Responsibilities


Transform data into valuable business- and customer insights
Conducting data analysis of customer behavior, program performance, and other key metrics to provide insights and recommendations to the customer program team
Collaborating with cross-functional teams and external vendors to ensure customer programs are effectively executed and optimized for performance
Creating customer segments, triggered actions and supporting weekly and monthly campaigns in our customer loyalty system
Supporting ad-hoc data requests and analyses as needed to support strategic decision-making
Continuously improve our ways of working with data and help drive the data-driven perspective on the business
Automate data flows and processes
Expose data and help build dashboards to share loyalty and membership information to key stakeholders.
Ensure that data is reliable, trustworthy and able to be analyzed.


Your Skills And Background


You have a relevant educational background in business, economics, statistics. Preferably, you also have relevant industry experience from a large FMCG company and +2 years’ experience from a similar position.
You have a natural interest in data and how it can be utilized to create a difference for our business.
You are comfortable dealing with large amounts of data, looking for trends and opportunities, and translating these into understandable and presentable overviews.
You must be fluent in both Danish and English
You have strong analytical skills and proficiency in working with e.g., SQL, Python, R. Preferably also have experience with Snowflake, Big query and SAP Datasphere.
It is an advantage but not a requirement if you have worked with data visualization tools Power BI and Sap Analytics Cloud (SAC).


It will be a strong match if you…


have an analytical mindset and a structured way of working.
are able to collaborate with colleagues from many parts of the organization and manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
care about quality, take pride in your work, and always strive to improve driven by ambition and eager to learn from day one.


What We Offer You

We offer an exciting and inspiring job with excellent opportunities for professional and personal development in an international company in continued growth.

Your daily workplace will be at the Salling Group headquarter in Brabrand, Aarhus.

As a Data Analyst you will play a key role in data utilization by operating and developing our data strategy, reporting and campaign management setup in cooperation with Customer Tech. IT, Business Intelligence and Commercial departments as well as our formats Bilka, føtex, Netto, Salling and Carl's Jr.

As part of a young and dynamic team, you will contribute with a direct impact on customers’ shopping experience.

Interested?

To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter outlining your relevant experience and why you are a strong fit for this role.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Do you want to play a key role in Adnami’s growth journey? Now is the time, because we are looking for someone to take ownership of the Snowflake platform the business runs its decisions on. 




Adnami is a Danish-born fast-paced scale-up within the AdTech industry. We launched in 2019 and today we are a trusted go-to solution for media agencies, publishers, and blue-chip advertisers when they buy digital High Impact Advertising. 




About the role 

We have completed our migration to Snowflake, and this role is about making more of it. You will own the platform end to end: the data models and dbt project that define them, the pipelines that feed them, and the Power BI reports the whole company works from. 




You would sit inside our Suite development team and work in their day-to-day rhythm, joining their cycles and their planning instead of taking requests from the outside. Data questions rarely arrive neatly packaged, and being in the room when the work is shaped is most of what makes the answers useful. 




There is also new ground. People across the business are starting to build their own AI-assisted reporting apps and look after them themselves. Your job is to make that work: trustworthy data underneath, sensible guardrails, and colleagues who know what they are doing. Done well, the whole company gets faster at answering its own questions, and you spend your time on the problems only you can solve. 




It is a broad, visible role with touch points right across the company. You are the person the business comes to with a question it cannot answer yet, and you decide whether the answer is a new model, a new report, or a better pipeline. 




This is not a remote role. You would be based in our Copenhagen office, where the team you work with sits. 




Responsibilities 

Own and develop our Snowflake platform: data models, transformations, and the dbt project that defines them. 
Build and maintain the pipelines and stored procedures that keep data flowing reliably. 
Provide the modelled, trustworthy data layer that reports and self-service apps are both built on. 
Enable self-service and keep it honest: help colleagues build their own AI-assisted reporting apps well, set the standards and guardrails, and step in when something needs doing properly. 
Work as part of the Suite development team: join their cycles, understand what is being built, and make sure the data side is thought through early. 
Partner with Finance and Sales, who rely on us for the numbers they run on. These are among our most important internal relationships. 
Take machine learning work from experiment into production. 
Work with the business to turn open questions into analyses, then into reports people actually use. 
Bring insight back unprompted, not only when you are asked. 




Your profile 

3-5 years in a data or BI role. This is not a graduate position. 
Strong SQL and solid data modelling fundamentals. 
Python for data work. 
Comfortable writing and maintaining stored procedures. 
Ready to pick up our stack quickly, and curious by nature. You want to know why the numbers look the way they do, not only how to produce them. 
Some exposure to machine learning or AI applied to business data. 
Able to hold your own with senior stakeholders, including on financial numbers. You can discuss what the data means, not only how it was built. 
Able to translate a vague business need into a concrete analysis. 
Confident with large datasets. 
Happy enabling other people instead of being the sole author. This role involves teaching, setting standards, and making other people’s work possible. 
Comfortable working inside a development team. You will be in the day-to-day flow with engineers. 
An MSc in a quantitative field (computer science, statistics, economics, mathematics, or similar). 




It’s a plus if you have 

Worked in Snowflake already. 
Dbt, ideally a project you have owned. 
Power BI, including DAX and Power Query. 
Put machine learning models into production, beyond the notebook stage. 
Set up data governance or quality standards for self-service BI. 
Experience with data API integrations. 
Worked with finance or commercial data. 




What we offer 

Competitive salary and pension. 
Paid phone and internet subscription. 
Your birthday off. 
Referral programme. 
A flexible working environment where results are what matter. 
A dynamic workplace. 
A lovely office in Copenhagen. 




About Adnami 

Adnami is a well-funded, fast-growing Danish-born technology company with a unique product and proven product-market fit. We give publishers a smooth, scalable way to deliver high impact advertising for their advertisers. We set a new standard for high impact advertising in the Nordic markets in record time, and we are now expanding rapidly into new markets.




We are an equal opportunity employer and support workforce diversity. Our aim is to ensure our workforce is diverse and inclusive, and we promote these values throughout our organisation. We employ, retain, promote, and otherwise treat all employees and job applications according to their merit, qualifications, competence, and talent. We apply this policy without regard to any individual’s sex, race, religion, origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, or disability.

Title: Business Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About the Role




We're seeking a driven Business Analyst to join our FP&A team - someone who’s eager to work directly with senior leadership and contribute to data-driven decisions from day one in a high-impact role that offers real visibility and room to grow.




Now a delisted, growth-equity backed business, OrderYOYO is entering an exciting new chapter – a clear testament to our bold growth ambitions and the fast paced, high-impact environment we are building.




In this role, you’ll gain broad exposure across the business by collaborating with Management, Commercial teams, Tech, and Product Owners. You'll play a key role in turning data into actionable insights with an analytical approach, including testing hypotheses, doing in-depth analysis and presenting findings for key stakeholders. As you grow, you’ll have the freedom to shape your path based on your strengths and interests.




Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing:




Assist with scenario analysis to help inform strategic decisions made at the leadership level.
Assist with invoicing processes and mature existing logic towards a more automated process.
Structure and analyse raw data, translate business needs into data requirements, and collaborate with Tech on onboarding and integration.
Design and analyse commercial experiments (A/B tests, hypothesis-driven investigations) to test what works before scaling.
Apply modelling techniques in Python (classification, regression, clustering, segmentation) where they sharpen the answer to a commercial question.
Build and enhance Power BI reports using our Microsoft Fabric data platform, supporting both management and internal stakeholders.




What We Are Looking For In You:




Experience in a commercial analytics, FP&A, consulting, or business analyst role - ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, or subscription business.
Strong Excel and Power BI skills. Comfortable building reports and analytical views on a modern data platform (Microsoft Fabric or equivalent).
Experience with experimentation and hypothesis testing (A/B tests, causal inference and OLS).
Working Python skills (pandas, scikit-learn). Able to build and interpret classification, regression, and clustering models for commercial questions - not building production pipelines.
Strong commercial instinct. Comfortable presenting findings to senior stakeholders and translating numbers into recommendations.
Structured problem-solving. Can take an open commercial question and decompose it into a testable hypothesis.
Interest in applied AI/ML - e.g. using LLMs to accelerate analytical workflows.




Why Join Us?




Direct exposure to decision-making at the highest level and learn how business challenges are tackled at the top level.
Work in a supportive, team-first culture where we help each other succeed.
Expect personal development plans and ongoing training tailored to your growth.
A dynamic, supportive environment where critical thinking is encouraged and your voice matters.
Be part of a high-growth journey in a growth equity-backed company, where ambition meets opportunity - and your impact truly matters.




Great to Have (But Not Required)




Exposure to Power BI, SQL, DAX, Python, and/or Power Query.
ML & AI intuition, such as K-fold cross-validation, exploiting gradients and similar.
Familiarity with FP&A concepts: budgeting, variance analysis, forecasting cycles.
Experience or interest in working on cross-functional projects involving Tech/Product, Operations, Sales and Marketing




What we do at OrderYOYO




OrderYOYO is a provider of white-label online ordering, payment, marketing, and POS software solutions to independent local takeaway restaurants. Title: Data Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About Us

Complir is the AI platform for the product compliance lifecycle, built for retailers, brands, and manufacturers selling physical consumer products across multiple markets.

We believe getting a physical product to market shouldn't mean fighting spreadsheets, PDFs, and supplier emails just to prove it's safe and legal to sell. Product compliance should be continuous, automatic, and understandable, not a bottleneck that slows launches down. We're building the AI infrastructure that makes that possible.

We work with many of the world's largest retailers and brands across fashion, furniture, cosmetics, toys, electronics and many other product categories. We're backed by Y Combinator, and a roster of investors who see what we see: Product compliance is the next major infrastructure category, and we're leading it.

About The Role

Every product you've ever bought, from a kid's toy dinosaur to your electric toothbrush, had to clear a wall of regulation before it reached you. That wall is written down somewhere: scattered across hundreds of government portals, PDFs, and legal databases, in dozens of languages, updated on no schedule anyone agreed to.

Your job is to turn that chaos into structured, queryable data our product can act on. You'll be the person who makes the world's product regulations machine-readable.

The data layer everything stands on

This is not a role where you write Python scripts in isolation. You'll understand, crawl, and monitor regulatory sources across hundreds of jurisdictions, parse raw legal text into a normalized requirement schema, and catch changes the day they land, so every label, Declaration of Conformity, and risk assessment we generate is provably current.

The interesting problems are everywhere: government portals that were last redesigned when fax machines were current, legal text that means different things in different translations, amendments that quietly rewrite three other acts, and the question of how you prove to an enterprise customer that your data was correct on the day they shipped. LLMs make structured extraction over legal text possible for the first time; making it reliable enough to stake a product launch on is the engineering problem you'll own.

You'll do this sitting next to the founders, our AI engineers, and our in-house compliance experts at our Copenhagen HQ. No layers, no ticket queues. When a source breaks or a regulation changes, the fix ships in hours, not sprints.

What You'll Actually Do


Build and operate the crawling and monitoring layer across hundreds of regulatory sources: government portals, legislative databases, and official gazettes in dozens of languages
Parse raw legal text (HTML, PDFs, scans) into a normalized requirement schema, using LLM-assisted extraction pipelines you design, evaluate, and harden
Build change detection that catches new acts, amendments, and repeals the day they land, and triggers the downstream updates our customers depend on
Own data quality end to end: provenance, versioning, and coverage metrics, so every requirement in the platform traces back to its primary source
Work with our regulatory experts to evolve the schema and taxonomy as coverage grows from the EU to new jurisdictions
Shape the architecture, tooling, and data culture as the team grows


You will love this job, if you are:


An engineer with several years building data pipelines, crawling infrastructure, or large-scale extraction systems
Experienced with (or seriously hungry to go deep on) LLM-assisted extraction: structured outputs, evals, and the failure modes of models reading dense text
Someone who treats data correctness as sacred: provenance, versioning, and "how do we know this is still true?" are your favorite questions
Unafraid of messy sources: broken HTML, scanned PDFs, and legal prose in languages you don't speak are puzzles, not blockers
Product-minded: You understand that a quality manager will stake a product launch on your pipeline's output
Bonus points if you have worked with regulatory data before
Comfortable with ambiguity and speed: Small team, fast decisions, no spec handed down from above
Excited to work on-site in Copenhagen with the whole team
A builder at heart


What You Get


Ownership of the regulatory data layer, the foundation the entire product stands on
Zero layers: You sit next to the founders, the AI team, and the compliance experts whose domain you're turning into data
Ground floor of a category-defining company, backed by Y Combinator and investors betting on product compliance becoming the next big thing
Competitive salary and equity
An office where the pastries are mandatory


If you've read this far and thought "that's the data problem I want to own," we'd like to meet you.

Title: Dataspecialist - Afd. for Uddannelse og Studerende
Place: Kongens Lyngby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

Vil du være med til at rykke data og mennesker tættere på hinanden på et af Danmarks førende universiteter?

På DTU arbejder vi med uddannelsesdata, men data skaber først værdi, når de bliver forstået, anvendt og omsat til bedre beslutninger. Derfor søger vi en dataspecialist, der motiveres af at bygge bro mellem data, forretning og mennesker. En kollega, der kan skabe fælles forståelse af data på tværs af organisationen og hjælpe både medarbejdere og ledere med at bruge data som et kvalificeret grundlag for udvikling.

Du bliver en vigtig del af vores arbejde med at styrke datamodenheden på uddannelsesområdet og skabe større tillid til de data, vi bruger i hverdagen.

Bliv en del af Læringsteknologi & Analyse

Du bliver en del af Læringsteknologi & Analyse, hvor vi arbejder med læringsteknologi, digitalisering og analyse til understøttelse af DTU's uddannelsesområde.

Vi ønsker at bringe data endnu tættere på forretningen. Derfor søger vi en kollega, der ikke alene kan analysere data, men som også kan skabe dialog, bygge relationer og støtte organisationen i at omsætte data til handling.

Du kommer til at samarbejde tæt med studieadministrative medarbejdere og andre centrale aktører på tværs af DTU.

Du skal kunne lide…


at skabe værdi i samarbejde med andre. Og i denne stilling er det lige så vigtigt at stille de rigtige spørgsmål som at finde de rigtige svar.


Du skal hjælpe os med at skabe et fælles sprog om data og bidrage til, at data anvendes mere systematisk i arbejdet med blandt andet uddannelseskvalitet, udvikling og prioritering.

Du trives derfor både med at fordybe dig i data og med at stå foran en gruppe kollegaer eller ledere og skabe fælles forståelse af resultater, sammenhænge og muligheder.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:


omsætte uddannelsesdata til overskuelige nøgletal, visualiseringer og fortællinger
kvalitetssikre og videreudvikle datagrundlaget på uddannelsesområdet
udarbejde analyser og dataopgørelser, der understøtter udvikling og prioritering
understøtte ledere og fagmiljøer med analyser, indsigter og datadrevet beslutningsstøtte
bistå med indberetning af uddannelsesdata til fx Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet, Danmarks Statistik, Rigsarkivet og Danske Universiteter
identificere nye muligheder for anvendelse af uddannelsesdata


Kvalifikationer og kompetencer

Det er vigtigt, at du er løsningsorienteret og proaktiv. Du skal derudover være nysgerrig og have mod på at tilegne dig viden til opbygning af forretningsforståelse. Og så forestiller vi os, at du:


har erfaring med analyse og arbejde med data
er stærk i både skriftlig og mundtlig formidling
kan omsætte komplekse sammenhænge til klare budskaber og konkrete anbefalinger
er stærk i både skriftlig og mundtlig formidling
er nysgerrig på forretningens behov og motiveres af at skabe værdi for brugerne af data
er god til at skabe relationer og facilitere dialog på tværs af fagligheder og organisatoriske niveauer
har forståelse for samspillet mellem processer, systemer og data
arbejder struktureret og har blik for kvalitet


Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med værktøjer som Qlik, R eller Python, men det vigtigste er, at du kan omsætte data til indsigt og skabe værdi i samarbejde med andre.

Din uddannelses- og erfaringsmæssige baggrund kan være forskellig. Du kan komme med erfaring som analytiker, dataspecialist eller fra en rolle, hvor du har arbejdet med at skabe sammenhæng mellem data, forretning og beslutninger.

Hvem tror vi, du er?

Du er typen, der gerne graver dig ned i data for at forstå en problemstilling, men som får lige så meget energi af at diskutere resultaterne med kolleger og ledere.

Du er nysgerrig, løsningsorienteret og optaget af at skabe fælles forståelse. Og du motiveres af at gøre data anvendelige for mennesker, der ikke nødvendigvis selv arbejder med data til daglig.

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

I Læringsteknologi & Analyse vægter vi personlig trivsel, kollegial sparring og samarbejde højt og tror på, at det bidrager positivt til vores fællesskab og løsning af arbejdsopgaver. Vi har et uformelt arbejdsklima med plads til gode idéer, sparring og humor og vægter en høj fleksibilitet i tilrettelæggelsen af vores opgaveløsning og arbejdsdag. Tillid til hinanden og til ledelsen er en grundpille, hvilket skaber en følelse af sikkerhed og tryghed i arbejdsmiljøet. Vi forventer, at du har gode samarbejdsevner og også har lyst til at indgå aktivt i samarbejdet både lokalt og på tværs af DTU.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til overenskomst for akademikere i staten. Du ansættes som fuldmægtig, specialkonsulent, chefkonsulent. Der kan desuden forhandles tillæg i henhold til DTU's lønstruktur for AC TAP: https://www.inside.dtu.dk/human-resources/under-ansaettelsen/loen/loenstrukturer

Eller i henhold til LC/CO10-fællesoverenskomsten og organisationsaftale for IT-medarbejdere (Prosa) i statens tjeneste.

Der kan desuden forhandles tillæg i henhold til DTU's lønstruktur for PROSA: https://www.inside.dtu.dk/human-resources/under-ansaettelsen/loen/loenstrukturer

Eller i henhold til OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten og organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og It-medarbejdere (HK/Stat).

Der kan desuden forhandles tillæg i henhold til DTU's lønstruktur for HK Kontor eller HK Laborant: https://www.inside.dtu.dk/human-resources/under-ansaettelsen/loen/loenstrukturer

Der er tale om en fast stilling på 37 timer om ugen.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Vi skal modtage din online ansøgning senest den 14. september 2026. Åbn linket "Ansøg nu", hvor du udfylder ansøgningsformularen samt vedhæfter motiveret ansøgning, CV og eksamensbeviser.

Ønsker du flere oplysninger om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte teamkoordinator, Magnus Brabrand Ditlev ( mabdi@dtu.dk / tlf. 2179 8849) eller kontorchef, Jette Kolby ( jklk@dtu.dk / tlf. 2837 7431)

Alle interesserede uanset alder, køn, handicap, race, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold, opfordres til at søge stillingen. Da DTU arbejder med forskning i kritisk teknologi, hvormed der gælder særlige regler for blandt andet sikkerhed og eksportkontrol, kan der blive foretage open source-baggrundstjek af kvalificerede kandidater til stillingen.

DTU – Til gavn for samfundet siden 1829

DTU er et af Europas førende tekniske eliteuniversiteter. Med forskning og uddannelser i international topklasse skaber vi løsninger på tidens store samfundsmæssige udfordringer og bidrager til at sikre Europas globale førerposition inden for bæredygtig teknologiudvikling. Siden H.C. Ørsted grundlagde DTU for snart 200 år siden, har vores mission været den samme: Vi udvikler og nyttiggør naturvidenskab og teknisk videnskab til gavn for samfundet. DTU har 13.800 studerende, 1.600 ph.d.-studerende og 6.500 ansatte. Vi arbejder i et internationalt miljø og har en inkluderende, udviklende og uformel arbejdskultur. DTU har campusser i hele Danmark og i Grønland og samarbejder med de bedste universiteter verden over.
