Title: Dataanalytiker
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
HOFOR arbejder målrettet med data, BI, AI og digitalisering som grundlag for bedre beslutninger, mere effektive arbejdsgange og større værdi på tværs af organisationen. Vi søger en dataanalytiker, som kan omsætte forretningsbehov til analyser, datamodeller og løsninger, der skaber reel værdi i praksis.

Analyse og udvikling af BI- og dataløsninger

Du bliver en del af sektionen AI & BI Udvikling og får en central rolle i at bygge bro mellem forretning, data og teknologi. Du skal identificere behov, kvalificere idéer og omsætte dem til analyser, dashboards og datadrevne løsninger, der understøtter beslutninger, optimerer processer og fremmer HOFORs digitale udvikling.

Dine opgaver bliver at:


Indsamle, analysere og visualisere data samt omsætte mønstre, afvigelser og tendenser til indsigter, der kan bruges i beslutninger og prioritering
Analysere årsager bag nøgletal og KPI’er
Udvikle, vedligeholde og optimere dashboards, KPI-overvågning og rapporteringsløsninger i Power BI
Arbejde med dataudtræk, transformation og indlæsning af data fra forskellige datakilder
Udvikle og dokumentere datamodeller, semantiske modeller, dataflows, processer og analyser
Sikre datakvalitet, validering, performance og governance i løsningerne
Samarbejde med IT om databaser, API-integrationer, connectorer og systemunderstøttelse
Bidrage til prioritering og kvalificering af BI-, data- og AI-initiativer



God forretningsforståelse og erfaring med dataanalyse og BI

Du har nogle års erfaring med dataanalyse, rapportering eller BI-udvikling. Du kombinerer gode analytiske evner med en solid teknisk forståelse og trives i krydsfeltet mellem forretning, data og teknologi. Du er nysgerrig på sammenhænge, ser bag om tallene og evner at omsætte dataindsigter til konkrete anbefalinger og handlemuligheder.

Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:


Har erfaring med Power BI, SQL, databaser, datamodellering, ETL-processer, Power Query og DAX
Kan omsætte forretningsbehov til relevante analyser, KPI'er, dashboards og anbefalinger
Har forståelse for datakvalitet, governance, integrationer og samspillet mellem forretning, data og IT-systemer
Kommunikerer dataindsigter klart og konstruktivt og trives i samarbejdet med mange forskellige interessenter



Dine dygtige kolleger er klar til at byde dig velkommen

Du får ni dygtige kolleger, du kan sparre og grine med i hverdagen og bliver en del af et tværfagligt team med AI- og UX-specialister, BI-udviklere og projektledere. Derudover bliver du også en del af et større digitaliseringsområde med 180 engagerede medarbejdere.

Vi værdsætter faglig forskellighed og prioriterer et sundt og fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø, der bl.a. giver plads og mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter aftale med nærmeste leder. Hos os er der plads til dig, og til at du har et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv.

Du kan læse mere om vores medarbejdergoder her .

Sådan bliver du vores kollega

Er du klar til nye muligheder, så ser vi frem til at høre fra dig senest den 3. september 2026. Vi vil gerne gøre det nemt for dig at søge vores stilling, du skal derfor ikke skrive en ansøgning, men blot sende dit CV, hvor du sætter nogle ord på din motivation for at søge stillingen. Du kan finde inspiration til at skrive et motiveret CV her.

Vi afholder 1. samtaler den 10. og 11. september og 2. samtaler den 15. og 18. september.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionsleder Shadi Chreiteh på tlf. 34458460.

Søg stillingen ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen”.

Hos os får du plads

Vand, varme, hverdag. I HOFOR sikrer vi forsyningen i hovedstadsområdet. Men vores ansvar rækker længere: Vi skaber fremtidens bæredygtige byer. Det kræver overskud, og derfor giver vi dig plads. Plads til at forfølge de store ideer og til at hente de små. Plads til at dyrke de faglige detaljer og til at tegne de store linjer. Plads til at hjælpe hinanden og til at tænke nyt, når der er brug for det. Vi har plads til flere og til, at du kan være med.

HOFOR. Hos os får du plads. Til fællesskab, udvikling og et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv.

Inkluderende kultur og rekruttering

I HOFOR arbejder vi på at skabe en inkluderende kultur, og vi leder efter dygtige kollegaer uanset udseende, køn, kønsidentitet, seksuel orientering, etnicitet, religion, handicap, alder osv. Vi vil gerne skabe lige muligheder for alle samt sikre en retfærdig rekrutteringsproces. Undlad venligst at vedhæfte et billede.

Title: Advanced Analytics Specialist, Supply Chain Intelligence
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you passionate about driving high-impact projects in a global supply chain? Do you want to play a key role in delivering transformational initiatives that shape how Ambu scales, operates, and delivers value to patients worldwide?

Ambu is transforming – and this is your opportunity to shape how intelligence drives our supply chain.

We have recently evolved our analytics function into a Supply Chain Intelligence team within our Global Supply Chain organization, and we are seeking an Advanced Analytics Specialist to join us. The team’s ambition is clear: moving from describing what happened to knowing what to do next. You will play a central role in delivering this journey; building predictive and prescriptive models, enabling what-if scenarios and decision support, and strengthening the data foundation that underpins it all; while helping build a data-driven culture across the global supply chain.

At Ambu, we are on an ambitious growth journey - scaling our operations and capabilities to meet the rising global demand for our innovative medical solutions. As part of this journey, you will join a highly motivated team that values initiative, impact, and collaboration; and you will have a front-row seat in maturing how data and intelligence power our global supply chain.

The role

As an Advanced Analytics Specialist, your primary responsibility is to design, build, and deploy analytics solutions that move our global supply chain from descriptive dashboards to predictive and prescriptive intelligence. You will work across our five focus areas: data foundation, reporting & visibility, advanced analytics, decision support, and analytics enablement; with the greatest emphasis on advanced analytics and decision support.

This is a hands-on role where technical depth meets business-centric problem-solving. Working closely with the Advanced Analytics Manager, GSC, you will partner with stakeholders across corporate functions and manufacturing sites – bridging business and IT – to ensure that data becomes a strategic asset embedded in how Ambu’s supply chain makes decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced analytics & decision support (primary focus)


Develop, deploy, and maintain predictive and prescriptive models (e.g., forecasting, anomaly detection, optimization) that address concrete supply chain challenges across planning, operations, and distribution
Build what-if scenario and simulation capabilities that give leadership actionable decision support; not just reporting
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical problems, and analytical results into clear recommendations for stakeholders and leadership
Automate recurring analyses and workflows to free capacity across the organization for higher-value work
Take ownership of solutions end-to-end: from problem framing and data preparation to model deployment in collaboration with back-end IT, monitoring, and adoption


Data foundation, visibility & analytics enablement


Contribute to advancing our data foundation toward a single source of truth; improving data quality, governance, and data models in collaboration with IT
Develop and enhance Power BI dashboards and standard GSC reporting where they create genuine visibility and value
Support upskilling across the global supply chain through training, documentation, and self-service enablement; helping embed a data-driven culture
Stay curious about new technologies (AI, machine learning, modern analytics tooling) and proactively bring relevant opportunities into the team


Suggested candidate profile

Skills

Skills and experience can be gained in many ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be described on paper. You are, however, likely to succeed in this position if you have:


2–5 years of experience in analytics, data science, or business intelligence roles. You may have gained your experience in a consultancy, an industrial company, or a data-driven scale-up
Strong hands-on skills in SQL and Python (or R) for data preparation, analysis, and modelling
Solid experience with Power BI – including DAX and data modelling – and an eye for visualizations that drive decisions
Experience building predictive models (e.g., forecasting or machine learning) and bringing at least one into real operational use; you know the difference between a notebook and a solution people rely on
Strong business translation skills; you can turn a vague business question into an analytical approach, and an analytical result into a clear recommendation
A working understanding of supply chain processes (e.g., planning, manufacturing, logistics, or distribution); you don't need to be a supply chain expert, but you can speak the language of operations and understand the physical flows behind the data
Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills; you build trust quickly and collaborate effectively across functions and levels
A proactive, structured and independent way of working: you thrive in a maturing environment where you help build the way, not just follow it


It is an advantage if you have experience with the following:


Deeper experience within supply chain planning, S&OP, or distribution analytics
ERP data (e.g., Infor), cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Fabric), or optimization and simulation techniques
Experience in integrating new data (e.g., through API/EDI) into database and semantic models
Experience in training or upskilling non-technical colleagues
Exposure to a GxP-regulated industry


Please note that due to the upcoming summer holiday period, the recruitment process may take slightly longer than usual. We expect to begin the interview process at the beginning of August.

Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Title: Product Owner & Analytics Engineer
Description:
Har du evnen til at forstå forretningens behov, prioritere de vigtigste indsatser og omsætte dem til dataløsninger, der skaber værdi i praksis? Så er du måske vores nye Product Owner & Analytics Engineer.

En nøglerolle i udviklingen af OK's dataplatform

Du bliver en del af Data Engineering & BI, som har en central rolle i at gøre data til et strategisk aktiv på tværs af OK. Vi er i gang med en ambitiøs transformation, hvor vi bygger en moderne dataplatform og udvikler nye måder at arbejde med data på – med fokus på skalerbarhed, kvalitet, genanvendelighed og forretningsværdi.

I rollen kombinerer du Product Ownership og Analytics Engineering. Du sætter retningen for dit område, prioriterer indsatserne og sikrer, at teamet arbejder med det, der skaber størst værdi. Samtidig arbejder du hands-on med datamodellering, forretningslogik og udviklingen af data products, der omsætter data til konkrete indsigter og løsninger for forretningen.

Du får en bred kontaktflade på tværs af organisationen og stor indflydelse på både prioriteringer, arbejdsformer og udviklingen af OK's dataplatform.

Vi søger en profil, der forener kompetencer fra både Product Owner- og BI-udviklerrollen. Du kan kombinere forretningsforståelse, produktledelse og analytiske kompetencer for at sikre, at data omsættes til løsninger, der bliver anvendt og skaber værdi.

Dine opgaver er at:


Drive data- og analyseinitiativer fra idé til forretningsværdi.
Eje og prioritere backloggen for dit område.
Omsætte forretningsbehov til data products, KPI'er og analyser.
Udvikle genanvendelige datamodeller og forretningslogik.
Sikre høj anvendelse af data gennem stærke løsninger og tæt forretningsdialog.
Udfordre behov og skabe alignment mellem forretning, IT og Data.
Bidrage til udviklingen af OK's moderne dataplatform.


Du balancerer forretning, teknologi og samarbejde

Du trives i krydsfeltet mellem forretning og teknologi og motiveres af at omsætte behov til løsninger, der skaber værdi. Du tager naturligt ejerskab, skaber fremdrift og formår at omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til konkrete initiativer. Samtidig bygger du stærke relationer, udfordrer konstruktivt og skaber tillid på tværs af organisationen.

Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med:


Product Ownership eller lignende roller med ansvar for prioritering, roadmap og backlog.
At omsætte forretningsbehov til data products, analyser og konkrete løsninger.
Stakeholder management og samarbejde på tværs af forretning og IT.
Datamodellering, forretningslogik og udvikling af genanvendelige dataløsninger.
At skabe værdi og adoption gennem datadrevne løsninger.
Datakvalitet, governance og dokumentation.


Vi ser også gerne, at du har erfaring med følgende teknologier og værktøjer:


Databricks
Power BI
SQL
Spark Declarative Pipelines


Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har erfaring med:

Microsoft SQL Server BI (SSIS, SSAS og SSRS)

Derfor skal du søge

Du bliver en del af et område i stor udvikling, hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på både vores dataplatform og den måde, vi arbejder med data på.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:


En central rolle med stor indflydelse på OK's dataområde
Mulighed for at præge vores dataplatform og arbejdsmetoder
Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger
Stor kontaktflade og tæt samarbejde med forretningen
Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
Fleksible arbejdsforhold, sundhedsforsikring og attraktive personalegoder


Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig. Send dit CV og fortæl os kort, hvorfor netop du motiveres af at skabe værdi gennem data.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at tage fat i Senior Manager, Data Engineering, Peter Marcker på tlf. nr.: +4561680118.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med:

Microsoft SQL Server BI (SSIS, SSAS og SSRS)

Du bliver en del af et område i stor udvikling, hvor du får mulighed for at sætte dit præg på både vores dataplatform og den måde, vi arbejder med data på.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Title: BI & Data Consultant
Description:
Join Our Digital Transformation Journey

At Palsgaard, we are continuing our digital transformation by strengthening the applications, data platforms, and integrations that support our global business processes.

To support this journey, we are looking for a BI & Data Consultant who will play a key role in developing and improving our data platform, BI solutions, integrations, and business application landscape. The role combines hands-on technical development with close collaboration across IT and the business to turn data, BI, digital opportunities, and AI into scalable solutions.

In this role, you will work across a focused portfolio of BI, data platform, integration, and business-critical application technologies, including:


Our central data platform, which consolidates business data for reporting, analytics, and integrations between applications.
Power BI, Fabric, semantic models, and Microsoft Copilot, helping strengthen reporting, AI adoption, and value creation across the organization.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365FO) and related integrations.
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CRM), Work Point, and other business applications that support our global processes.


Our solutions are largely cloud-based and built on Microsoft Azure technologies. You will play an active role in maintaining, enhancing, and future-proofing our data platform, BI solutions, and related application landscape while ensuring strong collaboration between business stakeholders, IT, and external partners.

Your responsibilities:

As a BI & Data Consultant, you will be an important part of Palsgaard’s Global BI and Data Platform team in our global IT department in Juelsminde. You will contribute to strengthening the digital and data foundation that supports Palsgaard’s strategic priorities.

Your responsibilities will include:


Develop, maintain, and further modernize our central data warehouse/data platform, including data ingestion, transformation, data modelling, and preparation of reliable data for reporting and analytics.
Develop Power BI reports from our backlog in close collaboration with global business stakeholders and the BI team, ensuring high-quality, scalable data models and clear analytical storytelling.
Contribute to improving how Palsgaard uses AI across the organization and how AI can support the development, documentation, automation, and quality of BI solutions created by the team.
Support daily operation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of BI, data platform, and integration solutions.
Develop an understanding of Palsgaard’s broader IT application landscape and contribute to projects across global IT.


What we are looking for:

You bring a strong existing skill set, a relevant educational background, and solid hands-on experience within BI, data engineering, ETL processes, data warehousing/data platforms, and data modelling. You have the technical foundation to contribute actively from the start, while also bringing the curiosity and ambition needed to understand our business processes and help raise the capability, quality, and performance of our Global BI and Data Platform team.

Ideally, you bring a combination of:


A strong existing skill set within BI, ETL, data warehousing/data platforms, and semantic data modelling, supported by solid hands-on experience.
A good understanding of Microsoft-based technologies, preferably including Azure-based data warehouse development, Power BI/Fabric and Microsoft Dynamics AX or Finance and Operations (D365F&O).
The ability to understand existing business processes and translate business needs into sustainable data and application solutions.
An interest in working where business processes, technology, and data meet, combined with curiosity about new digital opportunities.
Experience with AI tools, combined with an understanding of relevant use cases and governance considerations, will be considered an advantage.


Who are you?

We are looking for a colleague who:


Has an outgoing and collaborative mindset, builds trust easily, and works effectively with colleagues, stakeholders, and external partners.
Is a self-starter, takes ownership, works in a structured and pragmatic way with an eye for the detail, and follows initiatives through from idea to implementation.
Is motivated to contribute to the future roadmap for how data, BI, and AI are used across Palsgaard.
Communicates clearly and builds strong relationships across functions and locations in a global organization.


What We Offer

At Palsgaard, you will join a company with a strong heritage, ambitious growth plans, and a clear focus on digital transformation.

We offer attractive employment conditions, including a 7th vacation week, health insurance, profit sharing through an additional pension scheme, and extensive opportunities for personal and professional development.

You will become part of an international environment with colleagues and customers around the world, while enjoying the benefits of working in a collaborative and informal culture located in beautiful surroundings at Palsgaard Estate in Juelsminde.

For further information, please contact Team Lead, Global BI and Data Platform, Martin Nordestgaard +45 4072 2788

Why Join Palsgaard?

This is a unique opportunity to take on a broad and influential role where you will help shape how data, BI, AI, and business applications are used across a global organization.

You will work with modern Microsoft technologies, drive digital initiatives across the organization, and contribute to building a scalable, integrated, and data-driven platform that supports our future growth.

At Palsgaard, technology is not just about systems—it is about enabling our people and business to perform at their best. As a BI & Data Consultant, you will be at the center of that journey.

Title: Data & Analytics Engineer for NAM Trading Quants
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job ID: 5318

Are you ready to be the driving force behind a modern data platform that shapes how trading decisions are made? We are looking for a skilled Data and Analytics Engineer who is passionate about building robust, scalable data infrastructure and data modelling solutions that unlock meaningful analytics and insights across our trading organization.

The role is a full time position based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

About Our Team

Meet the Trading Quants team. We add value by being change enablers that drive transformation of the investment process as part of an agile value stream where we identify business problems, define and implement solutions, to generate tangible value for our clients.

Our team is part of Nordea Asset Management, Global Trading. Within the investment management area, Global Trading, is responsible for order generation and trade execution on behalf of portfolio managers across asset classes. As a team, we homogenize data across asset classes, add structure and measurability to our investment processes, to unlock scale and quality throughout the organization.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What You’ll Be Doing

Main responsibilities in this role:


Extend our data platform, adding new data sources and transformations in response to new business requirements.
Build internal tools to support our trading desks.
Assist with implementing AI use cases leveraging our data models.
Drive projects within a value stream, binding together business and technology, to ensure we deliver tangible outcomes for our clients.
Interact with internal and external stakeholders, and our technology providers.


You’ll join a motivated and experienced quant team that values a cooperative environment where you can draw on your teammates' expertise and commitment to excellence.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you are someone who takes ownership of your work and is driven to make a meaningful impact, while being comfortable sharing your opinions and challenging established ways of thinking. You bring a software engineering mindset to your data work, embracing practices such as everything-as-code and automated testing. You thrive on learning quickly, are interested in exploring alternative ways of working, and possess strong stakeholder management skills that enable you to build relationships and influence outcomes across the organization.

Your background and skills include:


Experience working in a data analytics or data engineering capacity ideally using Python.
Experience with SQL.
An interest in asset management and financial markets.
Fluent in English both verbal and written.


It would be ideal if you also:


Are familiar with Snowflake and dbt.
Have practical knowledge of using Apache Airflow e.g. building DAGs.
Have experience with AWS or other public cloud solution.
Have hands-on experience implementing AI use cases, or a demonstrable enthusiasm for leveraging AI to drive innovation and efficiency.


If this sounds like you, get in touch!

What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 07/09/2026.

For more information, you’re welcome to contact Simon Hørdum Bonde at simon.bonde@nordea.com.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

Title: Analytiker - gør komplekse data til robuste løsninger for PFA's kunder
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
"Det her er rollen for dig, der interesserer dig for data og vil omsætte dem til konkrete forbedringer. Du får ansvar for at sikre et præcist og gennemtestet datagrundlag til pris- og produktfornyelser samt levere analyser og analytiske produkter, der understøtter gode beslutninger og skaber værdi for både kunder og kollegaer,” siger Mads Holm Madsen, Leder af Analyse.

Så hvad er det egentlig, du skal?

Som Analytiker får du en central rolle i teamets data- og analysearbejde, hvor du omsætter komplekse data til analyser, analytiske produkter og beslutningsgrundlag for forretningen. Du arbejder tæt sammen med forretningen om at skabe løsninger, der bidrager til at udvikle og forenkle vores dataarbejde. En af dine kerneopgaver bliver data- og analysearbejdet knyttet til pris- og produktfornyelser – lige fra fastlæggelse af krav og kriterier for dataudtræk til selve udtrækket, validering, kvalitetssikring og endelig leverance.

Gør dataarbejdet mere robust og skab nye analytiske indsigter

Som Analytiker bliver du ansvarlig for at:


Varetage data- og analysearbejdet i forbindelse med vores pris- og produktfornyelser for vores virksomhedsordninger, hvor det er centralt at overholde deadlines.
Identificere relevante kundegrupper, udarbejde dataudtræk og kvalitetssikre resultaterne, herunder teste edge-cases før levering til brevvarianter og frister.
Bidrage til at etablere datagrundlaget og kontinuerligt forbedre processen, blandt andet gennem automatiske test, så arbejdsgruppen lettere kan validere data og arbejde effektivt.
Levere analyser og analytiske produkter, der omsætter komplekse data til indsigter og beslutningsgrundlag for forretningen.


Hvem er du?


Du har erfaring som analytiker i en større organisation og solid praktisk erfaring med Python og SQL til databehandling og kendskab til Databricks og Spark.
Du arbejder præcist og struktureret med data, hvor kvalitetssikring og test er afgørende.

Title: Data Management Consultant
Description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Responsibilities & Technologies

In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including: Azure SQL Server, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, and others.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your Responsibilites Will Typically Include


Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.
Structuring and collection of data from various sources.
Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.
Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.
Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.


About You

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within data management. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. You thrive in a development-oriented environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:


ETL and Database technologies.
Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.
Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.


Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

Title: Trading Quant
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job ID: 5317

Are you ready to be part of a team that drives transformation of the trading process - from client inflow to post-trade analysis? We are now looking for a curious Trading Quant that strives for data-driven decision-making, to enhance the measurability of the actions taken by traders and portfolio managers, and to enable our traders to better source liquidity and manage execution risk.

The role is a full time position based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

About Our Team

Meet the Trading Quants team. We add value by being change enablers that drive transformation of the investment process as part of an agile value stream where we identify business problems, define and implement solutions, to generate tangible value for our clients.

Our team is part of Nordea Asset Management, Global Trading. Within the investment management area, Global Trading, is responsible for order generation and trade execution on behalf of portfolio managers across asset classes. As a team, we homogenize data across asset classes, add structure and measurability to our investment processes, to unlock scale and quality throughout the organization.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us. 

What You’ll Be Doing

Main responsibilities in this role:


Engage with traders to solve their execution challenges by providing them with data, frameworks, and tools that improve the search for liquidity and highlights execution risks.
Implement AI use cases leveraging our data models.
Drive projects within a value stream, binding together business and technology, to ensure we deliver tangible outcomes for our clients.
Ensure data-driven decision-making by expanding our Trading Data Model and its applications.
Interact with internal and external stakeholders, and our technology providers.
Extract data insights for client services and senior management on an ad-hoc basis.


You’ll join a motivated and experienced quant team that values a cooperative environment where you can draw on your teammates' expertise and commitment to excellence.

Who You Are

This is the right role for you if you are someone who takes ownership of your work and is driven to make a meaningful impact, while being comfortable sharing your opinions and challenging established ways of thinking. You excel at both analytical and technical problem-solving skills, and have the ability to drive projects forward effectively within virtual team environments. You thrive on learning quickly, are interested in exploring alternative ways of working, and possess strong stakeholder management skills that enable you to build relationships and influence outcomes across the organization.

Your background and skills include:


A solid academic foundation e.g. a masters in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, etc.
Experience with Python and SQL.
An interest in asset management and financial markets.
Fluent in English both verbal and written.


It would be ideal if you also:


Are skilled in building data models using e.g. data build tool (dbt).
Have hands-on experience implementing AI use cases, or a demonstrable enthusiasm for leveraging AI to drive innovation and efficiency.
Have experience with SimCorp Dimension and Snowflake.


What We Offer

People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.

A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.

Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.

Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application no later than 11/09/2026.

For more information, you’re welcome to contact Simon Hørdum Bonde at simon.bonde@nordea.com.

We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.

We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.

We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.

We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.

We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

Title: Business Analytics Consultant
Description:
Twoday er den førende digitale transformationspartner i Nordeuropa med en global tilstedeværelse. Med cirka 3.000 teknologer samarbejder vi med de mest beundrede private og offentlige organisationer for at levere banebrydende digitale løsninger. Vores dybe brancheekspertise omfatter Data & AI, softwareudvikling, digitale oplevelser og forretningsapplikationer. Vores team, der opererer i hele Norden og Litauen, genererede en omsætning på 280 millioner euro i 2023. Vi betjener over 8.000 kunder og understøtter deres digitale transformationsrejser.

Vil du være med på Danmarks stærkeste team af Business Analytics-konsulenter? Vil du arbejde med nogle af Danmark største virksomheder? Tænder du på at gøre komplekse problemstillinger til simple løsninger for kunderne? Så er twoday Data & AI det rigtige sted for dig! Vi søger nye Business Analytics-konsulenter til et af vores kontorer i Danmark.

Om stillingen

Som Business Analytics-konsulent vil du indgå i et stærkt team med en varierende hverdag – du vil få ansvar, frihed og faglig udvikling. Vores konsulenter besidder hver især stærke kompetencer, og du vil opleve kolleger, der er specialister på deres område.

Du vil sammen med vores kunder afklare de forretningsmæssige behov og derefter designe, udvikle og implementere løsningen. Alt efter kompleksitet og størrelse af løsningen arbejder du enten i et team eller som primær konsulent på løsningerne.

Vi holder faste firmadage, hvor sparring, idéudveksling og kollegialt sammenhold er i højsædet. Du vil opleve at blive udfordret, men du vil også få mulighed for at udfordre dine kolleger.

Fristet, men stadig i tvivl?


Turbo på det faglige! Hos twoday Data & AI er vores medarbejdere kendt for at have et skyhøjt fagligt niveau. Samtidig med at vi har det godt socialt.
Lækre kontorer! twoday Data & AI har lækre og moderne kontorer centralt placeret i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.
Tid til fordybelse! Vi har fire årlige fagdage, hvor idéudvikling, udvikling og sparring er i højsædet.
Uddannelse! Hos twoday Data & AI får du mulighed for efteruddannelse og certificeringer.
Attraktiv lønpakke! Vi tilbyder en attraktiv lønpakke med branchens bedste bonusordning.
Fantastisk kaffe! Hos twoday Data & AI har du adgang til fitness, frugt og fantastisk god kaffe.


Om dig

Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description



Business Analyst

Posting Start Date: 8/6/26

Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Working hours: Full-time

Work model: Hybrid

Contract type: Permanent

About The Role

We are excited to offer an incredible opportunity for a Business Analyst to join Scandinavian Tobacco Group’s Scandinavian cluster sales operation team. In this crucial role, you will be essential in leveraging data to drive business success, maximizing the value of our data, and ensuring accurate sales analysis, insights, and forecasting. Moreover, you will serve as a supportive anchor to empower our sales and marketing teams so they can accelerate our key growth enablers.

Your role as a dynamic, detail-oriented, and self-reliant professional is crucial in maximizing value across the Scandinavian sales cluster. A key part of your role will involve using data-driven insights to challenge the status quo, facilitating data usage across the entire organization, and managing expectations through strong cross-functional execution. You will report directly to the Sales Operations Lead.

WHAT WILL YOU BE RESPONSIBLE FOR?

Data Value & Sales Data Management


Enhance and maximize the value of data across the Scandinavian cluster organization. Automate and optimize sales data management and maintenance in close collaboration with key stakeholders. Lead data validation processes across systems and platforms.


Category & Business Analysis


Conduct category analysis and provide actionable recommendations for internal and external stakeholders. Monitor market price developments to proactively identify risks and business opportunities. Assist in building robust business cases supported by data-driven insights.


Forecasting & Performance Tracking


Oversee volume and event forecasting, as well as discount forecasting for campaigns. Track campaign performance and key performance indicators (KPIs), delivering actionable recommendations to improve outcomes. Prepare and present weekly and monthly internal reports to guide strategic decision-making.


WHAT SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE WILL BE REQUIRED?


Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, or a related field.
4 to 5 years of experience in a sales operations, data, or insights role, ideally within the FMCG industry.
Proven experience in data management, event forecasting, data validation, and handling market data sources (e.g., AC Nielsen).
Strong technical proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Experience with CRM/ERP tools (Salesforce, SAP) and data visualization tools (Power BI) is a major plus.
Strong analytical mindset with high attention to detail and a track record of driving change through data.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (written and verbal).
Knowledge of Danish or Swedish is a strong advantage.


Working At STG & What To Expect

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next.

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 480 000 DKK to 720 000 DKK corresponding to the level of the position, expected experience and responsibilities.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now and discover much more.

Our recruitment process

Requirements

Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against the key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you’ll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which may include the following steps:


Recruiter screen
Interview with the hiring team
Assessment, case study, or work sample
Final interview with leadership or key stakeholders


Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Please be informed that this Direct Search is conducted exclusively by Scandinavian Tobacco Group. We do not accept applications from agencies, and we will not provide compensation for unsolicited CVs.

Title: Dataanalytiker til EAE - Central Efterforskning i Midt- og Vestjyllands Politi
Description:
Central Efterforskning i Midt- og Vestjyllands Politi søger en civil dataanalytiker til Efterretnings- og analyseenheden (EAE).

Om EAE

EAE arbejder for at bekæmpe uvished og sikre, at ledelsen i Midt- og Vestjyllands Politikreds træffer beslutninger på et oplyst grundlag. Dette kræver en lang række forskellige politifaglige og tekniske kompetencer, hvoraf en af disse er databehandling og –analyse.

EAE søger en dataanalytiker til at skabe overblik over og forståelse af kriminalitetsbilledet, spotte opdagede tendenser, samt finde nålen i høstakken.

Dine opgaver

Du får en nøglefunktion i analyse- og efterretningsarbejdet med særligt fokus på at levere data til øverste ledelse og til øvrige sektioner i politikredsen.

Din primære opgave i EAE bliver at fremskaffe, behandle og fremstille relevant data, til de mange forespørgsler EAE modtager. Disse forespørgsler kan være på alt fra analyser på strategisk niveau og helt ned til måludpegning på operativt niveau.

Dine Primære Ansvarsområder Bliver Derfor At


skabe et dybdegående kendskab til Politiets datalandskab
fremsøge relevant data
sammenkoble data fra forskellige systemer
behandle, analysere og fremstille dine fund til beslutningstagerne.


Nogle Af Dine Øvrige Faste Opgaver Bliver


kriminalitetsanalyser
besvarelser af folketingsspørgsmål
trusselsvurderinger på arrangementer
måludpegning i konkrete efterforskninger.


Du indgår i et tæt samarbejde med øvrige medarbejdere i EAE, efterforskere, lokalpoliti, forebyggelse og ledelsen i kredsen.

Om dig

Du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og målrettet, men også være klar til at opsøge viden hos kollegaer eller på nettet. Dine opgaver vil sjældent have en prædefineret fremgangsmåde, så du skal selv finde den bedste løsning. Du skal derfor arbejde analytisk og systematisk, samt kunne dokumentere din metodik.

Vi forventer at du har en akademisk uddannelse og lægger desuden vægt på, at du:


arbejder struktureret
har en generel dataforståelse
evner at fremsøge, sammenkoble og behandle data
evner at tilegne dig ny viden
trives i tæt samarbejde og bidrager til fælles opgaveløsning
kommunikerer klart og professionelt
kan videreformidle fund fra dine analyser til kollegaer uden din tekniske indsigt.


Erfaring med programmering er en fordel, men er ikke et krav.

Politiet er en kompleks organisation med mange vinkler og arbejdsgange. Du kommer til at befinde dig i krydsfeltet mellem mange fagligheder, og skal få din faglighed til at supplerer andres.

Det vigtigste er, at du har viljen og lysten til at kaste dig over dette fagområde, og at du deltager aktivt i at udvikle og styrke EAE både med opgaveløsning, faglighed og en lyst til at bidrage positivt til arbejdsmiljøet i sektionen.

Vi tilbyder

En spændende arbejdsplads med mange fagligheder, og hvor du har muligheden for at dygtiggøre dig inden for din faglighed. Dit arbejde vil bidrage til løsningen af både operative og strategiske opgaver, og i sidste ende gøre Danmark til et tryggere sted.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt miljø med vidensdeling, sparring og mulighed for løbende kompetenceudvikling.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til den enhver tid gældende aftale mellem Finansministeriet og Akademikernes Centralorganisation.

Dit arbejdssted bliver Midt- og Vestjyllands Politi, Stationsvej 74, 7500 Holstebro.

Midt- og Vestjyllands Politi er en arbejdsplads med røg- og nikotinfri arbejdstid.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes til rette niveau, og at du kan bibeholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele din ansættelse.

Der forventes at blive afholdt samtaler i ugerne umiddelbart efter ansøgningsfristens udløb.

Stillingen forventes herefter besat snarest muligt.

Kontakt og ansøgning

Spørgsmål til stillingen kan rettes til politikommissær Henrik Varbøl på tlf. 61195294 eller på mail hva007@politi.dk (mailen kan ikke bruges til ansøgninger).

Når du søger en stilling i politiet, opretter du samtidig en profil i vores rekrutteringssystem. Hvis du søger flere stillinger i politiet, skal du lægge en ansøgning og et CV ind i systemet pr. ansøgt stilling. Foruden ansøgning og CV bedes du uploade dit eksamensbevis. Du skal uploade alle dokumenter i pdf-format.

Vi opfordrer alle interesserede til at søge uanset køn, alder, religion eller etnisk baggrund.

Title: Senior Operations Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Who we are looking for

We are looking for an experienced analyst who can take full ownership of capacity planning and forecasting within our operations team, and who thrives on turning data into concrete actions close to the business.

You will hit the ground running from day one and become a key person in professionalising our operations setup.

Over time, the role has the potential to grow into a broader operations responsibility as the organisation scales.

What you will be working on

Capacity planning & forecasting


Own and develop our capacity planning model across all advisors and task types
Build robust forecasting models that support staffing decisions and resource allocation
Ensure we always have an up-to-date and reliable picture of capacity vs. demand


Analysis & insight


Analyse time usage, efficiency and SLA adherence across the operations team
Identify automation opportunities and quantify the potential of specific initiatives
Deliver ongoing reporting to the leadership team


Direct collaboration with operations


Work closely with the operations team to translate analyses into action
Be the data resource that makes it easier for operations to make good decisions


What you bring


3-5 years in a comparable position
Strong analytical profile with experience in capacity planning, workforce management or operations analytics
Solid experience with SQL and data processing, preferably in Snowflake/DBT
Comfortable with forecasting methods and statistical modelling
Experience with BI tools. We use Lightdash.
Ability to communicate complex analyses clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Self-driven and action-oriented. You do not wait to be led.


Nice to have


Experience with Python for automation and modelling
Background from a company with seasonal fluctuations or variable demand
Experience building or optimising operational processes


What we offer


A role with real influence over how Skatteguiden scales its operations
Close collaboration with a strong data team and an engaged operations organisation
Opportunity to grow into a broader area of responsibility over time
Office-first culture in Copenhagen with a focus on professional sparring and community


Lean process


20-minute "vibe check" online screening call with The Hub
1-hour onsite case session with the hiring manager, a team member and product manager
30-minute onsite meet & greet with the CEO and COO

Title: Data Scientist
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.

40% of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste. 

We’re more than an app: we are a certified B Corporation with a mission to empower everyone to take action against food waste, so alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions - such as our Retail Technologies offering, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.

We’re growing fast: Our community of 133 million registered users and 261,000 active partners across 21 countries, have together already prevented 517+ million meals from going to waste - avoiding over 1.397.000 tonnes of CO2e!

Your mission

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our Product Analytics and Center of Excellence team at Too Good To Go.

In this role, you will help build and scale data science capabilities across product and business domains, enabling smarter, more automated, and more impactful decision-making.

As a marketplace, many of our most critical challenges revolve around supply-demand dynamics, user behavior, and marketplace efficiency. You will work on problems such as personalisation, optimisation, and forecasting, helping us move from reactive analysis to proactive, model-driven systems.

You will work as part of the Center of Excellence, partnering closely with Product, Analytics, and business teams through high-impact, project-based collaborations.

Your role

Partner with Product and business leaders to identify high-impact opportunities where data science can drive step-change improvements
Develop and deploy machine learning models and statistical methods to solve problems such as: Personalisation and recommendation systems, Marketplace optimisation (e.g. ranking, matching, supply-demand balance) and Demand and supply forecasting.
Translate ambiguous business problems into scalable models, algorithms, and data products
Design and contribute to experimentation and measurement frameworks to evaluate impact
Collaborate closely with Product Analysts, ML Engineers, and stakeholders within the Product Analytics and Center of Excellence, working in an embedded, project-based model
Take end-to-end ownership, from problem framing to model development and impact evaluation
Contribute to building data science best practices, tools, and standards across the company 

Requirements

Master’s degree or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Econometrics, or a related field
Strong experience applying machine learning and statistical modeling to product or business problems
Experience in at least one of the following areas: Personalisation / recommendation systems, Marketplace or optimisation problems, Forecasting (time series or causal)
Strong programming skills in Python and solid proficiency in SQL
Experience with experimentation (A/B testing) and impact measurement
Ability to operate in ambiguous problem spaces and translate them into structured solutions
Strong communication skills — able to influence product and business stakeholders
High ownership and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Fluent in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Our values

We win together: Food waste is a big beast to fight. We believe in a #oneteam.
We raise the bar: We always push for more. We work smart, smash barriers and elevate one another.
We keep it simple: Our ambitions are bold but our solutions are simple.
We build a legacy: We’re proud of the change we’re driving. 
We care: We always look out for each other. Caring is also about the way we do business. We do the right thing.

What We Have To Offer

An opportunity to work in a global social-impact company and certified B Corporation! where you can see a real and tangible impact in your role.
To be an integral part of our Data & Analytics team. We are eager for you to make an impact and contribute to the role of analytics across key decisions and our solution processes. Your insights are valuable, and we are here to listen.
Work-life balance is important to us! Focus on the job to be done, not the hours spent, there is no need for overtime.
We trust in our employees and encourage an autonomous environment that provides several opportunities for employees to contribute, develop and take ownership of their work in a way that works for them.
To be part of an international company, with over 1,300+ colleagues across 19 countries that are on the same important mission.
An informal environment, working alongside 170+ passionate people within Tech & Product
We celebrate our differences and our successes and have a strong values-driven team culture.
We work in a hybrid set-up and value in office work weekly.
We may be able to support you with a working visa in Copenhagen, please be prepared to discuss this topic further as your first stage interview.

How to apply

We take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above. Please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.
Submit your CV in English.
Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.

Job Ref:

A Movement for Everyone
We want to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. With that mission, it’s only natural that we want to build a diverse and inclusive team of highly capable individuals who are passionate about doing things in a better way. We strongly believe we all excel and are more creative when we’re allowed to be ourselves, and we’re committed to a culture where all of us belong.
We are an equal opportunity employer and all employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. If you need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Title: Quantitative analyst for Short-term Automated Trading
Description:
Quote

You will combine quantitative research, machine learning, and software engineering to uncover market inefficiencies and turn them into profitable trading strategies.

Here’s what the job entails

In the role, you will tackle challenging quantitative problems and develop fully automated, machine learning-driven trading strategies that operate 24/7 and have a direct impact on trading performance.

Your key responsibilities include:


designing, developing, and deploying machine learning-driven trading strategies using Python and modern machine learning/deep learning frameworks
transforming large-scale and high-dimensional datasets into actionable trading signals and predictive models
continuously improving existing models, infrastructure, and research processes to maintain a competitive edge
collaborating closely with traders and analysts to translate market insights into scalable quantitative solutions
staying at the forefront of developments in machine learning, deep learning, and quantitative finance, and taking full ownership of bringing new ideas into production


Meet your team

You will join our Short-term Automated Trading team, where we develop and operate algorithmic trading strategies in the European electricity markets by applying advanced quantitative methods, machine learning, and automation to make better trading decisions.

We are a team of highly motivated specialists with backgrounds in quantitative finance, mathematics, physics, computer science, and machine learning. We challenge each other's thinking, move quickly from idea to implementation, and share an ambition to build better models and make better trading decisions. We value intellectual curiosity, honest feedback, and rigorous thinking.

But enough about us… over to you!

You’ll work deeply with quantitative modelling and machine learning in a fast-moving domain, so you enjoy tackling complex quantitative challenges and turning ideas into measurable outcomes. You are driven by ownership, excellence, and the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled colleagues.

We also imagine that you:


hold an MSc or PhD in data science, computer science, mathematics, physics, or a related field
are an advanced Python developer with experience building robust, production-quality code
have extensive experience with machine learning techniques and frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, Scikit-learn)
keep up with the latest innovation in machine learning and deep learning, and enjoy turning cutting-edge research into practical solutions that deliver measurable value


Please note that prior knowledge of the energy sector is not required for this role. We welcome various levels of experience from a highly analytical environment and will tailor the role to your profile.

We’ll take good care of you

At Danske Commodities, we take great care of our people. Joining us means you’ll get a lot of great perks – including social events, cultural experiences, tasty food and benefits to better your health, your life and your future.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

Shape your development tailored growth plans, 100+ DC University courses & Harvard Learning access

100+ yearly events from office parties to DC Sports events, CS:GO team, student network & more

Global career paths as part of our parent company, Equinor’s 20,000-strong international network

Flexible work life adjustable hours, part-time options & up to 2 work from home days/week

Fuel Fridays one paid Friday off every month (July and December excluded)

Top-tier parental leave up to 26 weeks paid, pension during leave & post-leave support

Unlimited paid child's sick days because family comes first

Extra time off 5 additional days on top of your 5 weeks

Senior days extra time off if you’re 55+

Attractive package 10% pension, health insurance, bonus scheme & more

Share savings the option to join Equinor’s attractive share programme

Home setup covered paid internet, phone & IT gear

Free tickets & discounts culture, family fun, hotels, restaurants & more

Organic meals light breakfast, lunch, snacks, dinner & take-away

Barista café high-quality coffee, always on us

On-site wellness state-of-the-art gym, physio, chiro and massage therapy

New HQ in the heart of Aarhus with stunning views, inspiring architecture and close to public transport

…. and much more

We're an energy trading and optimisation company that works at the intersection of technology and energy economics. Our disciplined and scalable trading strategies are designed to be competitive in volatile markets and create value for our partners.

Title: Erfaren dataspecialist til Gældsstyrelsen, Center for Data, Analyse og Modeller
Place: Middelfart, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Motiveres du af at dykke ned i rå og komplekse datamængder, og er du dygtig til at formidle essensen af dem? Så er du måske vores nye dataspecialist i Center for Data, Analyse og Modeller i Gældsstyrelsen.




Gældsstyrelsen har hovedsæde i Middelfart og har ansvar for at inddrive gæld til det offentlige. Det er en opgave, der har stor betydning for samfundet og finansieringen af vores fælles velfærd.




Vi søger en dataspecialist til centeret, hvor vi udvikler vi analyser, modeller, automatiseringer, datadrevne løsninger og arbejder med strategiske initiativer, der understøtter en mere effektiv og intelligent inddrivelse.




Dialog- og samarbejdsorienteret dataspecialist

Som dataspecialist vil dine primære arbejdsopgaver være at udføre opgaver, hvor du gennem din viden og udstilling af data formår at gøre rå og komplekse datamængder forståelige og anvendelige for interne og eksterne interessenter.




Du vil blive en del af vores udsøgningsteam, som står for at svare på spørgsmål fra forskellige samarbejdspartnere, f.eks. Gældsstyrelsens driftsenheder der har behov for data til at lette sagsbehandlingen, datasvar til spørgsmål fra presse, ledelsesværktøjer til direktion mv.




Konkret får du bl.a. mulighed for at arbejde med dataudtræk via SQL, behandling af data i Excel og diverse rapporteringsløsninger, segmenteringer af datamateriale samt klargøring og formidling af data til et bredt publikum.




Nysgerrig, analytisk og dedikeret

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende – vigtigst er din forståelse for og evne til at arbejde med komplekse datamængder. Det forventes i jobbet, at du er proaktiv, nysgerrig, arbejder selvstændigt, og at du er en holdspiller, som værdsætter den videndeling, der kendetegner kulturen i vores center.




For at lykkes i rollen arbejder du struktureret og metodisk med store datamængder. Det falder dig naturligt at arbejde med forskellige IT-løsninger, hvor det er en fordel, hvis du er fortrolig med brugen af SQL, Excel og forskellige præsentationsværkstøjer såsom f.eks. PowerPoint.




Det er væsentligt, at du er en god sparringspartner og har lysten til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor vi hjælper hinanden– både i centeret og på tværs af organisationen. En åben, ærlig og ordentlig kommunikation er således afgørende for, at både du og vi lykkes og trives i dagligdagen.




Center for Data, Analyse og Modeller – din nye arbejdsplads

Centeret består af ca. 35 medarbejdere og to kontorchefer i henholdsvis Middelfart og Frederiksberg, der leverer data til bl.a. drift, direktion, presse, departement og minister. Vi arbejder til tider med korte deadlines, hvor det er nødvendigt at yde en ekstra indsats for at komme i mål med opgaver. Til gengæld har vi en stor fleksibilitet og et godt sammenhold samt høj trivsel.




Din kommende kollega, Marianne, anbefaler jobbet på baggrund af følgende: Hvis du som person trives med at have indflydelse på dit arbejde, dykke ned i store datamængder og gøre dem brugbare for interne såvel som eksterne interessenter og derved være med til at bidrage til en væsentlig samfundsopgave, så send en ansøgning. Vi har i centeret et stærkt sammenhold, hvor vi lægger stor vægt på vidensdeling og fællesskab.




Som nyansat vil du indgå i et grundigt introduktions- og oplæringsforløb, der sikrer udviklingen af dine kompetencer i forhold til arbejdsopgaverne. Du vil få en kontaktperson i kontoret, der vil kunne hjælpe dig og besvare spørgsmål i opstartsfasen. Og så kommer du på hold med en masse dygtige kollegaer, som altid står klar til at hjælpe dig. Skatte- og Vækstministeriet lægger vægt på at understøtte fleksible arbejdsvilkår, og rammerne for arbejdstilrettelæggelsen drøftes mellem leder og medarbejder med udgangspunkt i den samlede opgaveløsning.




Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansøgning med CV og eksamensbevis bedes sendt via linket ”Søg Stillingen” senest onsdag den 9. september 2026. Spørgsmål besvares gerne af kontorchef Henrik Løgstrup på telefon 72 37 64 26 eller chefkonsulent Marianne Lyda Frederiksen på telefon 72 37 69 62.




Vi forventer at afholde 1. samtaler mandag den 14. og tirsdag den 15. september 2026. Går man videre til 2. samtale, afholdes de mandag d. 21. september 2026.




Der kan indgå en logisk test og en personanalyse i ansættelsesforløbet. Der vil forud for ansættelsen blive indhentet straffeattest og referencer samt foretaget et restancetjek for så vidt angår restancer til det offentlige.




Forventet tiltrædelsesdato er den 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale.




Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og It-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet.




Du bliver ansat i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner. Arbejdsstedet er Teglgårdsparken 103, 5500 Middelfart.




Om Gældsstyrelsen

’Vi hjælper Danmark ud af gæld - vi er statens inkasso.’




Gældsstyrelsens opgave er at sikre, at så mange som muligt betaler deres gæld til det offentlige, og at ny gæld forebygges. Men det handler ikke kun om kroner og øre. Når vi inddriver gæld, gør det en forskel for vores fælles retsfølelse og sammenhængskraft.




Borgere og virksomheder skal møde en åben og kommunikerende styrelse, som tager dialogen i øjenhøjde og evner at gøre det komplekse forståeligt. Derfor lægger vi vægt på at have dygtige og motiverede medarbejdere, som med høj faglighed forstår at balancere samarbejde og service med myndighedsrollen. Vi søger løbende nye kolleger, som deler vores ambition om at hjælpe Danmark ud af gæld.




Læs mere om os på gaeldst.dk.




Gældsstyrelsen opfordrer alle kvalificerede uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Til gengæld har vi en stor fleksibilitet og et godt sammenhold samt høj trivsel.


Din kommende kollega, Marianne, anbefaler jobbet på baggrund af følgende: Hvis du som person trives med at have indflydelse på dit arbejde, dykke ned i store datamængder og gøre dem brugbare for interne såvel som eksterne interessenter og derved være med til at bidrage til en væsentlig samfundsopgave, så send en ansøgning. Vi har i centeret et stærkt sammenhold, hvor vi lægger stor vægt på vidensdeling og fællesskab.


Som nyansat vil du indgå i et grundigt introduktions- og oplæringsforløb, der sikrer udviklingen af dine kompetencer i forhold til arbejdsopgaverne. Du vil få en kontaktperson i kontoret, der vil kunne hjælpe dig og besvare spørgsmål i opstartsfasen. Og så kommer du på hold med en masse dygtige kollegaer, som altid står klar til at hjælpe dig. Skatte- og Vækstministeriet lægger vægt på at understøtte fleksible arbejdsvilkår, og rammerne for arbejdstilrettelæggelsen drøftes mellem leder og medarbejder med udgangspunkt i den samlede opgaveløsning.


Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansøgning med CV og eksamensbevis bedes sendt via linket ”Søg Stillingen” senest onsdag den 9. september 2026. Spørgsmål besvares gerne af kontorchef Henrik Løgstrup på telefon 72 37 64 26 eller chefkonsulent Marianne Lyda Frederiksen på telefon 72 37 69 62.


Vi forventer at afholde 1. samtaler mandag den 14. og tirsdag den 15. september 2026. Går man videre til 2. samtale, afholdes de mandag d. 21. september 2026.


Der kan indgå en logisk test og en personanalyse i ansættelsesforløbet. Der vil forud for ansættelsen blive indhentet straffeattest og referencer samt foretaget et restancetjek for så vidt angår restancer til det offentlige.


Forventet tiltrædelsesdato er den 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale.


Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og It-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet.


Du bliver ansat i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner. Arbejdsstedet er Teglgårdsparken 103, 5500 Middelfart.


Om Gældsstyrelsen

’Vi hjælper Danmark ud af gæld - vi er statens inkasso.’


Gældsstyrelsens opgave er at sikre, at så mange som muligt betaler deres gæld til det offentlige, og at ny gæld forebygges. Men det handler ikke kun om kroner og øre. Når vi inddriver gæld, gør det en forskel for vores fælles retsfølelse og sammenhængskraft.


Borgere og virksomheder skal møde en åben og kommunikerende styrelse, som tager dialogen i øjenhøjde og evner at gøre det komplekse forståeligt. Derfor lægger vi vægt på at have dygtige og motiverede medarbejdere, som med høj faglighed forstår at balancere samarbejde og service med myndighedsrollen. Vi søger løbende nye kolleger, som deler vores ambition om at hjælpe Danmark ud af gæld.


Læs mere om os på gaeldst.dk.

Title: Data Engineer – Cost Index Optimization
Place: Odense, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Engineering | Odense, Denmark | Full-Time

Jeppesen ForeFlight builds software that airlines and pilots around the world rely on every day. From our Odense office, you'll join an international engineering organization where your work has a direct, measurable impact on airline fuel efficiency and emissions.

Own the data platform behind a new flight optimization engine

We're hiring a Data Engineer for a new team building our next-generation Cost Index Optimization (CIO) product. Decoded flight recorder (QAR) data arrives from upstream providers — everything after that is yours: the lakehouse, data quality, per-tail training datasets, and the savings reporting our airline customers see.

What You'll Do


Build the data lakehouse (Iceberg/S3, Bronze/Silver/Gold layers) for flight data at fleet scale
Own data quality at the ingestion boundary — automated validation of inbound QAR data, including duplicate detection, date/route checks, and cross-checks against independent sources like ADS-B
Build per-tail training and validation datasets and the feature engineering layer for the modeling team
Build the savings reporting framework that quantifies fuel and cost savings per customer fleet
Support large-scale reprocessing as models, parsers, and quality rules evolve



What We're Looking For


Strong data engineering experience with Python, SQL, and a modern lakehouse or warehouse stack (Iceberg, Delta, or similar) in production
Experience running pipelines on AWS (S3, batch processing/orchestration, infrastructure as code)
A data-quality mindset — you treat validation as a product feature, not an afterthought
Comfort working with large volumes of noisy sensor or time-series data
Interest in aviation is a plus; domain expertise is not required



Why Join Jeppesen ForeFlight?

We believe a rewarding career is built on meaningful challenges, a supportive environment, and great colleagues. At Jeppesen ForeFlight, we empower our employees to make a direct impact on our products and services while supporting their overall wellbeing.

Our benefits package includes comprehensive health insurance, a pension plan, generous paid vacation plus additional time off during Christmas, a health and wellness allowance, an employee assistance program, two paid volunteer days annually, an employee referral program, and flight rewards and a flight stipend.
