Title: Data Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About Flatpay

Flatpay is not just another payment solution; we're dedicated to innovating the market for payment solutions and financial services in the SME segment with our customer-centric and transparent services.

We've grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies out of the Nordics and Denmark's fastest unicorn company. Today, we're more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe, building products that make a real difference for our customers.

We're ambitious, move fast, and like to challenge the status quo - but we also believe work should be fun. We celebrate wins, help each other out, and create an environment where people can do great work while genuinely enjoying the journey.

About The Job

As a Data Engineer at Flatpay, you’ll play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining the data platform that powers our insights and daily operations. You’ll work across systems, pipelines, and departments to ensure data is reliable, performant, and available where it matters most.

Your focus will be on developing and maintaining scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, managing data models, and improving our infrastructure. All to enable smooth data-driven decision-making across the business.

You’ll collaborate closely with analysts and fellow engineers to turn business requirements into robust technical solutions that help Flatpay move faster and smarter.

What You'll Do


Design and write maintainable, scalable, and testable data solutions
Develop and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines for data ingestion, transformation, and delivery
Collaborate with the team to develop, test, and deploy new functionality and improvements
Continuously enhance our CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and alerting infrastructure
Lead and take ownership of your own projects within the team
Contribute to building and maintaining internal libraries and shared platform components
Actively participate in improving systems from an architectural and performance standpoint


Who You Are

You are a pragmatic, flexible, and detail-oriented problem solver who enjoys building clean, efficient, and scalable data systems. You understand when to apply best practices and when to adapt them for real-world constraints.

You’re passionate about designing reliable data infrastructure, automating workflows, and collaborating with others to build data platforms that scale. You communicate clearly and confidently in English, our primary business language, and you’re comfortable working cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Must-haves


1–3 years of experience as a Data Engineer or similar role
Strong Python and SQL skills in production environments
Solid understanding of ETL/ELT design and data modeling principles
Experience with CI/CD workflows, version control (e.g., Git), and testing best practices
Ability to think logically and systematically when building and scaling data pipelines
Proactive and collaborative mindset with strong communication skills
Business-level proficiency in English


Nice-to-haves


Experience with Databricks or similar modern data platforms
Familiarity with data orchestration and modeling tools (e.g., dbt, Airflow, Prefect, or Azure Data Factory)
Exposure to cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Experience with monitoring, alerting, and observability systems


We’d still love to hear from you if…

You don’t check every box but you’re a Python- and SQL-savvy problem solver who loves to learn, adapt, and improve data systems.

If you’re curious, collaborative, and excited about shaping Flatpay’s data platform — we encourage you to apply!

Why Flatpay

Joining Flatpay means stepping into a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and teamwork is celebrated. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, contributing to our mission of empowering merchants to succeed.

With us, you’ll experience an ambitious drive to constantly push boundaries and redefine what's possible. While we don’t take ourselves too seriously, we take our responsibility towards our people very seriously. We welcome driven, low-ego individuals who live our values and want to grow with us.

Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

Title: Lead Product Data Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Tech-first. Ego-free. User-obsessed. Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insights they need to make better financial decisions — all directly connected to the Danish tax authority. We're an independent company of around 50 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.







The role




We need someone who owns product analytics — not just executes it. You'll set the direction for how Skatteguiden uses data to understand its users and make product decisions, and you'll be the person who raises the bar for what good analytics looks like here.




You'll work closely with product managers across our product teams and have real influence on what gets built and why. This isn't a support function. It's a lead role with ownership.







What you'll be working on




Own the product analytics function — define the strategy, set the standards, and drive adoption across product teams
Define and maintain core product metrics and KPIs across the organisation
Design and run experiments — from hypothesis to conclusion
Analyse user behaviour and funnels to identify growth opportunities and friction points
Build scalable dashboards and reporting in close collaboration with the data team
Translate findings into concrete recommendations for product leadership and senior stakeholders







What you bring




Strong SQL skills and experience with complex data modelling
Experience with Snowflake, dbt, Lightdash, Evidence or comparable tooling.
Solid product analytics experience — you've worked closely with product teams and understand what drives a digital product
Strong experimentation design and statistical analysis skills
A track record of owning a product analytics function, not just contributing to one
Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Self-directed and structured — you can take an ambiguous question and turn it into a sharp analysis







Nice to have




Experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud data warehouse
Experience with Lightdash, Tableau, or comparable BI tools
Python for data processing and analysis







What we offer







Ownership of the product analytics function at one of Denmark's fastest-growing fintech companies
Direct influence on product direction and a seat at the table where decisions are made
A strong data team with high professional standards and a modern tech stack
The opportunity to build something — not inherit a finished function
Office first in Copenhagen — five minutes from Rådhuspladsen, lunch at Claus Meyer, dinner covered if the day runs long







Practical




Start: As soon as possible

Reports to: Head of Data & Operations Planning

Salary: Competitive and based on experience







Our Lean Recruitment Process




Screening call with Christian Payne, 30 min (online)
45-minute onsite meeting with hiring manager and product manager
1-hour onsite case session with hiring manager and team member, followed by a short conversation with Nikolai (CEO), 30 min

This is a unique opportunity to shape Spirii's data infrastructure from an early stage — establishing standards for ingestion, orchestration, and data reliability as we scale.

Pipeline & Ingestion


Design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines that bring data from product backends, third-party services, and operational systems into Amazon Redshift.
Own ingestion reliability: monitoring, alerting, and incident response for pipeline failures.
Evaluate and improve orchestration tooling and scheduling.


Data Platform & Infrastructure


Evolve Spirii's data platform architecture: storage, compute, access control, and cost optimisation in Redshift.
Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code practices for data workflows (Terraform/CDK or similar).
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure and transformations.


Data Quality & Governance


Implement data quality checks, freshness monitoring, and anomaly detection across ingestion and transformation layers.
Work with Analytics Engineers and domain teams to define and enforce data contracts and schema standards.
Ensure GDPR-compliant data handling: PII identification, access control, and data retention policies.


Collaboration & Stakeholders


Partner with Engineering and Product teams to instrument events correctly at the source — schemas, identifiers, and change management.
Collaborate with Data team to ensure the analytics layer is built on reliable, well-modelled foundations.
Contribute to a strong data culture by creating and enhancing documentation, runbooks, data lineage, discoverability and incident response capabilities.


About The Team

You'll be joining Spirii's Data Enablement Team, a small, early-stage team formed in January 2026, so you'll have real influence over how things get built from here. The team consists of an Engineering Manager for Data (who you’ll report to), a Data Lead, a Product Manager for Data, and two Analytics Engineers who partner closely with our domain teams. We're in the middle of migrating from Redshift to Databricks and getting our first data products live in production on the new platform: you'll help shape ingestion, orchestration, and reliability standards as we scale.

About You


You care deeply about data reliability and building pipelines that teams can depend on.
You're hands-on: you build, test, and ship pipelines and infrastructure improvements yourself.
You think of data pipelines as products — you care about uptime, observability, and the downstream consumers who depend on them.
You embrace using AI tools to improve data engineering workflows, whether that's using LLMs to accelerate transformation authoring, anomaly detection, or documentation.
You're pragmatic: you know when to engineer robustly and when to keep things lean.
You collaborate well across teams and communicate clearly about trade-offs and status.


Qualifications


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related role with a strong data focus.
Strong SQL skills and solid experience building production data pipelines.
Hands-on experience with a modern data warehouse (Redshift preferred; BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks also relevant).
Experience with orchestration tools (Apache Airflow or similar).
Proficiency in Python for data work (pipeline scripts, transformations, tooling).
Solid understanding of ELT/ETL concepts, including incremental loading, CDC, and idempotency.
Familiar with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or similar).
Familiar with data governance concepts: access control, PII handling, GDPR-minded practices.


Nice to Have


Experience with data observability tooling.
Experience with event/data contract patterns in product analytics (schemas, versioning, instrumentation).
Experience with finance data and/or subscription/transaction domains.
Experience with dbt (understanding of transformation layer and how it interfaces with pipelines).
Experience using AI/LLM tools in a data engineering context
Machine learning infrastructure experience is a plus, but not required for this role.


Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work-life balance.


Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.
Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.
Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days (5 weeks + 5 extra) and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.
Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.
Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.
Stay Active: Use our Spirii gym and shared company car to keep moving.
Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.
Two innovation days per month for YOU to choose what you work on.


The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but fluent English language skills are required.

Spirii is a full-service e-Mobility provider, which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Title: Dataanalytiker med interesse for metode og dataanalyse
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du være en del af et område med en høj politisk bevågenhed? Vil du være med til at udvikle analytiske modeller og andre dataunderstøttede løsninger, der skal bidrage til en mere effektiv inddrivelse af offentlig gæld? Har du stærke metodiske og dataanalytiske evner, og har du lyst til at afprøve dem på store datamængder? Så er du måske vores nye dataanalytiker i Center for Data, Analyse og Modeller.

I centeret udvikler vi analytiske modeller og andre dataløsninger. Modellernes beregninger anvendes dels som input til at sætte den strategiske retning for inddrivelsesområdet og dels til at optimere driften via en datadreven optimering af inddrivelsesprocesserne.

Vi arbejder med dataanalyser og analysemodeller til inddrivelsesområdet

Du bliver en del af et kontor, der kombinerer høj faglighed med tæt samarbejde i mindre grupper. Vi har en uformel omgangstone med højt til loftet. Kontoret består af mange fagligheder, fra fysikere til sociologer, alle dog med den fællesnævner, at vi interesserer os for metode og dataanalyse samt formidling af resultater til et bredt publikum.

Med udgangspunkt i et datawarehouse, der samler store mængder register- og transaktionsdata fra forskellige systemer, udfører vi dataanalyser og udvikler analysemodeller. F.eks. udvikler vi modeller vedrørende skyldnersegmentering, fremskrivning, kursværdi, forældelse og produktionsstyring.

Dine Arbejdsopgaver Vil Være At


Håndtere og kombinere data og gennemføre dataanalyse på store datamængder
Udvikle eller videreudvikle vores statistiske/analytiske datamodeller
Belyse problemstillinger på inddrivelsesområdet og præge faglige drøftelser om opstilling af analysedesigns, metodevalg m.m.
Formidle forretningsviden og analyseresultater i eksempelvis notater eller præsentationer
Koordinere og styre processer ift. leverancer til vores interessenter


Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du ved ansættelsestidspunktet har afsluttet en akademisk uddannelse på kandidatniveau inden for et samfundsfagligt eller naturvidenskabeligt område. Du kunne fx være økonom, politolog, sociolog, matematiker eller fysiker.

Det Er Vigtigt, At Du


Via dit studie eller tidligere arbejde har praktisk erfaring med at håndtere og analysere data ved brug af kvantitative analysemetoder, fx via SQL, SAS, SPSS, Matlab, R, Python eller lignende værktøjer
Interesserer dig for dataanalyse og analytiske metoder, og at du er hurtig til at sætte dig ind i nye programmeringssprog
Er grundig, fagligt ansvarsfuld og kan arbejde selvstændigt på projekter med en lang tidshorisont


Det er en fordel, hvis du har en stærk analytisk sans og en politisk forståelse, så du kan se konteksten, hvori dit arbejde indgår.

Grundig introduktion og oplæring

Som nyansat vil du indgå i et grundigt introduktions- og oplæringsforløb. Udover introduktionsforløbet vil du blive tildelt en fast kollega fra teamet, som kan hjælpe dig i opstartsfasen.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC) eller anden relevant overenskomst i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet. Forventet tiltrædelse er den 1. november 2026 eller efter nærmere aftale. Arbejdsstedet er Osvald Helmuths Vej 4, 2000 Frederiksberg.

Title: Analytiker til Business Intelligence
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Har du interesse for data og analyse, som understøtter tusindvis af kunders behov og vigtige beslutninger i Jyske Bank-koncernen? Og motiveres du af at arbejde tæt på både forretningen og de tekniske løsninger? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Jobbet – gør data til værdi

I Business Intelligence arbejder vi hver dag på at omsætte data til indsigt, handling og forretningsmæssig værdi. Vi udvikler dashboards, analyser og intelligente dataløsninger, som bruges bredt i koncernen – fra bank og realkredit til stabsfunktioner og kundevendte områder i såvel Privat som Erhverv.

Som analytiker får du mulighed for at præge hele processen. Du er med fra de første idéer og dialoger med forretningen til udvikling, implementering og forankring af løsninger, der skaber konkrete resultater. Du kommer tæt på beslutningstagerne og får mulighed for at se dine analyser blive omsat til handling.

Bliv en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab

Hos Jyske Bank får du mulighed for at arbejde med nogle af Danmarks mest spændende data- og analyseopgaver i en organisation, hvor data spiller en central rolle i den strategiske udvikling.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt miljø, hvor der er en åben og uformel tone, gode udviklingsmuligheder og stor frihed til at påvirke både løsninger og egen faglige udvikling. Hos os får du kolleger, der elsker at nørde med data, kode og avanceret modellering – og som samtidig værdsætter humor, sammenhold samt en uformel omgangstone.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team bestående af 9 specialister og 2 studentermedhjælpere, som deler en passion for data, problemløsning og høj faglighed.

Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes i fællesskab. Derfor prioriterer vi samarbejde, videndeling og sparring højt. Samtidig giver vi plads til fordybelse, nysgerrighed og eksperimenter med nye teknologier og metoder.

Dine primære opgaver



Udvikle og formidle dashboards og datadrevne løsninger, der understøtter forretningens beslutninger
Sparre med interessenter om mulighederne i data og analyser
Omsætte komplekse forretningsbehov til brugbare og værdiskabende løsninger
Bidrage til indberetninger til offentlige myndigheder blandt andet Nationalbanken og Finanstilsynet
Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og interessenter på tværs af hele koncernen



Din profil

Du motiveres af at skabe værdi gennem data og får energi af at løse komplekse problemstillinger. Du er analytisk dygtig, nysgerrig og trives med at dykke ned i data for at finde svar og nye muligheder.

Det kan være en fordel hvis du har erfaring fra en lignende rolle og motiveres af at omsætte data til indsigt, der skaber værdi. Du arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt, men ved også, at de bedste resultater ofte skabes gennem samarbejde.

Derudover forestiller vi os, at:



Du har gode kompetencer inden for dataanalyse, datamodellering og programmering
Du har solid erfaring med SAS eller lignende værktøjer
Du har erfaring med at bruge AI-værktøjer som fx Copilot eller lignende.
Du er tryg ved at bruge AI til at løse opgaver, f.eks. til at strukturere, skrive eller analysere og kan forholde dig kritisk til outputtet.
Du har evnen til at formidle komplekse analyser på en enkel og forståelig måde
Du har en relevant kandidatuddannelse, eksempelvis cand.polit., cand.scient.oecon., cand.merc.IT, cand.scient. i matematik eller tilsvarende



Ansøgning

Ansøgningsfristen er 31. august 2026, men vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vi oplever mangfoldighed som en fordel i vores opgaveløsning og i vores fællesskab. Derfor opfordrer vi alle til at søge.

HR Rekrutteringspartner Amalie Stensgaard vil håndtere din ansøgning.

Title: Quantitative Developer - Python

Qube Research & Technologies (QRT) is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager, operating in all liquid asset classes across the world. Combining data, research, technology, and trading expertise has shaped our collaborative mindset, which enables us to solve the most complex challenges. Design, develop, deploy and maintain cloud native Python applications supporting research and trading workflows, including market data dashboards, risk analytics, profit and loss reporting, weather analytics and performance analysis

Build and maintain scalable data pipelines that support model development and production workflows

Description:
A Day In The Role

Reporting directly to the Head of Data, you will act as a strategic business partner, playing a pivotal role in accelerating L’Oréal's ongoing business transformation across the Nordics Hub (Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Finland). You won't just build technical solutions; you will translate complex data into compelling business narratives, guiding commercial decisions and shape our strategy.

Strategic Insight & Value Creation: Translate ambiguous business challenges into high-impact data solutions and front-end dashboards (PowerBI) that directly drive commercial growth and operational efficiency.

Business Transformation & Technical Execution: Leverage SQL and Python to build robust pipelines and automations, bridging the gap between technical back-end capabilities and commercial business needs.

Stakeholder Influence & Change Management: Partner closely with cross-functional leaders (Marketing, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Finance) to manage data initiatives, champion data-driven decision-making, and drive change across the organization.

We Are Looking For


An educational background in a technical or analytical field such as Mathematics, Economics, or Engineering.
Fluency in English.

A place for you to leave your comfort zone and grow beyond your potential (here, you’ll be encouraged to try new things and take risks!)
Real responsibility from day 1, there’s no sitting on the sidelines at L’Oréal

Title: Data Engineer
Place: København SV, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you passionate about turning data, AI, and software into practical business solutions? Would you like to work in a global engineering company where digital solutions support the decarbonization of world trade and help colleagues make better decisions every day? Then this could be your next opportunity.

We are looking for a Data / AI Solution Developer to join our Data Management team in PrimeServ Denmark. In this role, you will help design, build, and improve intelligent solutions that combine data, analytics, machine learning, LLMs, and software development to solve real business challenges.

This is not a role focused only on models or only on data pipelines. We are looking for someone who enjoys working across the full lifecycle of solution development - from understanding business needs and shaping concepts, to building data-driven and AI-enabled solutions that are robust, usable, and valuable in practice.

You will play an important role in:


Designing and developing data-driven and AI-enabled solutions that support business processes and decision-making.
Translating business challenges into technical solution concepts in collaboration with stakeholders and domain experts.
Exploring, preparing, and analyzing data from multiple sources to identify patterns, opportunities, and solution directions.
Developing machine learning, predictive, or AI-based components that can be embedded into business applications or workflows.
Contributing to the full solution lifecycle, including prototyping, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Collaborating with data engineers, developers, subject matter experts, analysts, and business stakeholders to create solutions that are technically sound and operationally relevant.
Supporting the documentation, communication, and adoption of solutions across the organization.
Staying up to date with relevant developments within AI, machine learning, cloud services, and applied analytics.


We imagine that you:


Hold a degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
Have experience working with data science, analytics, machine learning, or AI development in a professional setting for at least 2 years.
Have solid programming skills, preferably in Python, and are comfortable working with structured data and databases.
Understand that successful AI and data solutions require more than a model, they also require integration, usability, maintainability, and business relevance.
Are comfortable moving between analysis, prototyping, implementation, and collaboration with stakeholders.
Have experience translating business needs into technical designs or analytical approaches.
Are curious, solution-oriented, and motivated by solving practical business problems.
Can work both independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
Are fluent in English.


It will be an advantage if you have experience with


Machine learning frameworks and applied AI development.
Cloud platforms such as Azure.
SQL and relational databases.
APIs, integrations, or software components that operationalize analytical solutions.
Business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI.
MLOps, deployment, or monitoring of analytical models.
Software engineering practices such as GIT version control, DevOps, testing, and maintainable code design.
Working in environments where domain expertise and technical development need to come together to create business value.


What does success look like in this role?

Success in this position is not only about developing strong models or performing advanced analysis. It is about helping the business turn data and AI into solutions that are actually used.

That means understanding the context of the problem, engaging the right people, shaping the solution with the users in mind, and helping ensure that the final result works as part of a broader business process. In many cases, this requires collaboration across several roles, for example with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, developers, analysts, and data engineers.

We are therefore looking for someone who thrives in the space between technology and business, and who enjoys building solutions that make a measurable difference.

Welcome to Data Management | PrimeServ Denmark

You will become part of Data Management in PrimeServ Denmark, where we work with data, software, and digital development to support the business across functions and locations. Our team combines different technical and analytical competences, and we work closely with colleagues in Denmark and internationally.

We are a supportive and collaborative team with an informal working culture, where knowledge sharing, curiosity, and continuous improvement are highly valued. We believe the best solutions are created when people with different perspectives work together, and we place strong emphasis on both professional development and team well-being.

You will have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects with real-world impact, while being part of an organization that plays an important role in creating more sustainable solutions for the maritime industry.

Unleash your potential at Everllence

Join us on our journey toward a carbon‑neutral future. At Everllence, you will help shape innovative energy solutions while growing your skills and advancing your career.

We prioritize work-life balance, flexible working hours and remote work options.

We value creativity, diversity, well‑being, and have a wide range of social clubs -from yoga and fishing to creative activities.

In 2027, we will unite our Copenhagen and Holeby locations at a new and modern site in Trekroner, Roskilde.

Build your future with us

Please apply before Tuesday 1st of september, 2026. Interviews will be held during the application period.

Questions? You are welcome to contact Manager Ingi Ulfar Helgason (Ulli) by phone at +45 23701492.

Relocating to Denmark? We support you with a mobility package, including help with CPR registration, tax, and work permits.

We aim for a fair and inclusive recruitment process. Regardless of gender, age, religion, disability, or ethnic background, we encourage you to apply. We embrace a global mindset and intercultural environment to ensure a collaborative and inclusive workplace. If you need support, such as assistive tools for dyslexia, we can assist you.

Title: Analytikere til bekæmpelse af hvidvask og skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet
Description:
Kan du spotte usynlige mønstre i komplekse datasæt og omsætte brudstykker af informationer til skarpe analyseprodukter? Brænder du for datadrevet problemknusning, og vil du være med til at sætte retningen for vores tværgående kontrolindsatser? Så er du måske en af de analytikere, vi søger til Tværgående Analyse og Kontrol.




Vær med til at understøtte bekæmpelse af skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet

Fagområdet Særlig Kontrol i Skattestyrelsen bekæmper organiseret, systematisk og kompleks skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet, og i Tværgående Analyse og Kontrol har vi til opgave at understøtte fagområdets kernedrift og vores strategisk prioriterede områder med operationelle og taktiske analyser og kontroloplæg.




Derudover har vi ansvaret for at omsætte finansielle efterretninger fra Hvidvasksekretariatet (NSK) til konkrete og målbare kontrolindsatser samt indsamle, validere og visualisere data for at understøtte en data- og analysedrevet opgaveløsning.




Som analytiker i Eenheden får du en aarierede portefølje af analyse- og efterretningsopgaver, der

favner bredt og kan byde på alt fra

Taktisk analyse: Udpegning af kontrolegnede entiteter eller udarbejdelse af efterretnings- og sagsoverblik, der beskriver ”Hvem bør kontrolleres?”
Operationel analyse: Identificere og kortlægge tværgående overblik over netværk eller klynger i form af visualiseringer / netværksdiagrammer og netværksanalyser, der beskriver ”Hvad er omfanget, og hvad gør de involverede?”
Strategisk analyse (begrænset omfang): Udarbejde problem- eller kortlægningsanalyser som belyser ”Hvad udgør en risiko?”
Ad hoc-opgaver: Understøtte driften og enhedens øvrige opgaveportefølje.




Gennem opgaveløsningen kommer du til at få indflydelse på vores måde at arbejde mere databaseret med bekæmpelse af skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet og være med til at sætte retningen for vores tværgående kontrolindsatser. Du kommer til at samarbejde bredt både internt og eksternt, og du får mulighed for at deltage i både nationale og internationale myndighedsfællesfora.




Gode formidlingsevner, systemkendskab og erfaring med efterretningsanalyse

Med en bred portefølje af opgaver inden for analyse og efterretning søger vi analytikere, der i den grad kan omsætte brudstykker af information til skarpe analyseprodukter. Platforme som IBM i2 (Analyst Notebook), Palantir Gotham eller tilsvarende løsninger skal helst ikke være ukendt for dig. Har du erfaring med eller uddannelse i efterretningsanalyse er det et stort plus for os – det samme gælder teknisk kendskab til Python, R eller Excel VBA.




Derudover ser vi gerne, at du har en relevant uddannelse inden for analyse eller lignende. Har du arbejdet med analyse og efterretning i en anden offentlig myndighed eller indgået i samarbejder som ODIN, FOS, Al Capone eller NTE, er det en fordel og kompetencer med særlig relevans.




Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

er dygtig til formidling – både i forhold til at omsætte svært stof med målgruppen for øje, men også når analyser og data skal forklares
motiveres af et tæt samarbejde på tværs af forskellige faggrupper og ledelseslag
formår at omfavne ny teknologi: Du skal gerne synes, at det er sjovt at arbejde med nye metoder og måder at gå til opgaverne på
tager ansvar for helheden i enhedens ad hoc-opgaver, når det kræves – også når rutineopgaver i driften skal løses. Vi er sammen om opgaverne, og vi løfter i flok!




Tværgående Analyse og Kontrol – Særlig Kontrol – Din nye arbejdsplads

I vores enhed bliver du en del af et fagligt stærkt kontor med 20 kolleger, høj trivsel og et godt socialt sammenhold. Vi kan tilbyde et spændende job med stor samfundsmæssig betydning, hvor vi naturligvis sørger for et grundigt onboarding-forløb med intern undervisning, og du får mulighed for løbende at udvikle dig fagligt gennem mange forskellige opgaver.

Enheden er placeret i Hjørring, men der vil være mulighed for arbejdssted ved et af Særlig Kontrols øvrige kontorer i enten Aarhus eller Høje Taastrup. Da distanceledelse i forvejen er en integreret del af vores hverdag, skal du hvile i at samarbejde på tværs af geografisk afstand, ligesom der må forventes rejseaktivitet til fællesaktiviteter i Hjørring.




Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Send ansøgning med CV, uddannelsespapirer samt yderligere relevant materiale via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest mandag den 17. august 2026 kl. 12.




Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte funktionsleder Anders Melchiorsen på telefon 72 37 98 35 eller souschef Dorota Macdonald på telefon 72 37 01 56.

Vi forventer at holde første samtalerunde fredag den 21. august 2026 og anden samtalerunde fredag den 28. august 2026. Der vil som led i ansættelsessamtalerne indgå en analytisk case, der skal løses hjemmefra og derefter præsenteres til en samtale. Derudover forventer vi at gøre brug af en personanalyse i rekrutteringsforløbet.




Forud for ansættelsen indhenter vi referencer og straffeattest.




Hvis du går videre til ansættelse i rekrutteringsforløbet, skal du være opmærksom på, at vi foretager en undersøgelse af, om du har gæld, der er sendt til inddrivelse hos det offentlige. Vi undersøger ligeledes, om du har afgjorte kontrol- og/eller straffesager på skatte- og afgiftsområdet. Din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at vi ikke finder oplysninger om dig, der er uforenelige med en ansættelse i Skatte- og Vækstministeriets koncern.




Du skal være opmærksom på, at din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde denne sikkerhedsgodkendelse under din ansættelse i stillingen. Hvis du allerede er sikkerhedsgodkendt i en anden offentlig myndighed og bliver tilbudt stillingen, ønsker vi at overtage din sikkerhedsgodkendelse fra din nuværende arbejdsplads, hvis forudsætningerne for det er opfyldt.




Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet. Du bliver ansat i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner.

Arbejdsstedet kan være Parallelvej 11, 9800 Hjørring, Lyseng Allé 1, 8270 Højbjerg eller Engelholm Alle 1, 2630 Taastrup.




Skat er ikke enkelt. Derfor har vi brug for dig.

I Skattestyrelsen bliver du en del af et fagligt og mangfoldigt fællesskab, hvor du får ansvar, udvikler dig gennem komplekse opgaver og får tæt sparring med dygtige kolleger – alt sammen inden for fleksible rammer.

Skattestyrelsen lægger vægt på at understøtte fleksible arbejdsvilkår, og rammerne for arbejdstilrettelæggelsen drøftes mellem leder og medarbejder med udgangspunkt i den samlede opgaveløsning.

Din udvikling betyder meget for os, og hos os får du gode muligheder for læring og en karrierevej, der er fleksibel og tilpasset dig, uanset hvor i livet du befinder dig.

Vi samarbejder på tværs af generationer, uddannelser, baggrunde og landsdele om at løse vores kerneopgave. Vores opgaver kræver viden, ekspertise og fordybelse. Din læringskurve vil derfor være stejl, og du styrker din faglighed og opbygger kompetencer, der følger dig videre i dit arbejdsliv.

Skattestyrelsen spiller en vigtig rolle i samfundet ved at sørge for, at ingen betaler hverken for meget eller for lidt i skat. Vær med til at understøtte bekæmpelse af skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet

Derudover har vi ansvaret for at omsætte finansielle efterretninger fra Hvidvasksekretariatet (NSK) til konkrete og målbare kontrolindsatser samt indsamle, validere og visualisere data for at understøtte en data- og analysedrevet opgaveløsning.


Som analytiker i Eenheden får du en aarierede portefølje af analyse- og efterretningsopgaver, der

favner bredt og kan byde på alt fra

  • Taktisk analyse: Udpegning af kontrolegnede entiteter eller udarbejdelse af efterretnings- og sagsoverblik, der beskriver ”Hvem bør kontrolleres?”
  • Operationel analyse: Identificere og kortlægge tværgående overblik over netværk eller klynger i form af visualiseringer / netværksdiagrammer og netværksanalyser, der beskriver ”Hvad er omfanget, og hvad gør de involverede?”
  • Strategisk analyse (begrænset omfang): Udarbejde problem- eller kortlægningsanalyser som belyser ”Hvad udgør en risiko?”
  • Ad hoc-opgaver: Understøtte driften og enhedens øvrige opgaveportefølje.


Gennem opgaveløsningen kommer du til at få indflydelse på vores måde at arbejde mere databaseret med bekæmpelse af skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet og være med til at sætte retningen for vores tværgående kontrolindsatser. Du kommer til at samarbejde bredt både internt og eksternt, og du får mulighed for at deltage i både nationale og internationale myndighedsfællesfora.


Gode formidlingsevner, systemkendskab og erfaring med efterretningsanalyse

Med en bred portefølje af opgaver inden for analyse og efterretning søger vi analytikere, der i den grad kan omsætte brudstykker af information til skarpe analyseprodukter. Platforme som IBM i2 (Analyst Notebook), Palantir Gotham eller tilsvarende løsninger skal helst ikke være ukendt for dig. Har du erfaring med eller uddannelse i efterretningsanalyse er det et stort plus for os – det samme gælder teknisk kendskab til Python, R eller Excel VBA.


Derudover ser vi gerne, at du har en relevant uddannelse inden for analyse eller lignende. Har du arbejdet med analyse og efterretning i en anden offentlig myndighed eller indgået i samarbejder som ODIN, FOS, Al Capone eller NTE, er det en fordel og kompetencer med særlig relevans.


Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • er dygtig til formidling – både i forhold til at omsætte svært stof med målgruppen for øje, men også når analyser og data skal forklares
  • motiveres af et tæt samarbejde på tværs af forskellige faggrupper og ledelseslag
  • formår at omfavne ny teknologi: Du skal gerne synes, at det er sjovt at arbejde med nye metoder og måder at gå til opgaverne på
  • tager ansvar for helheden i enhedens ad hoc-opgaver, når det kræves – også når rutineopgaver i driften skal løses. Vi er sammen om opgaverne, og vi løfter i flok!

I vores enhed bliver du en del af et fagligt stærkt kontor med 20 kolleger, høj trivsel og et godt socialt sammenhold. Enheden er placeret i Hjørring, men der vil være mulighed for arbejdssted ved et af Særlig Kontrols øvrige kontorer i enten Aarhus eller Høje Taastrup. Da distanceledelse i forvejen er en integreret del af vores hverdag, skal du hvile i at samarbejde på tværs af geografisk afstand, ligesom der må forventes rejseaktivitet til fællesaktiviteter i Hjørring.

Send ansøgning med CV, uddannelsespapirer samt yderligere relevant materiale via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest mandag den 17. august 2026 kl. 12.

Derudover forventer vi at gøre brug af en personanalyse i rekrutteringsforløbet.


Forud for ansættelsen indhenter vi referencer og straffeattest.

Din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at vi ikke finder oplysninger om dig, der er uforenelige med en ansættelse i Skatte- og Vækstministeriets koncern.


Du skal være opmærksom på, at din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde denne sikkerhedsgodkendelse under din ansættelse i stillingen. Title: Logistics & Data Coordinator - Waste Management
Place: Gladsaxe, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Corporate Facilities (CFa)

Bagsværd, Denmark

Are you passionate about using data to understand and improve daily operations? Do you have a good understanding of logistics and enjoy working close to the operational reality behind the numbers?

We are looking for a Logistics & Data Coordinator to join our Waste Management team in Corporate Facilities at Novo Nordisk. In this role, you will combine data and logistics with active involvement in daily waste operations across Novo Nordisk sites in Denmark – turning data into practical improvements while helping the team keep operations running smoothly.

Your new role

This role offers a diverse mix of analytical, operational and collaborative tasks. As our Logistics & Data Coordinator, you will play a key role in ensuring a solid data foundation for our waste management activities. You will be responsible for the upload, consolidation and quality assurance of operational data in our Waste Management system, including maintaining accurate information on containers and related services. You will structure, validate and analyse data to identify trends and deviations that support our daily operations.

With your analytical mindset and understanding of logistics processes, you will monitor operational performance and identify opportunities to optimise collection frequencies, fill rates, transportation needs and container solutions.

The role goes beyond data and analysis. You will be an active part of our day-to-day operations, coordinating orders and operational requests, collaborating closely with colleagues, internal stakeholders and external suppliers, and acting as a key point of contact for resolving waste- and logistics-related issues.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


Ensure accurate data foundation for finance, invoicing, reporting, and internal controls ‌
Maintain and update operational and master data
Collect, validate, analyse, and present operational data and insights
Work with colleagues and suppliers to coordinate activities, solve issues, and improve operations
Help optimise collection schedules, transport needs, fill rates, and container solutions


Your Skills And Qualifications

We are looking for someone with strong numerical and analytical skills who is motivated by combining data with logistics and daily operations. You are an advanced Excel user, comfortable working with data and able to translate it into practical operational insights.

Ideally, You Bring


Experience with data processing and analysis in an operational or business context.
Experience with or a good understanding of logistics and operational processes.
A structured and analytical approach with the ability to identify patterns, deviations and improvement opportunities.
The ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and take ownership of your responsibilities.
Strong collaboration and communication skills and the ability to work effectively with colleagues, stakeholders and external suppliers.
Good written and verbal communication skills in Danish and English.
Experience with or knowledge of the waste area is an advantage, while analytical capabilities, logistics understanding and a willingness to learn are key to succeeding in the role.


You have good system understanding and are comfortable learning and working with digital tools. Knowledge of Power BI or similar tools is an advantage.

You are operationally minded and enjoy being close to the daily operations. You are curious about the connection between data and operations and able to turn insights into practical improvements.

Your new department

The Waste team, based in Bagsværd, is responsible for waste operations across Novo Nordisk sites in Denmark. We work to ensure stable and efficient waste management while contributing to Novo Nordisk's environmental and climate ambitions.

Our work combines daily operations, logistics, data and continuous improvement and requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders and external suppliers.

We value teamwork and shared responsibility. You will have your own areas of responsibility while being part of a team where we support each other in solving both day-to-day operational tasks and more complex challenges.

The Waste team is part of Corporate Facilities, which enables Novo Nordisk to focus on its core business by providing solutions and services related to physical infrastructure, workplaces and facility operations.

What We Offer

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Salary: Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 437,600.00 to 643,200.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Sr. Manager Charlotte Ahrens at cnxa@novonordisk.com.

Deadline


August 2026


Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Please note that you do not need to submit a cover letter. Instead, include a few sentences in your CV outlining your motivation for applying. To support a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly ask candidates not to include a photo in their CV.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

Skattestyrelsen lægger vægt på at understøtte fleksible arbejdsvilkår, og rammerne for arbejdstilrettelæggelsen drøftes mellem leder og medarbejder med udgangspunkt i den samlede opgaveløsning.

Din udvikling betyder meget for os, og hos os får du gode muligheder for læring og en karrierevej, der er fleksibel og tilpasset dig, uanset hvor i livet du befinder dig.

Vi samarbejder på tværs af generationer, uddannelser, baggrunde og landsdele om at løse vores kerneopgave. Vores opgaver kræver viden, ekspertise og fordybelse. Din læringskurve vil derfor være stejl, og du styrker din faglighed og opbygger kompetencer, der følger dig videre i dit arbejdsliv.

Skattestyrelsen spiller en vigtig rolle i samfundet ved at sørge for, at ingen betaler hverken for meget eller for lidt i skat. Det er ikke en enkel opgave, men den er vigtig, og vi er stolte af at sikre finansieringen af den offentlige sektor. Skat er alles ansvar – og så er det vores arbejde. Og det kan også blive dit.

Brænder du for datadrevet problemknusning, og vil du være med til at sætte retningen for vores tværgående kontrolindsatser? Så er du måske en af de analytikere, vi søger til Tværgående Analyse og Kontrol.


Vær med til at understøtte bekæmpelse af skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet

Fagområdet Særlig Kontrol i Skattestyrelsen bekæmper organiseret, systematisk og kompleks skatteøkonomisk kriminalitet, og i Tværgående Analyse og Kontrol har vi til opgave at understøtte fagområdets kernedrift og vores strategisk prioriterede områder med operationelle og taktiske analyser og kontroloplæg.


Derudover har vi ansvaret for at omsætte finansielle efterretninger fra Hvidvasksekretariatet (NSK) til konkrete og målbare kontrolindsatser samt indsamle, validere og visualisere data for at understøtte en data- og analysedrevet opgaveløsning.


Som analytiker i Eenheden får du en aarierede portefølje af analyse- og efterretningsopgaver, der

favner bredt og kan byde på alt fra

  • Taktisk analyse: Udpegning af kontrolegnede entiteter eller udarbejdelse af efterretnings- og sagsoverblik, der beskriver ”Hvem bør kontrolleres?”
  • Operationel analyse: Identificere og kortlægge tværgående overblik over netværk eller klynger i form af visualiseringer / netværksdiagrammer og netværksanalyser, der beskriver ”Hvad er omfanget, og hvad gør de involverede?”
  • Strategisk analyse (begrænset omfang): Udarbejde problem- eller kortlægningsanalyser som belyser ”Hvad udgør en risiko?”
  • Ad hoc-opgaver: Understøtte driften og enhedens øvrige opgaveportefølje.

Du kommer til at samarbejde bredt både internt og eksternt, og du får mulighed for at deltage i både nationale og internationale myndighedsfællesfora.


Gode formidlingsevner, systemkendskab og erfaring med efterretningsanalyse

Med en bred portefølje af opgaver inden for analyse og efterretning søger vi analytikere, der i den grad kan omsætte brudstykker af information til skarpe analyseprodukter. Platforme som IBM i2 (Analyst Notebook), Palantir Gotham eller tilsvarende løsninger skal helst ikke være ukendt for dig. Har du erfaring med eller uddannelse i efterretningsanalyse er det et stort plus for os – det samme gælder teknisk kendskab til Python, R eller Excel VBA.


Derudover ser vi gerne, at du har en relevant uddannelse inden for analyse eller lignende. Har du arbejdet med analyse og efterretning i en anden offentlig myndighed eller indgået i samarbejder som ODIN, FOS, Al Capone eller NTE, er det en fordel og kompetencer med særlig relevans.


Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • er dygtig til formidling – både i forhold til at omsætte svært stof med målgruppen for øje, men også når analyser og data skal forklares
  • motiveres af et tæt samarbejde på tværs af forskellige faggrupper og ledelseslag
  • formår at omfavne ny teknologi: Du skal gerne synes, at det er sjovt at arbejde med nye metoder og måder at gå til opgaverne på
  • tager ansvar for helheden i enhedens ad hoc-opgaver, når det kræves – også når rutineopgaver i driften skal løses. Vi er sammen om opgaverne, og vi løfter i flok!

I vores enhed bliver du en del af et fagligt stærkt kontor med 20 kolleger, høj trivsel og et godt socialt sammenhold. Title: Analytiker, Økonomi og Analyse, Sjællands Universitetshospital
Description:
Vi søger en analytiker, der kan skabe stærke samarbejdsrelationer med ledere, klinikere og andre faggrupper og omsætte og formidle komplekse data og analyser til forståelig og anvendelig viden.

Som analytiker i Økonomi og Analyse på Sjællands Universitetshospital bliver du en del af et analysemiljø, der understøtter hele organisationen med analyser, beslutningsgrundlag og sparring.

På Sjællands Universitetshospital genereres der hver dag store mængder data om blandt andet patientforløb, aktiviteter, ventetider, kapacitet, kvalitet, økonomi og personale. Data stammer fra mange forskellige systemer, registreres af mange faggrupper og anvendes til en lang række formål. Derfor handler arbejdet både om bearbejdning af data og om forståelsen af de processer, der skaber dem. Det stiller krav til både faglighed og forståelse for samspillet mellem systemer, registreringspraksis, arbejdsgange og den kliniske virkelighed.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor arbejdet med data er det centrale i dine opgaver, men hvor du samtidig samarbejder tæt med ledere, kliniske afdelinger og andre kolleger i Staben. De kommende år vil være præget af regionssammenlægning og implementering af sundhedsreformen, som vil skabe nye behov for analyser, beslutningsstøtte og tværgående samarbejde, og stillingen vil derfor løbende kunne omfatte nye opgaver og ansvarsområder.

Dine arbejdsopgaver omfatter blandt andet:

Udvikling af analyser, visualiseringer og beslutningsgrundlag med afsæt i data fra Data- og Analyseplatformen (DAP), som er en tværregional platform i de østlige regioner.
Arbejde med datakvalitet, datastrømme og registreringspraksis.
Identificere og fejlfinde årsager til afvigelser i data og datamodeller.
Samarbejde med klinikere, ledere og kolleger om at forstå, fortolke og anvende data i den rette kontekst.
Formidle analyser, resultater og datamæssige sammenhænge til forskellige målgrupper.
Understøtte brugen af data gennem dialog, rådgivning og kompetenceudvikling i organisationen.
Bidrage til udviklingen af andre faglige initiativer, der dataunderstøtter hospitalets ledelse og kliniske afdelinger.

Hvem er du?

Vi forventer du har en akademisk uddannelse og kan dokumentere stærke analytiske kompetencer og erfaring i at arbejde med komplekse data.

Derudover:

Arbejder du sikkert og selvstændigt med SQL og har gerne erfaring med Python eller R.
Har erfaring med at bygge rapporter i Power BI
Har erfaring med at analysere data på tværs af systemer og datakilder.
Har forståelse for relationelle databaser, datamodeller og komplekse datastrukturer.
Kan omsætte komplekse analyser og datamæssige problemstillinger til forståelig og anvendelig viden for ledere, klinikere og kolleger.
Har gode samarbejdsevner og trives med at skabe relationer på tværs af fagligheder og organisatoriske niveauer.
Du er teknisk dygtig, men bruger samtidig din faglighed til at stille de rigtige spørgsmål til data og din nysgerrighed til at finde svarene

Vi forventer, at du selvstændigt kan levere fagligt solide løsninger, som kan anvendes i praksis. Vi lægger desuden vægt på, at du forholder dig aktivt til data, bruger din faglighed til at stille de rigtige spørgsmål til data og din nysgerrighed til at finde svarene. Du dokumenterer dine metoder, kilder og konklusioner samt kan redegøre for dine antagelser.

Det får du hos os

Du bliver en del af et fagligt analysemiljø, hvor sparring, videndeling og samarbejde er en naturlig del af hverdagen, og hvor tonen er uformel.

Du får rig mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt, blandt andet via samarbejde med de mange forskellige fagligheder i Staben og på hospitalet. Derudover får du mulighed for at præge både analyser, metoder og nye faglige initiativer i en organisation, der er under forandring.

Fælles for dine opgaver er, at de bidrager til at gøre data anvendelige og understøtte beslutninger, der har betydning for den kliniske hverdag og patienterne.

Om ansættelsen

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst for akademikere ansat i regioner m.v., herunder mulighed for indplacering som specialkonsulent.

Der er mulighed for at have primært arbejdssted i Køge eller Nykøbing F, men du skal være indstillet på fremmøde på alle SUH’s matrikler efter behov. Vi har som udgangspunkt fysisk fremmøde, men er fleksibel omkring hjemmearbejde.

Forventet ansættelsesstart 1. november 2026. Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt.

Vi forventer at afholde 1. samtaler i uge 38 og 2. samtaler i uge 39. Der vil til 2. samtalen indgå en case.

Få mere at vide om stillingen ved at kontakte Chef for Økonomi og Analyse Charlotte Lynge (tlf. 21 77 43 42 eller pr. mail ckun@regionsjaelland.dk)

Description:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.

For more information, visit WPP.com.

About Data & Technology Solutions

WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is WPP’s unified global data products and technology team. We work with our agencies and clients to build data-driven solutions and technology products to power marketing transformation. At the heart of this is WPP Open - our AI platform for marketing that connects professionals, data, tools, and AI in a single place. It is the simplest, safest, and fastest way to realize the benefits of scaled AI, delivering better-informed creative ideas faster, at scale, and at lower cost.

We’re endlessly curious, and our team of thinkers, builders, creators, and problem solvers is over 2,000 strong across 20 markets around the world.

Why we're hiring:

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Open Intelligence initiative. In this hands-on technical role, you will build and maintain core data capabilities, pipelines, and innovative features that power our global media ecosystem.

You bring strong communication skills, an understanding of brand, adtech, and marketing data, and a commitment to engineering reliable, scalable pipelines. You’ll collaborate closely with teammates and product stakeholders to ensure our data infrastructure evolves with the business while actively leveraging modern development and testing technologies.

If you are ready to be at the forefront of the AdTech industry, shaping its future, and driving success for both our clients, we encourage you to apply and join our team.

What you'll be doing:


Discuss & propose technical solutions, develop & review code following best practices and patterns.
Collaborate with both our Product organization and analysts and data scientists in Open Intelligence to add new features or changes to existing ones and translate those requirements into reliable, production-level components.
Contribute to designing and building strong data governance and quality frameworks to ensure data production is accurate and work consistently throughout its lifetime.
Contribute to identifying and addressing technical debt and inefficiencies within our data platform.
Stay curious and proactive, explore new tools, techniques, and technologies that can help us move faster and smarter.
Be happy to share knowledge in dedicated sessions and stand-ups.


What you'll need:


Strong communication skills, you can effectively explain technical concepts to various audiences.
2+ years of experience in data engineering.
Solid experience with data wrangling in a language such as Python, Go, or Scala.
Proficiency in large scale processing engines and related ecosystems (Spark
Experience working with CI/CD, version control, and testing best practices.
Experience with cloud-based platforms like GCP, AWS, or Azure.
Experience working with infrastructure as code tools like Terraform.
Experience with containerization management tools like Kubernetes.
A passion for data, technology, and computer languages.
Interest in leveraging AI coding assistants and prompt engineering to enhance productivity.


Nice to have:


Familiarity with AdTech- and/or MarTech data and terminology.
Experience with monorepo codebase.
Experience with data privacy engineering technologies and best practices in handling sensitive data.


Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

  • Experience working with CI/CD, version control, and testing best practices.

Som Senior Commercial Analyst får du ansvar for at styrke det datadrevne grundlag for kommerciel styring, salgsprioritering og performanceopfølgning.

Understøtte Commercial Managers med analyser, salgsindsigt og datadrevet beslutningsgrundlag til prioritering af kommercielle aktiviteter.
Analysere og følge op på kommerciel performance med afsæt i strategiske KPI’er, OKR’er og underliggende drivere.

Bidrage til at udvikle afdelingens brug af AI og nye analyseværktøjer, hvor det kan effektivisere analysearbejde og styrke beslutningsgrundlaget.

Du er analytisk stærk, nysgerrig og kan både dykke ned i data og løfte blikket, så dine analyser bliver omsat til klare anbefalinger og kommercielle handlinger.

Du er struktureret, selvstændig og god til at udfordre eksisterende antagelser på en konstruktiv måde. Samtidig er du stærk til at formidle komplekse analyser enkelt og handlingsorienteret, så de kan bruges af både ledelse og kolleger i forretningen.

Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:


Har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for fx cand.merc., økonomi, business analytics, statistik, matematik, data science eller lignende — kombineret med stærk kommerciel forståelse.
Har solid erfaring med kommerciel analyse fra digital forretning.
Har erfaring med at arbejde med større datamængder og omsætte dem til konkrete kommercielle anbefalinger.
Har stærke kompetencer indenfor Excel, Power BI eller andre analytiske værktøjer til visuel fremstilling
Har erfaring med kommercielle analyser og modeller inden for fx LTV, churn, forecasting, kampagneeffekt og ROI
Er nysgerrig på AI og nye analyseværktøjer og har mod på at bruge dem aktivt til at styrke analyse, formidling og beslutningsstøtte.


Velkommen til Commercial Management

Du bliver en del af Commercial Management – et engageret team med ansvar for den kommercielle udvikling og daglige drift på tværs af Danske Spil Casino, Tivoli Casino, Poker og Bingo.

Vi driver den kommercielle udvikling af Danske Spil Casino, Tivoli Casino, Poker og Bingo og omsætter data og kundeindsigter til konkrete handlinger, der styrker salget, skaber bedre spiloplevelser og udvikler vores brands på det danske marked.

Som Senior Commercial Analyst bliver du en vigtig sparringspartner for både Commercial Managers, BI og ledelsen. Du får en rolle, hvor analyser ikke skal ende som rapporter i en skuffe, men omsættes til konkrete beslutninger, prioriteringer og handlinger.

Vil du være med til at underholde danskerne?

Hvis du vil være med til at styrke den kommercielle udvikling af nogle af Danmarks stærkeste spilbrands, så send din ansøgning og CV snarest muligt. Du kender sikkert vores navn og nogle af vores spil. Men ved du også, hvordan Danske Spil er til glæde og til gavn for hele Danmark?

Vi er markedsleder inden for lotteri, sportsspil og casino i Danmark – og det er staten og de store idrætsforeninger, DGI og DIF, der ejer Danske Spil. Med andre ord ejer vi alle sammen Danske Spil.

Og med det ejerskab følger et særligt ansvar. Et ansvar for at finansiere det idræts-, kultur- og foreningsliv, vi er rundet af. Og et ansvar for at modarbejde spilafhængighed og sørge for, at det hele går ordentligt til.

Vores historie begyndte i 1948, da 20.000 idrætsfolk demonstrerede på Rådhuspladsen for en ny lov, som gav sporten del i overskuddet fra væddemål. Året efter blev Danske Spil grundlagt – og siden har vi hvert år sendt hele vores overskud tilbage til fællesskabet. Du bliver en del af et engageret team bestående af 9 specialister og 2 studentermedhjælpere, som deler en passion for data, problemløsning og høj faglighed.

Dine primære opgaver


Udvikle og formidle dashboards og datadrevne løsninger, der understøtter forretningens beslutninger
Sparre med interessenter om mulighederne i data og analyser
Omsætte komplekse forretningsbehov til brugbare og værdiskabende løsninger
Bidrage til indberetninger til offentlige myndigheder, blandt andet Nationalbanken og Finanstilsynet
Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og interessenter på tværs af hele koncernen


Din profil

Du motiveres af at skabe værdi gennem data og får energi af at løse komplekse problemstillinger. Du er analytisk dygtig, nysgerrig og trives med at dykke ned i data for at finde svar og nye muligheder. Det kan være en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra en lignende rolle.

Du har solid erfaring med SAS eller lignende værktøjer
Du har erfaring med at bruge AI-værktøjer som fx Copilot eller lignende, og kan forholde dig kritisk til outputtet

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst
Description:
About Shine

Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal and Belgium.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

Data at Shine

Our Data team is organised into three complementary pillars: Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, and Product/Revenue Analytics. This structure ensures you spend less time fixing broken pipelines and more time uncovering high-value growth levers.

The Product Analytics team partners closely with Product to drive discovery, experimentation, and measurable impact. We are now looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to lead the strategy for our Banking domain—the technical and financial heart of Shine’s value proposition.

What's in it for you?


Strategic Discovery: You will lead "Phase 0" of the product lifecycle, sizing opportunities for new banking features and identifying friction points in the user journey before a single line of code is written.
End-to-End Experimentation: From power-calculating sample sizes to interpreting complex A/B test results, you own the validation of our product hypotheses.
High-Stakes Influence: You will translate “Data-speak” into “Business-speak,” presenting findings directly to Product Leads and the Head of Product Analytics to help the company pivot or persevere on key initiatives.
A Mature Stack: Work with a best-in-class modern data stack including Snowflake, dbt, Python, and Omni, supported by a dedicated Analytics Engineering team.
A hybrid work policy: Enjoy a balanced mix of remote work and office collaboration
Modern, centrally located offices: Work from modern office spaces in prime city locations
An international environment: Join a diverse team with colleagues from across the globe
Mobility across locations: Opportunity to work from our offices in Copenhagen, Paris, Amsterdam, or Berlin


Your Responsibilities


Strategic Partnership: Partner directly with Banking Product Managers to define North Star KPIs and influence the long-term roadmap.
Deep-Dive Analysis: Lead sophisticated analyses on user activation, transaction velocity, retention, and feature adoption within the banking ecosystem.
Data Governance: Own and continuously improve analytical datasets and core Banking KPIs, ensuring reliability, scalability, and clear documentation.
Enablement: Build actionable, self-service dashboards and mentor junior analysts to foster a high-performance data culture.
Best Practices: Contribute to evolving our internal analytics standards, from SQL styling to peer-review processes.


📍 Job located in Berlin, Madrid or Copenhagen with the possibility of two remote working days per week.

About You


Experience: 5+ years in Data Analytics, with a proven track record in a fast-paced, product-driven environment.
Technical Excellence: Expert-level SQL and solid experience with DBT (modeling, testing, and documentation).
Product Mindset: You think in terms of user value and business outcomes, not just "queries completed."
Domain Expertise: Prior experience in Banking, FinTech, or regulated environments is highly valued.
Communication: Ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Language: Fluent in English; excited to work in a diverse, international setting.


Our Recruitment Process

1️⃣ Screening Call: Initial screening call with a TA-partner

2️⃣ Technical Call (60’): Discussion with your potential lead, to dive deeper into your experience

3️⃣ Case Study Presentation (60’): Evaluation of your methodology, problem-structuring, and impact mindset.

4️⃣ Logical & Personality Assessment (30–45’): Followed by meeting a few team members + Discussion with the VP of Data & Analytics regarding collaboration and strategic vision.

  • Strategic Discovery: You will lead "Phase 0" of the product lifecycle, sizing opportunities for new banking features and identifying friction points in the user journey before a single line of code is written.
  • End-to-End Experimentation: From power-calculating sample sizes to interpreting complex A/B test results, you own the validation of our product hypotheses.
  • High-Stakes Influence: You will translate “Data-speak” into “Business-speak,” presenting findings directly to Product Leads and the Head of Product Analytics to help the company pivot or persevere on key initiatives.
  • A Mature Stack: Work with a best-in-class modern data stack including Snowflake, dbt, Python, and Omni, supported by a dedicated Analytics Engineering team.
  • A hybrid work policy: Enjoy a balanced mix of remote work and office collaboration
  • Modern, centrally located offices: Work from modern office spaces in prime city locations
  • An international environment: Join a diverse team with colleagues from across the globe
  • Mobility across locations: Opportunity to work from our offices in Copenhagen, Paris, Amsterdam, or Berlin

Your Responsibilities

  • Strategic Partnership: Partner directly with Banking Product Managers to define North Star KPIs and influence the long-term roadmap.
  • Deep-Dive Analysis: Lead sophisticated analyses on user activation, transaction velocity, retention, and feature adoption within the banking ecosystem.
  • Data Governance: Own and continuously improve analytical datasets and core Banking KPIs, ensuring reliability, scalability, and clear documentation.
  • Enablement: Build actionable, self-service dashboards and mentor junior analysts to foster a high-performance data culture.
  • Best Practices: Contribute to evolving our internal analytics standards, from SQL styling to peer-review processes.

📍 Job located in Berlin, Madrid or Copenhagen with the possibility of two remote working days per week.

About You

  • Experience: 5+ years in Data Analytics, with a proven track record in a fast-paced, product-driven environment.
  • Technical Excellence: Expert-level SQL and solid experience with DBT (modeling, testing, and documentation).
  • Product Mindset: You think in terms of user value and business outcomes, not just "queries completed."
  • Domain Expertise: Prior experience in Banking, FinTech, or regulated environments is highly valued.
  • Communication: Ability to turn complex, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Language: Fluent in English; excited to work in a diverse, international setting.

Our Recruitment Process

1️⃣ Screening Call: Initial screening call with a TA-partner

2️⃣ Technical Call (60’): Discussion with your potential lead, to dive deeper into your experience

3️⃣ Case Study Presentation (60’): Evaluation of your methodology, problem-structuring, and impact mindset.

4️⃣ Logical & Personality Assessment (30–45’): Followed by meeting a few team members + Discussion with the VP of Data & Analytics regarding collaboration and strategic vision.

Title: Data Management Consultant
Description:
Job Description

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Responsibilities & Technologies

In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including: Azure SQL Server, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, and others.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your Responsibilites Will Typically Include


Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.
Structuring and collection of data from various sources.
Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.
Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.
Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.


About You

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within data management. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. You thrive in a development-oriented environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:


ETL and Database technologies.
Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.
Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.
Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.


Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.
