Title: Data Analyst
Description:
VOY is a fast growing Healthtech scale-up, aiming to be the healthcare provider that millions of people trust as their partner to a long and healthy life. Our platform allows users to quickly and safely diagnose possible conditions, get treatment and support them afterwards to live a higher quality life. To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are


You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale


What you will do

Translate data into insight


Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation


Build and maintain dashboards & reports


Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users


Contribute to data quality & modelling


Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably
Collaborate with the Data Engineering team on data modelling, dbt transformations and data governance
Identify and escalate data quality issues and help ensure consistency across systems
Help define and track metrics that matter, ensuring every KPI is well understood and correctly calculated


Partner across teams


Work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, Finance and Programme Delivery to understand their data needs
Communicate complex data concepts in a way that's accessible to non-technical stakeholders
Help drive adoption of data-driven thinking and self-serve analytics across the organisation


What we need from you


2-4 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or similar analytics role
Proficiency in SQL - you can write queries to explore, filter, join and aggregate data reliably
Experience with at least one BI/visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Familiarity with modern data stacks and tools (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt are all helpful)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex findings clearly to diverse audiences
This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in the office


Experience you may have


A degree in a quantitative subject (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, etc.)
Experience in healthcare, public health or regulated industries
Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and statistical work
Experience working in fast-growing, high-impact environments
Familiarity with dbt or other data transformation frameworks


Please note that this is a hybrid role with a requirement of in office presence, 3 days per week

Healthcare is broken. We’re fixing it — and we need your help.

Back in 2019, we launched MANUAL to tackle men's health (starting with hair loss and sexual health). A few years later, we launched Voy with a focus on weight loss. But our ambition has always been bigger. Healthcare too often treats conditions in isolation, not people as a whole, and we're on a mission to prove there's a better way.

In 2025, we evolved from MANUAL into Voy, a brand built for the long game: supporting people through every stage of life, not just a single diagnosis. Today, we support over 1 million members across the UK, Germany and Brazil, delivering personalised care across weight loss, menopause, hair loss and TRT (with more categories on the way).

Ready to join us and change how healthcare feels for millions of people?

About Matalan

From humble beginnings to disruptive innovations in the retail industry, find out about how Matalan is ever-evolving here.

We know as a team, we are stronger together – we champion equality for all and make lasting connections that go beyond work. We thrive off our inclusive culture, encouraging our colleagues to bring their true selves to work and contributing to collective creativity, open-mindedness and growth.

We want give every candidate the opportunity to perform at their best throughout the application and interview process and then ultimately in their role. If you require any adjustments during our recruitment process, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

In the event that a high volume of suitable applications are received, the post may close prior to the specified closing date. Please apply as soon as possible if interested.

About The Role

As a Customer Data Analyst, you’ll turn data into meaningful insight that drives real business impact. Sitting at the heart of our Customer, Ecommerce and Marketing functions, you’ll use data to shape smarter decisions, stronger campaigns and better customer outcomes.

You’ll take ownership of projects end-to-end, working with semi-structured data to uncover trends, answer key business questions and influence strategy.

What You’ll Be Doing


Owning and delivering analysis that goes beyond reporting to provide clear, actionable “so what” insights
Writing efficient, scalable SQL to unlock value from complex datasets
Applying structured analytical thinking to solve problems with minimal direction
Designing and building intuitive Power BI dashboards that bring data to life for stakeholders
Using testing and measurement techniques to evaluate performance and optimise campaigns
Ensuring data accuracy by understanding and managing data lineage end-to-end
Identifying data challenges and proactively improving data quality and reliability
Creating clear, accessible documentation so work can be easily reused and scaled
Partnering with Ecommerce and Marketing stakeholders to support decision making and performance


About You

You’re a curious, commercially minded analyst who enjoys digging into data and uncovering the story behind it. You’re confident working independently, but equally comfortable collaborating with stakeholders to drive impact.

You bring both technical expertise and a strong understanding of how data supports real business decisions.

What You’ll Bring


Strong SQL skills, with experience writing complex queries in a commercial environment
A solid understanding of analytics, testing and statistical methods
Experience translating data into clear, engaging insights using tools like Power BI
The ability to communicate complex findings in a simple, compelling way
Experience working with semi-structured data, ideally in a retail or B2C environment
A proactive approach to problem solving, with a focus on quality and accuracy
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and influence
A natural curiosity and desire to understand the “why” behind the data
A mindset of continuous improvement, always looking to develop and add more value


Benefits

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Help transform the future of British Army training through the power of data.

Whether your analytical experience comes from industry, government or military service, this is your opportunity to apply your expertise where it matters most. As a Senior Data Analyst, you'll help transform how the British Army measures training performance, manages risk and drives continuous improvement. Working within the Insights, Guidance and Control (IGC) Cell, you'll turn complex data into actionable intelligence, support senior leaders with critical decisions, and help shape the future of collective training across the Army.

Permanent role - 37.5 hours a week

Hybrid role with 2 or 3 days a week in Warminster

Due to the nature of this role, you must be eligible for UK Security Clearance at BPSS level.

What you'll be doing



Analyse training, safety and operational data to identify trends, risks, opportunities and actionable insights.
Collect, validate and maintain data from multiple sources to ensure accurate and reliable reporting.
Develop and enhance dashboards, reports and visualisations that support senior decision-making and operational readiness.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation, standardisation and better reporting processes.
Work with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into meaningful analytical outputs.
Act as a subject matter expert, providing guidance on analytics tools, reporting best practice and data-driven decision making.
Mentor colleagues and promote high standards of analytical quality, consistency and continuous improvement.
Present findings clearly through reports, presentations and briefings while ensuring data security, confidentiality and compliance.



What we're looking for

Essential Skills/Experience/Qualifications



Appropriate Qualification in a data-related subject (such as Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or Business Analytics) or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience in a Senior Data Analyst, Business Intelligence or data-focused analytical role within a complex organisation.
Strong skills in collecting, cleansing, validating, analysing and interpreting data from multiple sources.
Advanced experience creating dashboards, reports and visualisations using Power BI and Excel.
Good understanding of data modelling, databases, data architecture and data quality management principles.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, explain performance and provide evidence-based recommendations.
Knowledge of AI-enabled analytics, data pipelines and the data requirements needed to support AI solutions.
Experience mentoring colleagues and confidently communicating technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.



Desirable Skills/Experience/Qualifications



Knowledge and experience of collective training
Knowledge of the military/Army



About ACTS (Army Collective Training Service)

The OMNIA® Training consortium brings together five leading UK defence training organisations: Capita, Raytheon, Rheinmetall, Cervus and Skyral. As the British Army's Strategic Training Partner (STP), OMNIA has a clear mission: to transform collective training over the next 15 years and deliver world-class training for the British Army.

Working with the Land Warfare Centre (LWC), OMNIA will schedule, plan, design, deliver and assure collective training across the Army's Collective Training System (ACTS), while also delivering the Collective Training Transformation Programme (CTTP). This generational opportunity will enable more relevant, challenging and safe training, helping the British Army to fight and win. Central to this mission is the ability to set and measure training performance against requirements, assure operational readiness, and capture associated training and safety risks.

Salary up to £50,000 depending on skills and experience
Enjoy flexible benefits including extra leave purchase, paid volunteering days, enhanced family leave, lifestyle discounts, and access to inclusive employee networks - all designed to support your wellbeing and personal growth.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Company




We’re Octopus Legacy: one of the fastest growing tech companies in the country, part of the UK’s most exciting and best-trusted group (you may have heard of some of our sister companies…) and we have a mission.




We’re on a path to scale, aiming to become a household name while transforming a long-established industry and helping our customers prepare for, and find support after, death.




But we can’t do it alone, and that’s why we’re assembling a team of top performers to build with us.




Ready to be part of something big?




The Role

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our growing data team at Octopus Legacy. You’ll play a central role in helping teams across the business make smarter, faster, more informed decisions.




While you’ll sit within the data team, your day-to-day will involve working directly with stakeholders from across the organisation such as Growth, Product and Operations. You’ll turn messy real-world data into actionable insights, bring structure to ambiguity, and help the business better understand what drives performance.




This is a hands-on, high-impact role in a fast-moving environment. You’ll need to be comfortable navigating shifting priorities, championing a data culture, and bringing rigour to complexity.




We’re still early in our data journey - right now, the focus is on building the foundations: modelling key metrics, creating dashboards, and getting reliable data into the hands of the people who need it. As our data maturity grows, there’ll be opportunities to go deeper into analysis, experimentation, and more advanced analytics.




Key Responsibilities:

Act as a thought partner to teams across the business - helping them define problems, clarify questions, and uncover the metrics that matter
Translate stakeholder needs into end-to-end data solutions: from raw data to dbt models to dashboards in Metabase
Define and document clear, consistent metrics to support better decision-making across departments
Build intuitive, impactful dashboards that make data accessible and actionable for non-technical users
Deliver ad-hoc and project-based analysis to evaluate initiatives in growth, product, operations, and beyond
Collaborate with the data team to improve the reliability, clarity, and accessibility of our data models and pipelines
Operate with a high degree of autonomy - scoping projects, pushing for clarity, and challenging assumptions when needed
Contribute to a culture of curiosity and rigour, laying the groundwork for more advanced analytics and data science over time




Who Are You?

You have 2+ years of experience in a data analytics role, ideally in a startup or a company building out its data capability
You're proficient in SQL and have worked with BI tools (like Metabase, Looker, or Tableau) to build dashboards that help teams make better decisions
You have hands-on experience with dbt or similar tools, and a solid understanding of data modelling best practices
You’re comfortable working with messy or incomplete data, and know how to turn it into something clean, structured, and useful
You enjoy working with non-technical stakeholders - you ask thoughtful questions, clarify ambiguous requests, and help teams think through what they really need
You take ownership of your work, are comfortable scoping projects with limited direction, and aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions
You’re curious, pragmatic, and excited by the idea of shaping a modern data function from the ground up
Bonus: you have an interest in experimentation or data science, and are keen to grow into more advanced analytics over time




Skills and Knowledge




Must haves:

Strong curiosity and proactive mindset, with the ability to independently explore data, ask the right questions, identify opportunities, and drive projects forward without requiring constant guidance.
Experience in data analytics and the ability to extract actionable insights from complex datasets.
Proficiency with SQL, DBT, python is desirable.
Proven ability to work closely with business stakeholders and translate their needs into data-driven solutions.
Experience in developing reports and dashboards to monitor key metrics.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to present complex data in a way that is understandable and actionable for non-technical stakeholders across departments.
Proficiency with data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Metabase).




Nice to haves/we can work on these:

Basic programming skills in languages such as Python.
Understanding of statistical methods and their application to business problems.
Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment.




Bonus if you:

You have a basic understanding of Data Science concepts and are interested in learning more.
You have experience in training or educating non-technical teams on data literacy.




Our Mission

When people think about planning for death they think about wills, life insurance and funerals. We take these cold processes and turn them into something more human. Share more than money: leave voice notes, music, recipes. Shape a legacy that connects you while you're here. And after you're gone.




Founded by Sam after his mum died suddenly, we’re a group of people who work in death because we’ve been affected by it. We know the difference a good plan makes, and what it’s like when there isn’t one.




Death can come between us, leave mess, legal fees, frustration. But it can also make us stronger. We see a world where people talk openly about death, and work out the real meaning of legacy, one that connects to them. We’re here to make that world happen.




Benefits:

Octopus share incentive scheme.
Hybrid working (London Bridge).
Flexible holiday + extra day off for your Birthday.
Work from anywhere in the world for up to 4 weeks per year.
Vitality Health & Life Insurance.
Pension scheme.
Enhanced parental leave.
Free Will & LPAs + discounts on other Octopus services.
Cycle to Work Scheme and access to the Electric Vehicle (EV) Salary Sacrifice Scheme.
Octopus Giving: we match any charitable fundraising that you do up to £500.
Octopus Springboard: where we help our employees become fully-fledged entrepreneurs.
Dog friendly office.
Breakfast every day, snacks and wellness activities




We know that to be truly innovative, we need to have a diverse team around us. That is why Octopus Legacy is committed to creating an inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Data Analyst (0448)
Description:
Make your career count

At Price Bailey, we provide exciting opportunities for training, personal growth and career engagement. We believe in fostering happiness and fulfilment in your work, whilst supporting and inspiring you to grow. We understand that your life extends beyond the workplace, which is why our Smart Working culture promotes flexibility, allowing you to choose when and where you work, whilst still providing excellent client care.

We are a well-established, independently owned firm of chartered accountants and business advisors, offering a comprehensive range of services including audit, accounting, tax, and corporate finance. We proudly support a diverse client base across the UK and internationally, with a strong focus on entrepreneurial, owner-managed businesses that share our passion for innovation.

What do the team do?

Our IT team plays an important role in helping the firm operate more efficiently, make better-informed decisions and continue to improve the way we deliver services to our clients.

As part of our growing data and digital transformation team, you will help develop, maintain and enhance reporting and analytical solutions that support decision-making across the firm. Working primarily with data from our Practice Management System and associated business applications, you will transform complex data into meaningful insight using SQL, Power BI and other Microsoft technologies.

The firm's reporting environment is built primarily around Microsoft SQL Server and Power BI, with data sourced from Practice Management, Finance, HR, CRM and other operational systems. This role will play a key part in the ongoing development of our reporting, data warehouse and wider business intelligence capabilities.

This is a Cambridge-based role and you'll be expected to attend the office regularly each week to work closely with colleagues and be fully involved in team activities.

What will I be doing?

As a Data Analyst you will have ownership of the following tasks:


Developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reports and KPI scorecards that provide meaningful insights to stakeholders across the firm.
Analysing business performance data, identifying trends and opportunities across areas such as fee income, utilisation, WIP, debtors and operational performance.
Writing, optimising and maintaining SQL queries, datasets and reporting models to support business intelligence and decision-making.
Supporting the ongoing development of the firm's data warehouse, integrating data from multiple systems and helping to improve data quality.
Creating and maintaining Power BI data models, DAX calculations and Power Query transformations.
Working closely with Partners, Department Heads and operational teams to translate business requirements into effective reporting and analytical solutions.
Promoting a data-driven culture by providing user support, maintaining reporting documentation and contributing to data governance and continuous improvement initiatives.


What experience do I need?

Whilst having the following experience is advantageous, we value passion and potential. If you meet the minimum criteria listed below and are eager to develop yourself, we would love to hear from you:


A degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Finance or a similar discipline (minimum criteria).
Prior experienceworking in a Data Analyst or Business Intelligence role within a professional services firm (minimum criteria).
Strong SQL Server experience, including advanced SQL querying, query optimisation and data modelling.
Experience developing reports using Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, dashboard development and row-level security.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including advanced formulas, Pivot Tables, Power Query and data analysis techniques.
Experience working with relational databases and large datasets.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.


What's on offer?

In addition to your salary, we also offer the following benefits:


25 days annual leave (with the option to buy/sell up to 5 days holiday)
Private medical
Contributory pension scheme
4x life assurance
All employee share scheme
Family friendly policies e.g. paid time off for dependants
2 days paid for volunteering
Cycle to work scheme
Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) including shopping discount


Price Bailey aspires to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people, regardless of their social background, age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, or marriage and civil partnership. We are an equal opportunities employer and place inclusion at the heart of what we do. Our workplace is one where diversity is embraced and where everyone is empowered to be their authentic selves.

Should you require any reasonable adjustments, please let us know in the appropriate section of your application. For candidates with a disability who meet the minimum criteria of the role, we also offer a guaranteed interview, which you can opt into as part of your application.

Price Bailey will only accept CV's from recruitment agencies who have been briefed on specific roles by our Resourcing team and where contractual agreement exists already. We do not accept speculative CV's and agency fees will not be owed in these instances. Should you wish to be considered for our approved supplier list please contact recruitment@pricebailey.co.uk

Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy with over 20,000 employees across more than 50 countries and 140+ offices.

We work across incredible global industries, delivering exciting work that is defining our future and making an important societal impact in the communities we serve. Our people power our performance – we succeed when they do. With countless opportunities to collaborate, learn, and grow, the possibilities for excellence are as varied as every individual.

Whether you want to grow as a subject matter expert or broaden your experience with roles across our international community, you’re surrounded by global specialists who want to combine their expertise and champion you to be your best. As a proudly employee-owned business, we benefit our clients, our communities, and each other, investing in creating the right space for everyone to feel empowered, included, and valued. Whatever your ambition, Mott MacDonald is where people come to be brilliant.
About The business unit 
The Buildings Unit (BLD) has a major presence in Mott MacDonald's regional offices throughout the UK and mainland Europe, providing a wide range of diverse and transferable cross-sector skills across five key Sectors; Advisory, Built Environment, Energy, Transportation and Water. We also provide local services to customers and technical leadership to the rest of the Group in these sectors.

Overview Of The Role
The Healthcare Consulting Services Portfolio of the Health Division provides strategic and operational consultancy advice and support to healthcare clients to improve services outcomes for patients and staff. A key part of this advice centres on having robust data analysis and modelling outputs to provide evidence-based solutions for clients.

We provide support to Department of Health & Social Care, NHS England, New Hospital Programme, NHS clients and work internationally on projects in the Middle East, Canada and Australia.

This is an exciting opportunity for a candidate with demonstrable proven healthcare data analytical experience who can support a range of healthcare projects and complement our growing team of healthcare strategic and healthcare system planners, healthcare facility planners, digital specialists, facility managers and general consultancy specialists.

Key responsibilities and duties include:Data Collection: Requesting and gathering data from various sources, including clients, surveys, databases, and online platforms
Data Cleansing: Applying appropriate processes to clean and preprocess data to ensure accuracy and quality, removing duplicates and correcting errors
Data Analysis: Interpreting data to identify trends, patterns, and insights, including opportunities for performance optimisation
Data Modelling: Leading the development of complex and interactive models that can translate and illustrate the impact of new ways of working and configurations of service delivery to provide forecasts of future service demand and capacity requirements
Automation of Processes: support the wider Portfolio to automate current processes and increase our internal efficiency and productivity
Reporting and Visualization: Present findings through visualizations, reports, and dashboards, making complex data understandable for stakeholders
Collaboration: Working collaboratively across the business with other data analysts and as part of multidisciplinary teams


Candidate specification
Essential:

Degree level or higher qualification in a related analytical field
Demonstrable experience in data analysis, modelling within the healthcare sector
Adept at identifying problems and proposing data-driven solutions
Strong analytical abilities to interpret data and derive meaningful insights
Proficiency in tools such as Excel, Power Query, Python, R, or similar and data visualisation software, including PowerBI
Ability to communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including report writing skills
Support to business development activities and service solutions


UK Immigration
Mott MacDonald Ltd. are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024. We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.

Agile working
At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well-being, flexibility, and trust.

Equality, diversity, and inclusion
We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels they can contribute.

AI Usage
At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application.

Accessibility
We want you to feel supported and able to perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. If there is anything we can do to make applying or interviewing with us more accessible, please contact us at reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com and we'll be happy to discuss how we can help.

We offer some fantastic benefits including:
Financial wellbeing

We match employee pension contributions between 4.5% and 7%.
Life assurance equal up to 4 x your basic salary, with an option to increase the level of cover to 6 x your salary.
Our income protection scheme provides a financial benefit, as well as absence and return to work support due to long-term illness or injury.
Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing.
As an independently owned business we share the financial success of the business with all our colleagues in various ways including annual bonus schemes.


Employee Ownership

Our employee ownership model means no external investors, just us, creating a culture of shared success.
Our employees have a stake and a voice in our business, giving them a direct connection to our success through our personal and group performance bonuses.
As your career grows, so does your stake, recognising your long-term impact and contribution.
Your voice matters, with the opportunity to connect directly with senior leadership through formal channels to help shape our future.
For our senior roles you will have a direct pathway towards ownership from day one.


Health and wellbeing

Private medical insurance for all UK colleagues.
Health cash plan to support you with every day health costs and treatments.
Access to Peppy, providing free support from menopause experts for all UK colleagues.
A variety of wellbeing support is available through our comprehensive wellbeing program, including access for you and your family.
Ability to flex your salary to opt into a wide range of health benefits, many of which can be extended to your family too.


Lifestyle

A minimum of 33-35 days holiday each year, inclusive of public holidays and dependent on level, with the ability to buy or sell leave through our flexible benefits programme.
10 days additional paid leave for Armed Forces Reservists and Cadet Force Adult Volunteers.
Holiday entitlement increased to a minimum of 35 days after 5 years’ service.
Variety of employee saving schemes and discounts from high-street retailers.


Enhanced family and carers leave

Enhanced family leave policies, including 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave, and two weeks paid paternity/partner leave.
Our shared parental leave matches maternity leave meaning we pay up to 24 weeks at full pay.
Up to five additional days leave are provided for those with significant caring responsibilities, two of which are paid.
We offer policies and dedicated support to help military families balance service life with career and wellbeing.


Learning and development

Primary annual professional institution subscription.
A broad range of opportunities to enhance both technical and soft skills through mentoring, formal training, and self-development options.


Networks, communities, and social outcomes

Join a wide range of groups including our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability, and parents/carers communities.
We are proud signatories of the Armed Forces Covenant and Gold Award holders in the MOD Employer Recognition Scheme, supported by our dedicated internal Armed Forces Network.
Make a difference within our communities through our social outcomes.

Title: Data Analyst - Fraud
Description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What You Will Get To Do


Investigate fraud attacks, quantify their impact, and present clear findings that drive prioritisation and response
Propose and refine rule-based mitigations, working with fraud operations and engineering to see them through to implementation
Build and maintain reporting and dashboards to monitor fraud trends, rule performance, and key operational metrics
Work closely with fraud operations, data scientists, engineers, and product managers to ensure analytical insights translate into action
Proactively identify emerging patterns and flag risks before they escalate


To succeed in this role, you should have


Proven experience as a Data Analyst (Fraud), or a similar role (4+ years, can be made up for with accomplishments)
Strong problem solving skills
Advanced proficiency with SQL. you're comfortable writing complex queries to investigate and slice data across large datasets
Experience in fraud, risk, or financial services; you understand how fraud attacks work and how to think about mitigation trade-offs
A proactive mindset — you don't wait to be asked; you spot something unusual and you dig in
Some exposure to Python or scripting for data manipulation and analysis
Proficiency with a BI tool (PowerBI, Looker, Tableau, Superset, Redash, or any other alternative)
Strong stakeholder management skills; you can communicate findings clearly to fraud operations, product managers, engineers, and senior leadership — and you know how to influence decisions with data across all of them.
Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams where priorities shift quickly.
Proficiency with a spreadsheet tool (Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, or any other alternative)
Enjoy autonomy and a flat structure: we have millions of customers and a flat hierarchy so any individual can have an outsized impact
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
A drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or any other related field


Experience With The Following Would Be a Plus


Data governance
Python or any other scripting language
Git or any other version control tool


What We Can Offer You


Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We have built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.


What To Expect In The Hiring Process


A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
Technical take-home task (SQL test).
Technical Interview with hiring manager.
A behavioural interview with the Head of Data Analytics/Science and Fraud Team.


Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Nottingham Trent House (95002), United Kingdom, Nottingham, Nottinghamshire

Senior Data Analyst

About The Role

Are you an experienced and passionate data professional looking to drive meaningful change? This could be the perfect role for you.

Data Analysis is at the core of our UK business, delivering critical insights that shape information-driven strategies and influence key company decisions. As a Senior Lead Data Analyst, you will take a pivotal role in driving analytical excellence, spearheading analytical initiatives, and shaping the agenda for high-impact business areas.

Using advanced analytical and technical expertise, you will innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions—making complex business data more accessible and actionable.

What You'll Do

On any given day, you’ll work across problem-solving, solution generation, innovation, and data management. Your responsibilities will include:


Data Extraction & Manipulation – Handling highly complex, business-critical requests with precision.
Collaboration & Solution Development – Partnering with diverse teams and stakeholders to design user-friendly data solutions, tools, and self-service frameworks.
Insight Generation – Scanning and leveraging available data sources to provide actionable insights that drive business growth.
Exploring Emerging Technologies – Quickly adapting to and integrating new technologies to enhance analytical capabilities.
Subject Matter Expertise – Developing deep expertise in key data-driven workstreams and becoming a trusted advisor across the business.
Additional Contributions – Providing consultancy and resolution support for customer-impacting issues, fulfilling customer account updates, and producing large data sets for customer surveys.


What We're Looking For


Expertise in Data Analytics – Advanced proficiency in core data analyst skills, including coding, data transformation, comprehensive data knowledge, and a strong understanding of systems.
Technical Excellence – Advanced SQL skills required, with proficiency in at least one additional programming language (e.g. Python, R) preferred.
Strategic Thinking & Stakeholder Engagement – Proven ability to communicate complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders and drive decision-making.
Problem-Solving & Analytical Rigor – A structured, inquisitive approach to solving challenges through data-driven methods.
Numerical & Trend Analysis – A natural affinity for numbers and a keen eye for identifying trends to inform business decisions.
Initiative & Ownership – Strong ability to prioritize workloads, deliver results at pace, and escalate issues effectively when required.

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
Junior Data Analyst


Bristol | Hybrid | Up to £35,000

We're working with an established organisation in Bristol that is looking for a Junior Data Analyst to join their growing data team.

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their data career with a strong foundation in SQL, who wants to develop their experience across data retrieval, data modelling, Power BI and business reporting.

The Role


You'll work with business data to produce accurate, reliable reporting and analysis. A key part of the role will be using SQL to retrieve, manipulate and model data from relational databases, ensuring data is structured correctly and ready for reporting and analysis.

You'll also work closely with stakeholders to understand their reporting requirements and translate these into practical data solutions, including Power BI reports and dashboards.

Key Responsibilities






Use SQL to retrieve, manipulate and analyse data from relational databases.




Build and maintain data models to support reporting and analytics.




Develop and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards, using DAX where required.




Work with stakeholders to understand their reporting requirements.




Validate, cleanse and reconcile data to ensure accuracy and consistency.




Investigate data issues and resolve reporting discrepancies.




Test reports and datasets against source data.




Maintain documentation around data sources, definitions and transformations.




Support wider data quality, governance and reporting initiatives.


What We're Looking For


The key requirement is strong SQL knowledge and an understanding of how data is structured and modelled.

You'll ideally have:






Good working knowledge of SQL, including joins, filtering, aggregation, subqueries and data manipulation.




An understanding of relational databases and data modelling.




Some practical experience with Power BI, including reports and dashboards.




Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.




Good communication skills and the ability to work with non-technical stakeholders.




A curious and proactive approach to learning and developing your technical skills.


This will be a 2 stage interview process and for the right candidate my client can interview next week!


If you're interested in this role, or know someone who would be, then please apply to this advert and reach out to a. methula@ioassociates.co.uk

Description:
Salary: Competitive plus benefits

Working Pattern: Full Time

Contract Type: Permanent

About Matalan

From humble beginnings to disruptive innovations in the retail industry, find out about how Matalan is ever-evolving here.

We know as a team, we are stronger together – we champion equality for all and make lasting connections that go beyond work. We thrive off our inclusive culture, encouraging our colleagues to bring their true selves to work and contributing to collective creativity, open-mindedness and growth.

We want give every candidate the opportunity to perform at their best throughout the application and interview process and then ultimately in their role. If you require any adjustments during our recruitment process, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

In the event that a high volume of suitable applications are received, the post may close prior to the specified closing date. Please apply as soon as possible if interested.

About The Role

Join our dynamic Ecommerce team at Matalan as an Ecommerce Data Analyst! In this role, you'll play a pivotal part in driving our online success by leveraging your technical expertise in data collection, tracking and analysis. You will transform complex web data into clear, compelling stories with actionable recommendations that directly influence business decisions.

A vital role within the Analytics and Ecommerce teams, you will deliver critical web data insights to the Ecommerce team. This involves transforming business questions into analytical problems, analysing intricate datasets, and presenting concise, persuasive, and actionable insights that drive informed decisions and optimize online performance.

Key Responsibilities -


Delivery of actionable insight: utilise a variety of analytical techniques to deliver valuable actionable insight that address diverse business challenges
Stakeholder Relationship Management: Comfortable building strong relationships with key stakeholders to understand their analytical needs, identify challenges, opportunities and contribute to their strategic roadmaps
Commercial Impact Analysis: Able to evaluate the commercial viability of insights, quantify the impact of data driven decisions and prioritise future work that maximise value delivery.
Analytical Tool and Process Development: Develop and implement tools, reports, and processes that enhance the analytical capabilities of the team and wider business, with a focus on data democratisation and self serve analytics for the key teams.
Insight Democratisation: Create and maintain automated BI that promote data awareness and enhance the business knowledge of our online performance and customer behaviours.
Active member of the Analytics team: Sharing insight, analytical process and underlying data changes in the ecomm area with the wider analytics and data science team as part of our regular knowledge sharing.


About You


Educated to a degree level or with demonstrable relevant experience
Extensive experience of at least 4 years working with BigQuery is essential including a solid understanding of SQL coding
Strong Experience of Google analytics (GA4).
Extensive Experience of visualisation software essential (e.g. Power BI/ Looker).
Understanding of analysis methodologies essential (statistical techniques a plus). 
Awareness of ETL processes and database automation.
Experience working with AI tools to generate automated insights advantageous
Confident in Microsoft Excel and full Microsoft Suite. (Or cloud based equivalents)


Benefits

In addition to competitive salaries, we also offer the below core benefits:


20% staff discount, which increases with length of service
Thrive Recognition Scheme
Wellbeing support provided by the Retail Trust
Life Assurance
Retail Rewards platform offering discounts for other retailers
Pension Scheme
Access to a wide range of career development
Additional benefits may apply depending on your role and area of the business

Description:
Welcome to Transport for London Careers

Job Title: Data Analyst – Business Intelligence

Grade: Band 2

Salary: Circa £37,500 (dependent on skill, knowledge and experience)

Contract Type: Permanent / Full Time / Hybrid

Reference: SF4355

Location: Southwark, SE1 8JZ

Hybrid working, within this role enables a balance of 50% of time split between the office and home over a 4-week period. Hybrid working arrangements can evolve subject to business requirements.

The closing date for applications is Tuesday 1 September @ 23:59

All offers of employment are subject to satisfactory right‑to‑work checks. Candidates must be able to demonstrate their right to work in the UK. At the present time TfL is unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Overview of Role

Join TfL’s Asset Strategy team at the heart of London’s long‑term asset renewal and investment planning, where data directly shapes how we keep the network safe and reliable. As a Data Analyst, you’ll help build and evolve our Asset Investment Models within TfL’s Decision Support System, turning complex asset inventory and performance data into clear, evidence‑led investment plans. You’ll develop and maintain impactful reporting and analytics products using tools like Power BI. If you love combining data, problem‑solving and real‑world impact, this is a chance to see your work directly influence the future of London’s transport network.

Key Accountabilities 


Support the development of Asset Investment Models using TfL’s Decision Support System.
Develop and maintain business reporting using standard tools and coding languages, e.g. Power BI, M, DAX, SQL, to investment decisions and capital programmes and.
Support asset data quality improvements through identifying errors, gaps and omissions in various asset datasets.
Interpret, manipulate and analyse data from multiple sources and databases to deliver greater insight and more value from our asset inventory data.
Provide accurate and timely outputs that can be understood by stakeholders with varying technical knowledge.
Provide analysis of multiple data sources using statistical and system tools/techniques.
Develop supporting material and provide training and guidance when necessary for tools and reports created by the team.


Skills, Knowledge & Experience

Skills & Experience


Experience in interpreting, analysing and manipulating complex datasets (including spatial) from multiple sources through applying statistical techniques, quantitative methodologies and system tools.
Experience in developing and maintaining management reports using Microsoft tools and coding languages (e.g. Power BI, M, DAX, SQL, MS Excel).
Experience in coding in R (Essential).
Experience of document management systems (e.g. SharePoint).
Experience in the use of GIS software such as QGIS.
Experience in working and supporting asset management systems. You will have experience with engaging with a wide range of stakeholders to capture requirements for data (including spatial) analysis and reporting.
Good written and oral communication skills, including the ability to present information to non-technical stakeholders.


Knowledge


Degree in computer science, data analysis or information management; including Geographical Information Systems (GIS), or a similar area or equivalent business experience.
Good understanding of broad range of information management systems; including asset management, GIS and workflow systems.
Understanding of principles of asset management.
Good understanding of reporting packages, databases and programming languages (e.g. SQL) for the querying, extracting and analysis of asset data.
Good understanding of quantitative and statistical approaches for gaining insight into data.
Good understanding of industry best practises, approaches and tools for data analytics and insight.
Understanding of data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI) together with dashboard and report design good practice.


Equality, Diversity and Inclusion

We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and aim to reflect the diverse communities we serve. We believe that a diverse workforce enables us to deliver better services and outcomes. Our goal is to make our recruitment as inclusive as possible. As a Disability Confident Leader, we actively encourage applications from disabled people. As part of the Disability Confident scheme, we aim to offer an assessment or interview to candidates who apply via the scheme where the minimum essential criteria for skills, knowledge and experience has been met. In some circumstances, it may not be practical to offer an interview or assessment to every candidate who applies through the scheme and meet the minimum essential criteria; in these situations, we select candidates who best meet the minimum criteria for the job rather than interviewing all who meet them.

Across all recruitment activity, we recognise that selection methods may vary depending on the nature and scale of the campaign and will be applied fairly, consistently and proportionately in line with our Disability Confident commitments.  

Application Process



Please apply using your most recent CV and optional 1 page Cover Letter (Word format only) explaining how you meet the criteria listed under the section ‘Role Requirements’, with reference to the skills, knowledge and experience you have gained at expert level.

You are encouraged to apply for the position that is most relevant to your existing skills, knowledge and experience as shortlisting is carried out on the basis of how well you meet the criteria for the role.

The closing date for applications is Tuesday 1 September @ 23:59





Vetting Process

At Transport for London, safety, trust and fairness sit at the heart of how we recruit. Our Vetting Charter (https://tfl.gov.uk/corporate/careers/our-vetting-process) explains the checks we carry out before you join us, helping ensure we create a safe, inclusive and reliable network for everyone who depends on our services. We simply ask that the information you provide is honest and accurate so we can progress your application smoothly. If something doesn’t match or can’t be verified, we may not be able to move forward with your application, but we’ll always treat you with transparency, respect, and clear communication throughout.

Benefits

In return for your commitment and expertise, you will enjoy excellent benefits and scope to grow. Rewards vary according to the level of role but mostly include the below:


Final salary pension scheme
Free travel for you on the TfL network
Reimbursement of 75% of the cost of a standard class Ticket for National Rail travel from home
30 days annual leave plus public and bank holidays
TfL is committed to work-life balance, operating a hybrid working approach where business and role requirements allow
Private healthcare discounted scheme (optional)
Tax-efficient cycle-to-work programme
Retail, health, leisure and travel offers
Discounted Eurostar travel


We will make every effort to give you as much notice as possible, however some interviews/assessments could be organised at short notice.

Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help turn data into insight that drives innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music?

Universal Music UK is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to become part of our UK central data, AI and technology team. The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun.

The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. In a creative organisation such as ours, reducing a complex problem into something simple is key, so any experience managing stakeholders, shaping questions and translating data into clear insight would also be a strength.

Alongside this, you will be responsible for delivering analysis, reporting and measurement that helps solve real business problems across Universal Music UK. You will work with stakeholders to understand business needs, define the right questions and turn complex data into clear, actionable insight. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business teams, you will help improve how we measure performance, understand audiences and identify opportunities for our artists, labels and central teams. As we’re first and foremost a data, AI and technology team, you should be comfortable working with large datasets, technical teams and modern analytics tools.

As part of the central data, AI and technology team, you’ll have a chance to work across all divisions, including AMS, frontline labels, our catalogue division UMR, and all other central teams, as well as data and technology teams within the wider business. This includes helping shape insight, reporting and data products that support & supercharge the labels.

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities include:


Working directly with the Data & AI team to support artists & labels across the business.
Being a senior voice within the team and leading data strategy at a label level.
Supporting core strategic research with data & audience insight.
Researching & developing data driven solutions to solve current & future business problems.
Utilising partner data to pull out key metrics and feeding back to the label teams.
Advising on data related topics to help guide or inform business decisions.
Sourcing, cleaning and preparing data for modelling, product creation or visualisation.
Developing new data sets or features that become integral to how the business operates.


At the heart of this role is a desire to give us a competitive edge in connecting our artists with audiences across the globe. More will be explained at Interview. Rest assured, this is an exciting role as part of an innovative new initiative within the organisation.

Skills

Skills & Experience


Strong ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight.
Creative and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.
Strong stakeholder engagement, management and communication skills.
Ability to lead analytical projects from idea through to delivery and adoption.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying large datasets accurately and efficiently.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform or AWS.
Experience building dashboards, reporting products and self-serve insight tools.
Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes and data quality.
Working knowledge of Python or another programming language for analysis.
Familiarity with Git, version control and modern analytics workflows.
Good understanding of AI, machine learning concepts and their practical application.
Ability to mentor others and raise the quality of analytical work across a team.
Knowledge of music repertoire is advantageous.


Experience


Minimum of 4 years’ experience in a data analyst, analytics or related role.
Background engaging stakeholders in a consultative or analytical capacity.
Experience leading analysis that informs business decisions and product development.
Experience working with engineering, data science or product teams to turn analysis into scalable tools, reporting or data products.


Education


Degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
A background in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Economics, Data Science or a similarly analytical discipline would be advantageous.

Title: Data Analyst

Location: Bristol (Hybrid, 2-3 days per week in the office)

Salary: £50,000 - £60,000 DOE

Industry: SaaS




The Opportunity

I'm currently working with a fast-growing SaaS organisation based in Bristol that is looking to hire a Data Analyst to join its growing data and analytics function.




This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in turning data into meaningful insights that support decision-making across the business. You'll work closely with stakeholders across commercial, product, marketing and operational teams to understand business requirements, analyse data and deliver reporting that helps drive performance.




The business is continuing to invest in its data capabilities, making this an exciting time to join a growing technology organisation where data is becoming increasingly central to how the business operates.




If you're passionate about using data to solve business problems, enjoy working closely with stakeholders and want to make a tangible impact within a SaaS environment, this could be an excellent next step in your career.




Key Responsibilities

Analyse business and customer data to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.
Design, develop and maintain dashboards and reports for stakeholders across the organisation.
Gather reporting requirements from business users and translate them into effective analytical solutions.
Develop and maintain SQL queries to extract, manipulate and analyse data.
Produce regular KPI, performance and management reporting.
Work closely with commercial, product, marketing and operational teams to understand business challenges and provide data-driven recommendations.
Support ad-hoc analysis to answer key business questions and inform strategic decisions.
Ensure the accuracy, consistency and quality of reporting across multiple data sources.
Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes and data visibility across the business.
Communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Document reporting processes and maintain high standards across the data and analytics function.




Essential Skills and Experience

Previous experience as a Data Analyst, BI Analyst or similar analytical role.
Strong SQL skills with experience querying and analysing relational databases.
Experience developing dashboards using Power BI, Tableau or a similar BI platform.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to turn data into actionable insights.
Experience working with business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver analytical solutions.
Strong communication skills with the ability to present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Excellent attention to detail and a strong focus on data accuracy.
Ability to manage multiple priorities within a fast-paced SaaS or technology environment.




Desirable Skills

Previous experience within a SaaS, software or technology organisation.
Experience working with product, customer or commercial data.
Exposure to Python or R for data analysis.
Understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modelling.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery or Azure.
Knowledge of data quality and governance best practices.
Experience working within Agile environments.
Exposure to tools such as dbt, Looker or Microsoft Fabric.




Package and Benefits

£50,000 - £60,000 salary (depending on experience).
Hybrid working (2-3 days per week in the Bristol office).
Annual performance bonus.
Competitive pension scheme.
Private medical insurance.
25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
Life assurance.
Flexible benefits package.
Ongoing learning and professional development opportunities.
Clear progression opportunities within a growing data function.
Opportunity to work within a growing SaaS organisation where data has a direct impact on commercial and strategic decision-making.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
We are looking for experienced Senior Data Analysts to join Customer Operations Data & Analytics, specialising in analytical problem solving, experimentation, insight generation and business change support.

Customer Operations is evolving rapidly. With Genesys becoming central to our customer journeys and AI Copilot transforming colleague experiences, data is critical in understanding customer behaviour, operational performance and business outcomes.

This is a hands-on senior analyst role for individuals who enjoy solving complex problems, challenging assumptions and helping the business make better decisions through evidence-based analysis. You will partner with operational leaders, product teams and transformation programmes to assess opportunities, measure impact and drive meaningful change.

You Will

What you'll be doing


Lead analytical investigations into customer journeys, operational performance and business outcomes.
Partner with stakeholders to define problems, shape analytical approaches and measure success.
Design and support tests, experiments and evaluations to assess the impact of new initiatives.
Apply statistical and analytical techniques to identify trends, opportunities, risks and key drivers.
Turn complex data into clear, actionable insight and recommendations.
Support transformation activity by identifying where change delivers the greatest value.
Challenge assumptions using evidence and analytical reasoning.
Develop dashboards, visualisations and analytical products that improve decision making.
Help define meaningful KPIs and measurement frameworks.
Coach analysts and promote best practice in analysis, experimentation and stakeholder engagement.


What We're Looking For

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Senior Data Analyst

Location: City of London (3 days per week)

Salary: £70,000–£85,000 + 20–40% bonus + benefits




Gravitas has partnered with a well-established London Market insurance organisation to recruit a Senior Data Analyst into its Data Analytics team. This is a priority hire with a real need for someone who can add value quickly, particularly in Power BI and Microsoft Fabric and who is confident partnering with underwriters and senior stakeholders.




Background note: Lloyd’s / London Market experience is still preferred, but we are now open to candidates from broader insurance and financial services backgrounds. Exceptional candidates from outside these sectors will be considered if they are technically strong and commercially minded.




The Role




Reporting to the Data Analytics Manager (Ballint’s team), you’ll sit in the “bridge” between the business and data/IT teams—translating stakeholder needs into well-scoped analysis and high-quality Power BI deliverables.




This role is commercially led (stakeholder partnership, requirements shaping, influencing decision-making) rather than deep pipeline engineering. You’ll also work closely with the Senior Data Scientist to agree clear handover points between analytics and data science.




Key Projects

Delegated data programme (multi-year): delivering granular, underwriter-ready insight and MI.
Power BI adoption & rationalisation: improving standards, reusability, governance, and reducing duplicated / inconsistent reporting.




What You’ll Be Doing

Partner closely with underwriters and business stakeholders to understand objectives, shape requirements, and communicate insight clearly.
Design, build and enhance Power BI dashboards and semantic models aligned to best practice (not quick prototypes).
Help drive Power BI standards and governance (modelling discipline, performance, usability, trusted metrics).
Collaborate with data/IT teams to ensure upstream data supports commercial reporting needs (without being the core data engineering owner).




Skills & Experience

Essential

Strong experience delivering Power BI in a commercial stakeholder environment (you must be credible with senior stakeholders; this is a key interview focus).
Power BI: strong modelling discipline and best practices (incl. star schema thinking, measure design, performance considerations).
Ability to translate ambiguous questions into clear, deliverable analytics outputs.

Preferred / Advantageous

Lloyd’s / London Market / specialty insurance experience (preferred, not mandatory).
Exposure to Copilot / AI tooling in analytics workflows (nice-to-have, not required).




Why This Role

If you enjoy being the person who can get underwriters aligned, define what “good” looks like, and deliver high-quality BI that stands up to scrutiny—this is a strong opportunity in a team investing in better decision support and BI maturity.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Connect2Hackney, as the internal talent team for the London Borough of Hackney, are excited to offer an opportunity for an experienced Data Analyst to join our forward-thinking Customer Services, Digital & Data team.




In this key role, you will be working at SFIA Level 4 ('Enable') to bridge the gap between raw data and impactful organisational decision-making. You will collaborate with stakeholders across the Council to translate complex business challenges into actionable insights, build user-friendly dashboards, and champion data-driven service improvements that directly benefit Hackney’s residents and local businesses.




Key Responsibilities




Identify, clean, aggregate, and analyse internal and external datasets. Design and automate high-impact visualisations and dashboards that empower leaders to make faster, better-informed decisions.
Partner across directorates and matrixed teams (e.g., Insight Service, Customer Experience, Digital Products) to understand business processes, key KPIs, and analytics requirements.
Collaborate with Data Engineers and data owners to build trusted, reusable datasets using open-source languages and the Council's analytical data platform.
Work within an Agile framework to iteratively deliver insights. Promote data sharing, best practices, and innovative analytical tools across the organisation.
Implement robust data management, privacy, security, and risk controls to maintain the integrity, confidentiality, and accessibility of information assets.
Provide direct line management for an Associate Analyst, contribute to multidisciplinary teams, and join an out-of-hours user support rota (with additional payment provided).




What We Are Looking For




We are seeking an analytical professional operating at SFIA Level 4 who demonstrates autonomy, influence, and strong technical problem-solving capabilities:




Core Competencies & Technical Skills

Data Visualisation: Proven experience using leading data analytics and visualisation tools to design, operationalise, and automate clear reports and visual formats.
Data Science: Ability to investigate complex problem sets, apply data science techniques/programming languages, evaluate models, and integrate data sources.
Data Modelling & Design: Skill in investigating ambiguous enterprise data requirements, planning data structures, and offering architectural guidance.
Business Intelligence: Strong background in querying and optimising non-standard BI tools to streamline operational data and drive governance/management decisions.
Information Assurance: Understanding of risk management, information security, data protection/privacy, and accreditation frameworks.




About You




Comfortable working under general direction, taking accountability, and planning tasks to hit quality targets.
Fluent in translating complex technical data into plain, structured narrative stories for both non-technical and technical audiences.
Adaptable, fast-paced mindset comfortable with iterative design and continuous learning.




Qualifications




Ideally educated to a Bachelor’s degree level and/or holds a relevant professional qualification.
Equivalent practical experience working at a similar technical level will be fully considered in lieu of formal qualifications.




Why Join Hackney Council?




Community Impact: Work directly on corporate objectives and Mayor's priorities that create positive social outcomes for Hackney’s diverse community.
Professional Growth: Active investment in your professional development, training opportunities, and peer networks.
Inclusive Environment: A culture committed to equal opportunities, accessibility, sustainability, and hybrid flexible working

Title: MI Analyst
Description:
Your Responsibilities

As Lockton’s continued investment in Data and MI the appetite for data is only increasing and is highly valued by senior management. As a result, we are looking to recruit the appropriate data individual to join the team.

First and foremost, the right candidate must fit in with Lockton’s culture. At Lockton we value the following principles:


Client first
Results and impact driven
Self-motivated
Continuous improvement


Role Responsibilities


Partner with business stakeholders to gather, challenge, and translate reporting and analytics requirements.
Extract, transform, analyse, and interpret data from multiple sources to support business decision-making.
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and semantic models.
Write efficient, scalable SQL queries to support reporting.
Deliver insights and recommendations that help stakeholders understand trends, performance, risks, and opportunities.
Collaborate with technical and non-technical teams to promote a data-driven culture across the organisation.


Qualifications

We are seeking a proactive and analytical individual who enjoys solving complex data challenges and turning information into valuable business insight.

You will be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can evolve quickly and will demonstrate the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing demands. A strong desire to learn, develop, and continuously improve is essential

Power BI

Data ingestion and transformation (Power Query)
Data modelling
DAX development and optimisation


SQL & Data Analysis


Strong SQL development skills, including query optimisation and troubleshooting.
Solid understanding of relational database design and data modelling principles.
Experience analysing large and complex datasets to identify trends and business opportunities.


Excel


Advanced Excel skills, including:
Power Query
Power Pivot
Complex formulas and modelling techniques


Preferred Skills:


Experience working with Databricks in a modern data platform environment.
Knowledge of dbt (Data Build Tool) for data transformation and modelling.
Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure.
Experience working with data engineering or ETL pipelines.
Exposure to version control and collaborative development practices (e.g., Git/GitHub).
Experience working within financial services, insurance, or other highly regulated industries.

Title: Senior Performance Analyst (x2)
Description:
About The Role

Are you an experienced analyst who can turn complex data into clear, actionable insight?

MOPAC's Evidence & Insight is a dedicated in-house team of analysts and researchers who provide analysis and insight on crime, policing and criminal justice across London. We are looking for two Senior Performance Analysts to support MOPAC's oversight of the Metropolitan Police Service through high-quality performance analysis and reporting.

In this exciting and dynamic role, you will work with a range of large datasets to:


Identify patterns, trends and emerging issues, using a variety of statistical and analytic techniques.
Translate analytical findings into clear evidence for senior leaders and decision-makers.
Produce insightful reports, briefings and presentations to inform discussions on policing performance and oversight.
You will also lead the development of regular performance reporting products and interactive dashboards so stakeholders and Londoners alike have access to timely, accurate and meaningful information.


Required Skills & Experience

You will have:


Strong experience in quantitative analysis and working with large and/or complex datasets.
The ability to identify key insights from data and communicate them with impact to senior stakeholders and non-technical audiences. You will do this through reports, presentations and data visualisations.
Advanced skills in Power BI and experience in dashboard designing, data modelling, as well as programming in DAX and through Power Query.
A collaborative approach and the ability to work with colleagues and partners across policing and criminal justice.


This is an exciting opportunity for an analyst who enjoys combining technical expertise with critical thinking to deliver meaningful insight on policing and crime in London.

Application Process

Candidates must submit their CV and must answer (around 1,500 characters per answer) to the supplementary questions which are:


Describe a piece of analysis you have undertaken using a large or complex dataset. How did you identify the key insights, and how did those insights influence understanding, decisions or actions?
Tell us about a time when you had to communicate complex analytical findings to a senior or non-technical audience. How did you present the information, and what was the outcome?
Describe a Power BI report or dashboard you have developed. What business need did it address, what techniques did you use, and what impact did it have for users or decision-makers?
Describe a time when you worked with multiple stakeholders to deliver an analytical or performance reporting project. How did you manage differing requirements and ensure a high-quality outcome?


You can also find out more about MOPAC by visiting our website.

If you have a question about the role or the recruitment process, please contact a member of the HR team via email on [email protected]
