Title: MAINTENANCE/RELIABILITY ENGINEER (MSE)
Description:
Job description:



MAINTENANCE/RELIABILITY ENGINEER

(MSE) 

Role purpose:

To improve the reliability, availability, and performance of plant and equipment through the development and implementation of effective maintenance strategies, data-driven reliability improvements, and compliance with all safety and regulatory requirements.

Your main responsibilities / What you will do:

Collaborate with the Senior Maintenance Manager UK to achieve Manufacturing Services and Group Property goals.
Coordinate maintenance with production teams and support Health & Safety Standards as Responsible Person when needed.
Manage equipment and site improvement projects, organize planned maintenance, and analyze failures with skilled engineers.
Prioritise machine issues, negotiate maintenance schedules, deliver programs such as PUWER and engineering inspections, and address risk management.
Work with procurement on cost objectives and senior management on funding plans. Ensure OEMs provide required services.
Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Investigating equipment breakdowns using methodologies like 5-Whys, FMEA, or fishbone diagrams to identify and fix the underlying source of a problem.
Preventative and Predictive Maintenance (PM/PdM): Designing maintenance schedules and leveraging technologies (such as vibration analysis or thermal imaging) to predict failures before they happen.
Data Analysis & Loss Elimination: Tracking key performance indicators (KPIs) like Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) and Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) to target the most expensive or problematic machinery.
CMMS Management: Utilizing Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (such as SAP, Maximo, or similar platforms) to track work orders, log equipment history, and source spare parts.
Training provided as necessary.

Who we are looking for:

Technical

Strong understanding of mechanical and/or electrical systems
Expertise in reliability engineering tools (RCA, FMEA, RCM)
Experience with CMMS/EAM systems (SAP PM desirable)
Knowledge of condition monitoring techniques

Analytical

Strong data analysis and problem-solving capability
Ability to interpret trends and performance metrics
Experience with Excel (advanced); Power BI or similar desirable

Behavioural

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
Structured, methodical, and detail-oriented approach
Ability to influence and drive change
Proactive and results-focused mindset

Qualifications & Experience

Essential

Level 3 Vocational Qualification in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, or related discipline)
Proven experience in a maintenance/reliability engineering role
Experience within a manufacturing or industrial environment
Knowledge of UK health & safety legislation
Managing Contractors
Experience of plant and equipment Relocation.

Desirable

Chartered Engineer (CEng) or working towards
IAM, Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt), or equivalent
NEBOSH / IOSH certification
Experience in regulated industries (e.g. aerospace, nuclear, oil & gas)
Project Management Skills

Additional Information

Full-time permanent basis, 37 hours per week
Occasional out-of-hours support may be required
Involvement in site shutdowns and critical maintenance activities
Continuous professional development expected

Why should you choose this position?

Due to its position as a leading aerospace manufacturer operating in a highly regulated, technology-driven environment where engineering excellence is critical. The role provides the opportunity to work on complex, high-value assets where reliability, safety, and precision are paramount.

ITP Aero offers a strong platform for applying advanced maintenance and reliability practices, including data-driven decision-making, predictive maintenance, and continuous improvement methodologies such as TPM and RCM. This enables engineers to move beyond reactive maintenance and deliver measurable improvements in asset performance and operational efficiency.

Additionally, the organisation’s focus on innovation, investment in technology, and commitment to safety and quality makes it an attractive environment for engineers seeking both technical challenge and professional growth. The role also offers exposure to large-scale operations and strategic asset management, supporting long-term career development within a globally recognised aerospace business.

Who will I work with?

Manufacturing Services Team
Factory Design and Layout Team
Laboratory Team
HS&E Team
Procurement Team
Operational Team

What we offer:

25 days annual leave (inclusive of 5 fixed days).
6 Leisure days – Accrued through working an additional hour per week in addition to your contracted hours.
ITP Aero Group Personal Pension Scheme – Salary Sacrifice pension contributions increase with length of service to a maximum company contribution of 12% after 3 years of service.
You will have the option to contribute more to your pension through salary sacrifice Additional Voluntary Contributions (AVC’s).
Hybrid Working (dependant on role).
Life Assurance – 6x salary to your nominated beneficiary(s).
Income Protection - In the event of long term sickness.
Cycle to Work Scheme.
Enhanced Sick Pay.
Enhanced Pay for Maternity and Paternity (in line with statutory service dates).
Additional Leave for Marriage, Moving House and Dependant leave.
Employee Assistance Programme.
Access to 24/7 GP.
Earn vouchers through healthy living.
Paid Professional Membership.
Bonus Scheme applicable to role.
Opportunity for growth and internal promotion.

Deadline for submitting applications

The application period will be open until Friday, 18th Sept 2026.
